b1-001-s003.gloss: 询问这个手提包是不是你的。
b1-001-s003.whyLearn: your 是形容词性物主代词，可换成 his/her/Tom's；this 可换成 that，问句随即变成新句子。

b1-001-s005.gloss: 再次用它确认手提包的归属。
b1-001-s005.whyLearn: 同一句型反复出现，说明这是本课的操练核心：把 be 提前发问，主语和 your+名词 直接替换即可。

b1-002-s002.gloss: 把自己的票递给对方看。
b1-002-s002.whyLearn: Here is 用于递东西，my ticket 可换成 your key、his bag；主语换单数名词，句子照样成立。

b1-002-s005.whyLearn: and 连接两项构成并列主语，动词仍用 is；your 换成 my/his 或把两项换成别的物品就能再造一句。

b1-002-s008.whyLearn: 与 Is this your handbag? 同型，只换名词；注意 umbrella 前用 your 而不是 you，这是中国学生的高频错点。

b1-003-s004.gloss: 介绍这位是索菲·杜邦小姐。
b1-003-s004.whyLearn: This is 加姓名是介绍他人的固定句式，Miss 后接姓氏；把姓名整块替换即可介绍任何人。

b1-003-s006.whyLearn: 说的是国籍，但 a French 是错的表达，应为 She is French；借这句记住国籍前不加 a，才值得学。

b1-006-s001.whyLearn: Whose 直接限定名词提问归属，是英语里问“谁的”最省事的办法；shirt 可换成任何单数名词。

b1-006-s002.gloss: 问戴夫这件衬衫是不是他的。
b1-006-s002.whyLearn: 呼语 Dave 放在句尾并用逗号隔开，说话对象可换成任意人名，前半句句型完全不变。

b1-006-s005.whyLearn: 与 Is this your shirt? 只差语序和物主代词：my 换 your/his 就成答句，可正反两向操练。

b1-006-s012.gloss: 再次确认衬衫是不是对方的。
b1-006-s012.whyLearn: your shirt 可整块换成 your coat、his shirt；掌握“be 提前 + 物主代词 + 名词”就能无限造句。

b1-007-s001.gloss: 问你的新连衣裙是什么颜色。
b1-007-s001.whyLearn: What color 是提问颜色的固定搭配，后接 be 与主语；your new dress 可换成任何衣物，注意原句无问号。

b1-007-s010.whyLearn: 对已知物品追问颜色，用代词 it 最省事；把 What color 换成 What size、What make 即得同类问句。

b1-009-s006.whyLearn: 字面是问“你好吗”，实际只是见面招呼，答语也回 How do you do；整句背下来比逐词分析更有用。

b1-009-s011.gloss: 第二次出现，仍是见面问候。
b1-009-s011.whyLearn: 同一句在对话里往返使用，说明它是成套寒暄语，需要成对记忆而不是单独分析语法。

b1-010-s009.gloss: 把东西递给对方时说的话。
b1-010-s009.whyLearn: here you are 是递东西的固定说法，children 可换成任何人称呼。

b1-011-s001.whyLearn: give 加人加物是双宾结构，please 和 Jane 可换成任何请求与称呼。

b1-012-s001.whyLearn: glasses 是只有复数形的名词，故用 some；换成 shoes 等复数名词同理。

b1-015-s004.whyLearn: 情态动词 must 提问时提到主语前，换成 can、should 也是同一语序。

b1-018-s001.whyLearn: of 短语做后置定语，说明照片拍的是什么，可换成 of my family 等。

b1-018-s005.gloss: 这是这个村子的另一张照片。
b1-018-s005.whyLearn: Here is 是倒装，主语 photograph 在后，of 短语限定照片内容。

b1-018-s010.whyLearn: another 表示再一个，of 短语省略后句子更简短，适合直接套用。

b1-019-s002.whyLearn: 现在进行时疑问句由 be 加动词 ing 构成，问对方此刻正在做什么。

b1-019-s004.whyLearn: give 后接人再接物，please 可前置可后置，呼喊名字放在句末。

b1-019-s011.skeleton: What are you going to do
b1-019-s011.gloss: 你现在打算做什么，乔治？
b1-019-s011.whyLearn: be going to do 问计划，now 表此刻，George 换成别的名字即可问人。

b1-019-s012.whyLearn: be going to 加动词原形说打算，paint it 可换成任何动词加宾语。

b1-019-s013.skeleton: What colour are you going to paint it?
b1-019-s013.gloss: 你打算把它漆成什么颜色？
b1-019-s013.whyLearn: what colour 置于句首问颜色，be going to 部分语序不变，很实用。

b1-019-s014.skeleton: I'm going to paint it pink.
b1-019-s014.gloss: 我打算把它漆成粉红色。
b1-019-s014.whyLearn: pink 是宾语补足语，说明漆成什么颜色，可换成任何颜色词。

b1-020-s001.skeleton: What are you going to do
b1-020-s001.gloss: 你打算把那个花瓶怎么办，彭妮？
b1-020-s001.whyLearn: do with 是固定搭配，问如何处理某物，with 后接要处理的东西。

b1-020-s002.gloss: 我打算把它放在这张桌子上。
b1-020-s002.whyLearn: put 加宾语加地点，on this table 说明放置位置，可换成别的处所。

b1-020-s005.skeleton: What are you going to do
b1-020-s005.whyLearn: do with it 承接上文已提过的东西，问同一件事时不必重复名词。

b1-020-s006.skeleton: I'm going to put it here,
b1-020-s006.gloss: 我要把它放在窗前的这个位置。
b1-020-s006.whyLearn: 范句：把地点换掉即可复用，in front of the window 可替换为 on the table、near the door 等。

b1-020-s009.whyLearn: 范句：Don't + 动词原形 是最简否定祈使句式，put it 可换成 leave it、move it 等。

b1-022-s003.whyLearn: 范句：Is there any + 不可数名词 询问有无，water 可替换为 milk、sugar、tea 等。

b1-022-s011.gloss: 啊是的，我现在能看见它了。
b1-022-s011.whyLearn: 范句：can see 表示当下看得见，now 一加就点明此刻，it 可换成 the cups、the kettle 等。

b1-022-s012.whyLearn: 范句：Where are + 复数名词 的固定问法，the cups 可换成 the plates、the glasses 等。

b1-023-s010.whyLearn: 范句：递东西时的整句应答，语序固定不能改成 You are here，必须整句记住直接使用。

b1-024-s003.whyLearn: 范句：Do you want a/an + 单数名词 的招待问句，a cup 可替换为 a glass、an egg 等。

b1-024-s006.whyLearn: 范句：疑问句里不可数名词前用 any 而不用 some，sugar 可替换为 milk、water、salt 等。

b1-024-s008.whyLearn: 范句：与 any sugar 同型，只换名词；注意 milk 是不可数名词，前面不能加 a。

b1-024-s010.gloss: 我不喜欢咖啡里加牛奶。
b1-024-s010.whyLearn: 范句：否定句里用 my 而不是 mine，in my coffee 可换成 in my tea、with sugar 等。

b1-024-s012.whyLearn: 范句：like 表长期喜好，与 want 的一次性需求相对，biscuits 可换成 sweets、apples 等。

b1-024-s014.whyLearn: 范句：one 代替前面提到的可数名词，避免重复，也可换成 another、some 等。

b1-025-s001.skeleton: Do you want any meat today,
b1-025-s001.gloss: 肉贩：伯德太太，今天要肉吗？
b1-025-s001.whyLearn: 范句：英语把称呼放句尾，与汉语先说称呼的习惯相反，today 点出当日，规范句子还应补问号。

b1-025-s006.whyLearn: 范句：推销式评价句，a nice piece 可替换为 a good price、a fresh one 等。

b1-025-s007.gloss: 伯德太太：请给我那一块。
b1-025-s007.whyLearn: 范句：Give + 人 + 物 的双宾祈使句，please 加在句尾更礼貌，可用 Show me、Pass me 替换。

b1-025-s008.skeleton: Do you want a chicken, Mrs Bird?
b1-025-s008.gloss: 肉贩：伯德太太，你要一只鸡吗？
b1-025-s008.whyLearn: 范句：称呼放在句尾并用逗号隔开，a chicken 可替换为 a duck、a piece of meat 等。

b1-025-s013.gloss: 招呼一声，说我也不喜欢鸡肉。
b1-025-s013.whyLearn: 否定句加 either 表示「也不」，再用 Bird 呼唤对方；把 chicken 换掉即可谈任何食物。

b1-026-s001.whyLearn: 问候后最常用的破冰问句，come from 是整体语块，换上 Japan、China 等地点即可照说。

b1-027-s001.whyLearn: 与上一课同形的问句，可见 Where do you come from 是值得整句背下的问答模板，问籍贯最直接。

b1-027-s007.gloss: 问对方最喜欢哪个季节。
b1-027-s007.whyLearn: Which seasons 提前作宾语，best 放句末表程度；换 What colour、What food 就能问任何偏好。

b1-027-s011.skeleton: I don't like autumn and winter.
b1-027-s011.gloss: 说我不喜欢秋天和冬天。
b1-027-s011.whyLearn: 否定句里用 and 连接两个名词，表示两个都不喜欢；记住 like 后接名词，可换成 spring、summer 等。

b1-029-s002.skeleton: The children go to school by car every day

modifiers.text: they are going to school on foot

b1-029-s002.gloss: 孩子们平时坐车上学，今天却步行。
b1-029-s002.whyLearn: but 把「天天如此」与「今天反常」并置，一般现在时对现在进行时；换掉 by car、on foot 就能写自己的对比句。

b1-029-s004.skeleton: Mrs Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning,

modifiers.text: she is going to the shops

b1-029-s004.gloss: 索耶太太上午通常在家，今早却去买东西。
b1-029-s004.whyLearn: usually 与 this morning 构成习惯与例外的对照，stays 对 is going；换时间状语即可照搬这个高频对比框架。

b1-030-s002.skeleton: Do you want the large size,
b1-030-s002.gloss: 问顾客要大号还是小号。
b1-030-s002.whyLearn: 选择疑问句用 or 并列两个选项，语气落在后一项；点东西时换 the red one、the blue one 就能直接开口。

b1-030-s004.whyLearn: Have you…? 是英式口语里 Do you have…? 的说法，any 用于疑问句；writing-paper 是买东西的实用名词。

b1-030-s008.gloss: 问对方要不要一本便签簿。
b1-030-s008.whyLearn: 店主推销文具的典型问句，结构最简；把 a pad 换成 a pen、an envelope 就是完整的购物对话。

b1-030-s014.whyLearn: 用 one 代替前面提过的名词，避免重复；这是英语问答里极高频的替代用法，换成 two、three 也照样说。

b1-030-s018.whyLearn: else 跟在疑问词后表示「另外的」，是问购物清单的固定小词；换 Who else、Where else 可以套用到别处。

b1-031-s002.whyLearn: What's the matter with…? 是问病情和状况的固定说法，把 him 换成 her 或 Tom 就能随时使用。

b1-031-s011.whyLearn: 祈使句直接以动词开头，Show 后接双宾语：先人后物；your 表所属，换 Show me your hand 就能指挥动作。

b1-031-s013.skeleton: What's the matter with him,	doctor?
b1-031-s013.whyLearn: 医生看病必用的问句，末尾 doctor 是直接称呼；掌握它就能描述病人症状并请医生判断。

b1-031-s018.whyLearn: Because 引导原因状语从句，直接回答 Why 提问，doesn't 是第三人称否定；理由可换成 He is tired 等。

b1-032-s011.whyLearn: 看病询问症状的固定开场，have a temperature 可换成 have a cough 等。

b1-032-s016.skeleton: He can get up for about two hours each day, but you must keep the room warm.

modifiers.text: for about two hours each day
but you must keep the room warm

b1-032-s016.gloss: 说他能起身两小时，但房间要保暖。
b1-032-s016.whyLearn: can 与 must 一许可一要求，换主语或动词即可谈别的护理条件。

b1-033-s001.skeleton: What are you going to do
b1-033-s001.gloss: 父亲问贝蒂今晚打算做什么。
b1-033-s001.whyLearn: 问计划的框架，换 do 后的动词或时间就能问任何安排。

b1-033-s002.skeleton: I'm going to meet some friends
b1-033-s002.gloss: 贝蒂说要去见几个朋友。
b1-033-s002.whyLearn: be going to 谈计划，换不定式动词即可说出自己的安排。

b1-033-s010.whyLearn: 祈使句加双宾语，把 her the key 换成别人别的东西就能派活。

b1-033-s013.whyLearn: 递物固定口语，整句照用，不必按语序翻译成“你在这里”。

b1-034-s015.skeleton: We're going to spend three days
b1-034-s015.whyLearn: spend 加时段加地点的安排句，换数字或地点就能说别的行程。

b1-034-s016.whyLearn: at my mother's 用所有格代住处，换人名或时间即可说借宿安排。

b1-035-s006.gloss: 说能在人群里看到我们。
b1-035-s006.whyLearn: can 表可能，换地点状语就能约定在何处能被找到。

b1-035-s014.skeleton: my wife said to me, "Don't drive so quickly!
b1-035-s014.gloss: 回家路上妻子叫我别开太快。
b1-035-s014.whyLearn: 过去时转述加否定祈使，换人物和内容就能引述任何叮嘱。

b1-036-s012.gloss: 问昨晚他是否又来电话。
b1-036-s012.whyLearn: 一般疑问句问昨晚发生的事，换动词或时间即是追查行踪。

b1-036-s015.whyLearn: 特殊疑问句追问内容，换 say 为 tell 或 ask 即可问别的话。

b1-036-s017.skeleton: Please don't telephone my daughter again !
b1-036-s017.gloss: 请对方别再打电话给女儿。
b1-036-s017.whyLearn: 否定祈使句表制止，换宾语和 again 就能下任何禁令。

b1-036-s018.whyLearn: 同一疑问句省去时间状语追问，可见状语可增可省。

b1-037-s004.skeleton: I can ask him the way."
b1-037-s004.whyLearn: ask 接双宾语问路，换 ask 的对象即可用于任何求助场合。

b1-037-s016.whyLearn: 否定一般现在时说明语言能力，换语言名称即可自我说明。

b1-038-s001.skeleton: Have you any shoes like these
b1-038-s001.gloss: 女士问有没有像这样的鞋
b1-038-s001.whyLearn: Have you后直接接名词，是英式旧式问法，可见have表示拥有的疑问句式

b1-038-s009.gloss: 售货员问她是不是在这儿买的
b1-038-s009.whyLearn: buy的过去式buy them here，地点here放句尾，问购物地点一句话就够

b1-039-s004.gloss: 护士问病人有没有预约
b1-039-s004.whyLearn: 就诊场景的第一句套话，把appointment换成ticket、room即可通用

b1-039-s019.skeleton: I can wait, but my toothache can't !
b1-039-s019.gloss: 我能等但牙疼等不了，幽默抱怨
b1-039-s019.whyLearn: can't后省略wait，前后对比制造笑点，学英语的省略与转折

b1-040-s001.skeleton: Tom:	What are you doing, Peggy
b1-040-s001.gloss: 汤姆问佩吉正在做什么
b1-040-s001.whyLearn: 现在进行时直接问当下动作，句尾加称呼很口语，可套用问任何人

b1-040-s003.gloss: 汤姆问我们需要买什么
b1-040-s003.whyLearn: need是购物清单核心动词，What do we need可换成need to buy直接问采购

b1-040-s013.skeleton: Tom:	Have we got any beer and wine?
b1-040-s013.gloss: 汤姆问家里还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗
b1-040-s013.whyLearn: have got表示有，any用于疑问句，清点存货时最实用的问法

b1-041-s018.skeleton: We can have dinner at seven o'clock.
b1-041-s018.whyLearn: can表示安排可行，at加钟点表示时间，换成其他时间照用

b1-041-s021.gloss: 佩吉问你刚才吃了什么
b1-041-s021.whyLearn: have指吃，过去式问已发生的餐食，与have got表示拥有形成对比

b1-041-s024.whyLearn: What's the matter是关心别人的固定问句，中间不能改成其他词

b1-041-s025.skeleton: Peggy:	Well, you're going to have roast beef and potatoes again tonight!
b1-041-s025.gloss: 佩吉说今晚又要吃烤牛肉和土豆
b1-041-s025.whyLearn: you're going to have表示即将吃到，again tonight点出抱怨的无奈

b1-042-s005.skeleton: Do you want to have lunch with us?
b1-042-s005.gloss: 问对方想不想和我们一起吃午饭
b1-042-s005.whyLearn: want to do是意愿核心句型，with us是邀请的关键，换动词即可通用

b1-042-s012.skeleton: Tom:	Let's go into the living-room, Peggy.
b1-042-s012.whyLearn: Let's加动词原形提建议，into表示进入空间，句尾加称呼更自然

b1-042-s013.skeleton: We can have our coffee there.
b1-042-s013.gloss: 我们可以在那儿喝咖啡
b1-042-s013.whyLearn: can表可以，there代替地点避免重复，our coffee体现所属关系

b1-042-s017.whyLearn: be going to表示已定计划，tomorrow点明时间，换动词与时间可套用

b1-042-s018.skeleton: Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
b1-042-s018.whyLearn: Tom and I用主格并列做主语，have a holiday是度假的固定搭配

b1-042-s020.skeleton: Tom:	When are you going to have a holiday, John?
b1-042-s020.gloss: 问你打算什么时候去度假
b1-042-s020.whyLearn: be going to 问将来计划，to have a holiday 可直接替换成 to take a trip 等

b1-042-s021.gloss: 约翰说不知道何时休假
b1-042-s021.whyLearn: 最地道的回避答法，don't know 后省去向对方重复的那层信息

b1-042-s023.whyLearn: did 加动词原形的过去时提问骨架，换 Where/When/Why 即可复用

b1-043-s003.skeleton: George:	Have you just been to the cinema?
b1-043-s003.gloss: 问对方是否刚去过电影院
b1-043-s003.whyLearn: have been to 说去过某地，just 卡在 have 与 been 之间表刚刚

b1-043-s013.skeleton: George:	I have never been there.
b1-043-s013.whyLearn: never 位置是考点，必须放在 have 之后、过去分词之前

b1-043-s014.skeleton: Have you ever been there, Ken?
b1-043-s014.whyLearn: ever 与现在完成时是固定搭档，句尾呼语 Ken 前要用逗号隔开

b1-043-s016.whyLearn: 过去时配具体时间点，in 加月份是回答 when 的标准答法

b1-044-s002.whyLearn: 句尾加 sir 是服务场合的礼貌，称呼语要放句末并用逗号隔开

b1-044-s005.skeleton: Attendant:	When did you bring it to us?
b1-044-s005.gloss: 问对方何时把车送来的
b1-044-s005.whyLearn: bring sth to sb 的双宾结构，疑问词放句首、did 后动词用原形

b1-044-s010.skeleton: Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.

modifiers.text: and have a look at it

b1-044-s010.whyLearn: Let's 提建议后接两个并列动词，have a look at 比 look at 更口语

b1-045-s007.skeleton: Mr Hill: How long have you lived here?
b1-045-s007.gloss: 问对方在这里住了多久
b1-045-s007.whyLearn: how long 配现在完成时问持续时长，是住多久的标准问法

b1-045-s012.skeleton: Mr Hill: Then why do you want to sell it?
b1-045-s012.whyLearn: why 加 do you want to 追问动机，want to do 表达意愿

b1-045-s013.skeleton: Mr West: Because I have just retired.
b1-045-s013.whyLearn: Because 独立成句的口语答法，just 与现在完成时连用说刚发生的事

b1-045-s015.skeleton: Mr Hill: How much does this house cost?
b1-045-s015.whyLearn: how much 问价钱，cost 用一般现在时表一贯价格，主语是房子

b1-046-s004.skeleton: Mrs Smith:	Has he moved to his new house yet?
b1-046-s004.gloss: 问对方是否已搬入新居
b1-046-s004.whyLearn: yet 用于疑问句问事情是否已发生，常与现在完成时同现

b1-046-s007.whyLearn: be going to 表已定的打算，注意与 will 表临时决定的区别

b1-046-s019.whyLearn: 范句可整句记；give 后换人称代词和物主代词就能套用，如 give her my thanks。

b1-048-s011.skeleton: Let's go and have a drink.
b1-048-s011.whyLearn: Let's 提建议的范句，go and do 表目的；换成 go and see a film 即可复用。

b1-048-s013.skeleton: We had better go back to the station now
b1-048-s013.gloss: 我们最好现在回车站去。
b1-048-s013.whyLearn: had better do 表建议，语气比 should 强；地点和时间状语可随场景替换。

b1-049-s018.whyLearn: 递东西的固定说法，整句背；here 后接代词不倒装，与 Here is your book 不同。

b1-049-s021.whyLearn: 问「怎么了」的固定句型，matter 前必须加 the；整句背下即可直接使用。

b1-050-s002.whyLearn: 同上一句加称呼语，人名可换成任何对象；逗号隔开放句尾，问熟人更自然。

b1-050-s004.whyLearn: 现在完成时问伤情，yourself 与主语 you 呼应；hurt 可换 cut 等其他动词。

b1-051-s015.whyLearn: What else 追问「还有什么」，does 后动词用原形 say，可换 do、read 等。

b1-052-s009.skeleton: I could answer sixteen of the questions.
b1-052-s009.gloss: 我能答出其中十六道题。
b1-052-s009.whyLearn: could 表过去的能力，answer 后接 of 加范围；换数字和名词就能谈考试成绩。

b1-053-s003.skeleton: Do you want to speak to her
b1-053-s003.whyLearn: want to do 表达意愿，speak to sb 是固定搭配；her 可换任何人，sir 放句尾更礼貌。

b1-053-s007.skeleton: Did you want to see me
b1-053-s007.whyLearn: Did you want to… 比 Do you want 更委婉，求见时常用；see me 可换其他动词。

b1-053-s009.whyLearn: 问拼写的固定句型，spell 后直接放被问的词；换个单词就能问任何拼写。

b1-054-s001.gloss: 夫人，您喜欢这条连衣裙吗？
b1-054-s001.whyLearn: 招呼顾客的礼貌问句，称呼 madam 放句尾；this dress 可换任何商品名词。

b1-054-s012.skeleton: I don't like the colour either.
b1-054-s012.whyLearn: 否定句句尾用 either 表「也」，与肯定句的 too 相对；the colour 可替换。

b1-055-s004.whyLearn: 疑问句里用 any 不用 some；换 milk 为其他名词即可问要不要别的东西。

b1-056-s002.whyLearn: 问价钱的范句，how much 提前、cost 用原形；换主语就能问任何物品的价格。

b1-056-s010.gloss: 夫里斯先生说不喜欢这款。
b1-056-s010.whyLearn: 对话里最常用的否定表态句，don't+动词原形直接表达不喜欢。

b1-056-s014.skeleton: You can pay a deposit（保证金） of ten pounds,

modifiers.text: and then one pound a week

b1-056-s014.gloss: 先付十镑定金，再每周付一镑共六十周。
b1-056-s014.whyLearn: can表示可以，用offer/分期付款报价；替换数字即可照用整句。

b1-056-s015.gloss: 丈夫问妻子喜不喜欢它。
b1-056-s015.whyLearn: Do you like it?是开口问喜好的万能句，呼语dear让语气亲切。

b1-056-s016.skeleton: I certainly do, but I don't like the price.
b1-056-s016.gloss: 她喜欢它，却嫌价钱太高。
b1-056-s016.whyLearn: do替代like避免重复，but把肯定与否定评价并置，转折自然。

b1-056-s019.skeleton: Millionaires don't buy things on instalments !
b1-056-s019.gloss: 他说百万富翁买东西不分期付款。
b1-056-s019.whyLearn: 主语复数用don't，on instalments是分期付款的地道说法。

b1-057-s008.skeleton: Have you any small change, sir?
b1-057-s008.gloss: 售票员问乘客有没有零钱。
b1-057-s008.whyLearn: 英式旧用法Have you any…?把have当实义动词提问，与do you have对比着记。

b1-057-s014.whyLearn: Neither+助动词+主语表“也不”，倒装且比me neither更正式。

b1-057-s021.whyLearn: So+助动词+主语表“也是”，与Neither can I成对，注意用have不用do。

b1-058-s010.whyLearn: Let's+动词原形是提议行动的标准句式，比shall we更口语。

b1-058-s022.gloss: 他说可以给你一些柠檬水。
b1-058-s022.whyLearn: can表许可，肯定句用some，替换食物名词即可说任何招待话。

b1-058-s024.whyLearn: 否定祈使句Don't+动词原形，是劝阻和提醒最直接的句式。

b1-059-s011.skeleton: I don't know," I answered, "Tommy's been to the lavatory three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!"

modifiers.text: "Tommy's been to the lavatory three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!"

b1-059-s011.gloss: 他答不知道，但汤米一早上厕所三次。
b1-059-s011.whyLearn: 一句里过去时答话与现在完成时抱怨并置，插入语还能后置提示说话人。

b1-060-s001.whyLearn: Do you like+复数名词问一类事物喜好，like后接可数名词复数最自然。

b1-060-s004.skeleton: two thieves climbed into his kitchen.

modifiers.text: While my friend, George, was reading in bed,

b1-060-s004.gloss: 朋友躺床上看书时，两个贼进了厨房。
b1-060-s004.whyLearn: While引导的进行时铺垫背景，主句用过去时推进事件，是叙事黄金结构。

b1-061-s004.whyLearn: Which books限定了可选范围，配did+动词原形问过去的选择。

b1-061-s006.skeleton: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Miss Roberts?
b1-061-s006.gloss: 经理问罗伯茨小姐半小时前是否接待过。
b1-061-s006.whyLearn: Did you+动词原形+时间状语核对过去事实，是查证和追问的常用问法。

b1-061-s010.skeleton: Manager:	Have you got a hat
b1-061-s010.whyLearn: 口语里 have got 等于 have，问有没有随身物品时最常用，句尾 sir 是服务场所的礼貌称呼。

b1-061-s014.gloss: 这位就是你招待过的那个人吗？
b1-061-s014.whyLearn: the man 后接 that 定语从句，是把辨认对象讲清楚的关键；that 在从句里作宾语，可以省略。

modifiers.text: I took during my trip to Australia

b1-062-s002.gloss: 这是我澳大利亚之行拍的一张照片
b1-062-s002.whyLearn: 关系代词省掉的定语从句：photograph 后直接跟 I took，展示叙述照片来历时最自然的说法。

b1-062-s004.skeleton: Bob: This is a good photograph
b1-062-s004.whyLearn: this is + 名词 + 形容词的入门评价句，可把 good 换成 lovely、nice 等词扩充词汇。

b1-062-s020.skeleton: Bob:	Why did you shave it off
b1-062-s020.whyLearn: shave off 是剃掉毛发的固定搭配，it 放在两个词中间；why 提问过去动作，态度带点惊讶。

b1-063-s004.skeleton: Susan:	Do you have to water it now
b1-063-s004.gloss: 苏珊问你非得现在浇水吗？
b1-063-s004.whyLearn: have to 问的是客观上有没有必要，与 must 相比更像在商量，反问对方的安排很实用。

b1-063-s014.whyLearn: already 放在句末的疑问句常带意外语气，比单纯问 Have you finished 更有情绪色彩。

b1-063-s021.skeleton: It means I can have tea
b1-063-s021.gloss: 这意味着我可以改喝茶了
b1-063-s021.whyLearn: means 后接完整句子作宾语；can 表许可，instead 放句末表示退而求其次的选择。

b1-065-s004.skeleton: Policeman:	Where do you think you are
b1-065-s004.gloss: 警察问你以为自己在哪儿？
b1-065-s004.whyLearn: do you think 插在疑问词后，语序仍是 where you are，是间接问句语序最常见的易错点。

b1-065-s017.skeleton: But you'd better not do it again
b1-065-s017.gloss: 但你最好别再这么干了！
b1-065-s017.whyLearn: had better not do 是警告语气的固定说法，否定词直接跟在 better 后，不能说 don't better。

b1-066-s001.skeleton: Roy: Where are you going to spend your holidays
b1-066-s001.gloss: 罗伊问哈里今年去哪度假？
b1-066-s001.whyLearn: be going to 问计划，holidays 用复数指整段假期；your 所有格限定 holiday 是最常见的搭配。

b1-066-s012.whyLearn: 否定祈使句 don't 加动词原形，be 动词也要用原形；简短有力，常用来反驳对方的乐观判断。

b1-066-s015.skeleton: Who's going to look after the dog
b1-066-s015.whyLearn: who 作主语时后面直接跟 is going to；look after 的宾语紧跟在 after 之后，不能拆开。

b1-066-s016.skeleton: Who's going to look after the house
b1-066-s016.whyLearn: 与上一句结构相同，只换了宾语；把 the house 替换成宠物或孩子就能反复操练同一句型。

b1-066-s017.skeleton: Who's going to look after the garden
b1-066-s017.whyLearn: 第三句同构排比，garden 与前两句的 dog、house 对应，展示 who 主语问句的替换练习。

b1-067-s001.skeleton: Reporter: Have you just made a new film
b1-067-s001.gloss: 记者问你刚拍完新电影吗？
b1-067-s001.whyLearn: just 放在 have 与过去分词之间，表示动作刚刚完成，是现在完成时里最常见的时间副词位置。

b1-067-s005.whyLearn: 极简的 be going to 范句，retire 可替换为任何动词原形，如 move、study。

b1-067-s007.skeleton: I don't want to make another film
b1-067-s007.gloss: 我很久都不想再拍电影。
b1-067-s007.whyLearn: don't want to do 表达意愿，for a long time 说明时长；film 可换 job、trip。

b1-067-s008.whyLearn: let's + 动词原形提建议的范句，buy a newspaper 可替换成任何活动。

b1-068-s010.skeleton: We are going to get married
b1-068-s010.whyLearn: be going to 表计划，get married 可换任意动词，next week 可换时间状语。

b1-069-s005.skeleton: You always say that, but we never win anything!
b1-069-s005.gloss: 你总那么说，我们却从没赢过。
b1-069-s005.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列分句，never 表完全否定；say、win 可换成同位置动词。

b1-069-s007.skeleton: I shall buy you a mink coat

modifiers.text: If I win a lot of money

b1-069-s007.gloss: 要是我赢很多钱，就给你买貂皮大衣。
b1-069-s007.whyLearn: 真实条件句范句：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 shall；money 与 coat 都可替换。

b1-069-s008.skeleton: I don't want a mink coat!
b1-069-s008.whyLearn: don't want + 名词直接表拒绝，a mink coat 可替换为任何不想要的东西。

b1-069-s011.skeleton: we shall travel around the world and we shall stay at the best hotels

modifiers.text: If we win a lot of money

b1-069-s011.gloss: 若赢大钱就环游世界、住最好的旅馆。
b1-069-s011.whyLearn: if 条件句后接两个 shall 并列主句，and 后省略 we；travel 与 stay 可换计划。

b1-069-s015.whyLearn: shall 用于征询对方意见，do 可替换为任何动词原形，then 表承上。

b1-069-s016.skeleton: we shall try and win the football pools again

modifiers.text: If we spend all the money

b1-069-s016.gloss: 钱花光了就再去赢足球彩票。
b1-069-s016.whyLearn: try and do 相当于 try to do；条件从句用现在时，money、win 可替换。

b1-070-s009.gloss: 我不知道什么时候能完成。
b1-070-s009.whyLearn: when 引导间接疑问作宾语，须用陈述语序；finish 可替换为任何动词。

b1-070-s011.whyLearn: what 引导间接疑问作宾语，介词 about 留在句末；talk about 的内容可替换。

b1-070-s016.skeleton: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company
b1-070-s016.gloss: 你在海外工程公司工作，对吧？
b1-070-s016.whyLearn: 反意疑问句范句：肯定陈述配否定尾巴，公司名与 work for 都可替换。

modifiers.text: because she had never traveled on a train before

b1-071-s003.gloss: 萨莉很兴奋，因为她以前没坐过火车。
b1-071-s003.whyLearn: because 从句用过去完成时交代更早的经历，主句表心情；excited 与经历可换。

b1-072-s002.skeleton: It is a famous beauty spot
b1-072-s002.whyLearn: It is + 名词的判断句，beauty spot 可整体替换为其他景点说法。

b2-001-s017.whyLearn: 引号内是完整引述句，private 可替换为其他形容词来改变语气。

b2-002-s002.whyLearn: never 放在实义动词前表习惯性否定，on Sundays 用复数表每逢周日。

b2-002-s015.gloss: 问对方此刻正在做什么。
b2-002-s015.whyLearn: 特殊疑问句把 what 提前，be 动词随 you 用 are，可换 watching 等动作。

b2-002-s019.skeleton: Do you always get up so late
b2-002-s019.whyLearn: 一般疑问句用 Do 开头，always 在实义动词前，可换成 Do you always have lunch so late。

b2-004-s009.skeleton: My brother has never been abroad before

modifiers.text: so he is finding this trip very exciting

b2-004-s009.gloss: 弟弟从未出过国，故觉得此行很刺激。
b2-004-s009.whyLearn: never 与 before 连用现在完成时表从未有过，so 引结果，find 后可接宾语加形容词。

b2-007-s004.skeleton: some of the detectives were waiting inside the main building

modifiers.text: while others were waiting on the airfield

b2-007-s004.gloss: 飞机到达时，部分侦探在主楼等候，其余在停机坪。
b2-007-s004.whyLearn: when 与 while 引时间状语从句，主句用过去进行时铺垫背景，while 强调同时进行。

modifiers.text: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door

b2-007-s006.gloss: 两名侦探守着门时，另两人打开了包裹。
b2-007-s006.whyLearn: while 从句用过去进行时铺垫，主句用一般过去时表突然发生的动作，层次分明。

modifiers.text: but I do not like hard work

b2-008-s006.gloss: 我也爱花园，但不喜欢干重活。
b2-008-s006.whyLearn: too 置于句末表「也」，but 连接两个并列分句，否定用 do not 比 don't 更正式。

modifiers.text: but he always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back

b2-011-s003.gloss: 他薪水高，却总向朋友借钱且从不还。
b2-011-s003.whyLearn: but 表转折，and 连接 borrow 与 pay 两个谓语，never 表从不，it 指借来的钱。

b2-011-s005.whyLearn: never 插在 has 与过去分词之间构成完成时否定，from me 说明借的对象。

b2-011-s008.skeleton: I have never borrowed any money from you

modifiers.text: so now you can pay for my dinner

b2-011-s008.gloss: 哈利说没借过钱，所以该你请客。
b2-011-s008.whyLearn: 现在完成时 never borrowed 强调从未发生，any 用于否定句，pay for 意为为…付钱。

b2-014-s006.skeleton: I do not know any French
b2-014-s006.gloss: 除了几个词，我完全不懂法语。
b2-014-s006.whyLearn: apart from 表除…之外，否定句中用 any 而非 some，at all 加强一点也不。

b2-014-s008.skeleton: I had nearly reached the town

modifiers.text: when the young man suddenly said, very slowly, 'Do you speak English?'

b2-014-s008.gloss: 我快到镇上时，年轻人慢吞吞地问我会说英语吗。
b2-014-s008.whyLearn: had reached 表过去某时前已完成，when 引突然发生的事，very slowly 作插入语。

b2-015-s012.whyLearn: 否定祈使句用 Don't 加动词原形，引语作 said 的宾语，said 用一般过去时。

b2-016-s001.skeleton: a traffic policeman will soon find it

modifiers.text: If you park your car in the wrong place

b2-016-s001.gloss: 若违停，交警很快会找到你的车。
b2-016-s001.whyLearn: if 引导条件从句，遵循主将从现：从句用一般现在时，主句用 will find。

b2-016-s006.whyLearn: 主系表结构说明地点性质，No Parking 作前置定语，可换 No Smoking 等标语。

modifiers.text: If anyone ever asked her how old she is
'My dear, it must be terrible to be grown up!

b2-017-s008.gloss: 有人问她年龄，她总说长大太可怕。
b2-017-s008.whyLearn: if 从句用过去时表委婉，how old she is 用陈述语序，it 为形式主语。

b2-018-s004.skeleton: Did you have a good meal
b2-018-s004.whyLearn: Did 提前构成过去时疑问句，have a good meal 是固定搭配，meal 可换成 trip、holiday 继续问

b2-020-s007.gloss: 我什么都钓不上来，连旧靴子都没有
b2-020-s007.whyLearn: never 与 anything 双重强调否定，破折号后 not even 补出最夸张的例子，可换成 not even a shoe

b2-022-s001.skeleton: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter

modifiers.text: from a girl of her own age

b2-022-s001.gloss: 女儿简做梦也没想到会收到荷兰同龄女孩的信
b2-022-s001.whyLearn: dream of 后接动名词 receiving，Jane 是同位语，from a girl of her own age 可整块换成别的来源

b2-022-s004.skeleton: She never thought of it again

modifiers.text: but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland

b2-022-s004.gloss: 她再没想起这事，十个月后却收到荷兰来信
b2-022-s004.whyLearn: but 连接两个过去时小句，never thought of it again 与 later 形成前后对照，时间短语可整体替换

b2-023-s004.gloss: 她要是来了，准会大吃一惊
b2-023-s004.whyLearn: if 从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用 will，get a surprise 可换成 be surprised、be delighted

modifiers.text: that she could stay with us

b2-023-s008.gloss: 我在信里说，她可以住我们这儿
b2-023-s008.whyLearn: told her 后接 that 宾语从句，could 与主句过去时呼应，stay with us 可换成 come、visit 等动词

b2-023-s010.skeleton: It is a very modern house

modifiers.text: so it looks strange to some people

b2-023-s010.gloss: 这是栋很现代的房子，有人看着觉得怪
b2-023-s010.whyLearn: so 引出结果分句，to some people 点明视角，a very modern house 可换成任意形容词加名词

b2-024-s004.gloss: 经理很同情，却也帮不上忙
b2-024-s004.whyLearn: but 连接两个过去时小句，could do nothing 表过去无能为力，nothing 可换成 little、much

modifiers.text: but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly

b2-025-s006.gloss: 他回答了我，但说得既不慢也不清楚
b2-025-s006.whyLearn: but 连接两个小句，neither...nor 并列两个副词，slowly 与 clearly 可换成任意一对副词

b2-025-s009.gloss: 我的老师从不像那样说英语
b2-025-s009.whyLearn: never 否定过去的习惯动作，like that 是方式状语，spoke English 可换成任意动词加宾语

b2-025-s016.gloss: 英国人彼此听得懂，我却听不懂他们
b2-025-s016.whyLearn: but 把两个分句正反对照，each other 表互相，them 回指 the English，人称代词可整体替换

b2-025-s017.whyLearn: Do 提前构成疑问句，they 与 English 都可替换，注意 speak 后直接跟语言，不加冠词

b2-026-s011.whyLearn: What 提前加 be 动词构成进行时问句，doing 可换成 reading、writing 等任意动词

b2-026-s015.whyLearn: Do 引导一般疑问句，like 与 it 可分别换成任何动词和宾语，正可与否定答句对照操练

modifiers.text: when he returns home at night
that someone has parked a car outside his gate

b2-028-s003.gloss: 他每晚回家，总发现有人把车停在大门外
b2-028-s003.whyLearn: when 从句用现在时表习惯，finds 后 that 从句用现在完成时，his gate 可换成 my window

b2-028-s004.skeleton: he has not been able to get his own car into his garage
b2-028-s004.gloss: 因此他一次也没能把自家车开进车库
b2-028-s004.whyLearn: 范句：has not been able to 表至今未能，get sth into sp 可替换物品与地点，even once 加重语气

b2-028-s007.skeleton: It is one of the ugliest faces
b2-028-s007.gloss: 这是我所见过最丑的脸之一
b2-028-s007.whyLearn: 范句：one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，后接省略 that 的定语从句，faces 与 seen 都可替换

b2-032-s001.gloss: 如今的人不如从前诚实
b2-032-s001.whyLearn: 范句：not so + 形容词 + as 从句表今昔比较，从句可用 they used to be 等替换，练否定比较结构

b2-032-s008.skeleton: the detective found out that the shop-assistant was her daughter

modifiers.text: that the shop-assistant was her daughter

b2-032-s008.gloss: 她被捕时侦探发现店员是她女儿
b2-032-s008.whyLearn: 范句：When 从句置句首作背景，found out 后接 that 宾语从句，人物身份与关系可整体替换

b2-033-s007.skeleton: She knew she was near the shore

modifiers.text: because the light was high up on the cliffs

b2-033-s007.gloss: 她凭崖上高处的灯光知道自己靠近海岸
b2-033-s007.whyLearn: 范句：knew 后省略 that 接宾语从句，再用 because 从句说出判断依据，两层从句一次练到位

modifiers.text: When she woke up a day later

b2-033-s010.gloss: 一天后她醒来发现自己躺在医院
b2-033-s010.whyLearn: 范句：find oneself + 介词短语表不知不觉身处某地，in hospital 可换成任何地点

modifiers.text: because he never expected the bicycle to be found

b2-034-s009.gloss: 他也觉得好笑，因为他没料到车会被找到
b2-034-s009.whyLearn: 范句：expect sth to be done 的复合结构，被动不定式 to be found 可换成任何动词，练被动不定式

modifiers.text: and he was not regretted it

b2-035-s002.gloss: 不久前他当了公交车司机，而且并不后悔
b2-035-s002.whyLearn: 范句：时间状语与 however 插入语开篇，and 再引一个并列分句，职业与态度内容可替换

b2-035-s009.skeleton: Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police

modifiers.text: While the battered car was moving away

b2-035-s009.gloss: 破车开走时罗伊停车打电话报警
b2-035-s009.whyLearn: 范句：While 进行时从句铺背景，主句两个过去式动词并列，可替换人物与两个动作

b2-036-s001.skeleton: Erna Hart is going to swim across the English Channel
b2-036-s001.gloss: 厄娜·哈特明天要游过英吉利海峡
b2-036-s001.whyLearn: 范句：be going to 表已定计划，swim across + 地点可换成任何运动与场所，末尾加时间

b2-036-s002.skeleton: She is going to set out from the French coast

modifiers.text: at five o'clock in the morning

b2-036-s002.gloss: 她打算清晨五点从法国海岸出发
b2-036-s002.whyLearn: 范句：set out from + 地点 + at + 钟点，出发地与时间可整体替换，练计划表达加状语顺序

modifiers.text: and many people feel that she is sure to succeed
that she is sure to succeed

b2-036-s004.gloss: 她是游泳健将，很多人觉得她必定成功
b2-036-s004.whyLearn: 范句：be sure to do 表必定发生，and 连接另一主句并由 that 从句转述众人看法，内容均可替换

b2-037-s009.skeleton: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games

modifiers.text: because they have never been held before in this country

b2-037-s009.gloss: 我们期待奥运会，因为本国从未办过
b2-037-s009.whyLearn: 范句：look forward to 后接名词，再用 because 从句给理由，赛事与理由可整体替换

b2-038-s004.skeleton: he began to complain about the weather

modifiers.text: for even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold
even though it was still summer

b2-038-s004.gloss: 他立刻开始抱怨天气，虽值夏天却阴雨寒冷
b2-038-s004.whyLearn: 范句：for 引出原因分句，分句里再套 even though 让步从句，主句与天气描写都可替换

modifiers.text: as if he had never lived in England before

b2-038-s006.gloss: 他表现得仿佛从未在英国生活过
b2-038-s006.whyLearn: 范句：as if 引导方式状语从句，用过去完成时表与过去事实相反，acted 与 lived in 可替换

b2-038-s007.skeleton: it was more than he could bear
b2-038-s007.gloss: 最后，这事超出了他的承受能力
b2-038-s007.whyLearn: 范句：more than sb could bear 表忍无可忍，bear 可换成 stand 等动词，主语也随语境替换

b2-039-s003.skeleton: he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington
b2-039-s003.gloss: 他独自一人时打电话找米灵顿医生
b2-039-s003.whyLearn: 时间从句在前铺垫，主句两个并列过去式动词推进，人名与机构可替换

b2-040-s016.skeleton: we would both enjoy our dinner

modifiers.text: if you ate more and talked less

b2-040-s016.gloss: 她说，你多吃少说，这顿饭大家都吃得香
b2-040-s016.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句 ate 与 would 搭配表与现在相反，both 位置可换

b2-041-s001.skeleton: Do you call that a hat
b2-041-s001.whyLearn: call A B 口语反问，a hat 可换成任何名词来讽刺

b2-041-s006.gloss: 我说，不该买我们用不着的东西
b2-041-s006.whyLearn: 省略关系词的定语从句紧跟 things，mustn't 表禁止，名词可替换

b2-041-s011.skeleton: A man can never have too many ties
b2-041-s011.gloss: 男人的领带永远不嫌多
b2-041-s011.whyLearn: can never have too many 是固定夸张说法，替换 ties 即可造句

b2-041-s012.skeleton: a woman can't have too many hats
b2-041-s012.gloss: 她回答说，女人的帽子也不嫌多
b2-041-s012.whyLearn: 与上句对仗，换主语和名词即可复用 can't have too many 结构

modifiers.text: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of Old Delhi
through one of the markets of Old Delhi

b2-042-s001.gloss: 在旧德里市场走累了，我们在广场歇脚
b2-042-s001.whyLearn: had had 过去完成时表先发生，不定式表目的，地点与目的可替换

b2-042-s004.skeleton: we had our first glimpse of the snake

modifiers.text: When he began to play a tune

b2-042-s004.gloss: 他一吹起曲子，我们才头一次看见那条蛇
b2-042-s004.whyLearn: have a glimpse of 名词化表达，时间从句先行动作，first 可换词

b2-043-s005.gloss: 一度看来，他们的飞机肯定要坠毁
b2-043-s005.whyLearn: it 作形式主语后置真正的主语从句，would 表过去将来，形容词可换

b2-043-s006.skeleton: It could only get over the mountains
b2-043-s006.gloss: 它只有升到一万英尺才越得过群山
b2-043-s006.whyLearn: if 从句后置，only 与 could 表唯一途径，数字与动词可替换

b2-046-s001.skeleton: workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes

modifiers.text: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport
to unload a number of wooden boxes

b2-046-s001.gloss: 伦敦来的飞机一到，工人开始卸下许多木箱
b2-046-s001.whyLearn: 时间从句、主句、定语从句三层递进，arrive at 与 a number of 可整块换

b2-046-s002.skeleton: No one could account for the fact

modifiers.text: that one of the boxes was extremely heavy

b2-046-s002.gloss: 谁也说不出为何其中一只箱子特别重
b2-046-s002.whyLearn: the fact that 引出同位语从句，account for 是固定搭配，从句可换

b2-046-s003.skeleton: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers
b2-046-s003.gloss: 一名工人忽然想到打开那只箱子
b2-046-s003.whyLearn: occur to sb to do 是地道句型，it 为形式主语，主语与动作可替换

b2-047-s002.skeleton: Mr Thompson is going to sell it
b2-047-s002.gloss: 汤普森先生打算卖掉它，因为房子闹鬼
b2-047-s002.whyLearn: be going to 表打算，because 从句交代理由，宾语与从句主语同指

modifiers.text: that they will not accept the inn
even if he gives it away

b2-047-s008.gloss: 村民已告诉他，就算白送也没人要这旅店
b2-047-s008.whyLearn: 现在完成时加宾语从句再套 even if 让步，gives away 可整块替换

b2-048-s006.skeleton: I either nodded or made strange noises
b2-048-s006.gloss: 面对这些问题，我要么点头要么怪声应对
b2-048-s006.whyLearn: either...or 并列两个过去式动词，介词短语置句首，动词可随意替换

b2-049-s003.skeleton: he carried the bed on to the roof of his house

modifiers.text: Because the weather was very hot
on to the roof of his house

b2-049-s003.gloss: 天太热，他把床搬到自家屋顶上。
b2-049-s003.whyLearn: Because 从句先说原因，主句 carried…on to the roof 是「把某物搬到某处」的可替换框架。

b2-049-s008.skeleton: he was still on the mattress
b2-049-s008.gloss: 他醒来时仍躺在床垫上。
b2-049-s008.whyLearn: When 从句与主句同为过去时，still on the mattress 可换成任何「仍在某处」的画面。

b2-050-s001.skeleton: I love travelling in the country

modifiers.text: but I don't like losing my way

b2-050-s001.gloss: 我爱在乡间旅行，却不愿迷路。
b2-050-s001.whyLearn: love doing 与 don't like doing 正反对照，换成任意两个爱好就能表达好恶。

modifiers.text: as I got on the bus
but I don't know where it is.'

b2-050-s003.gloss: 我说要去伍德福德格林，却不知它在哪儿。
b2-050-s003.whyLearn: be going to 说打算、where it is 说不知道，两句一换就能搬到任何问路场景。

modifiers.text: because I own over a thousand books

b2-052-s003.gloss: 这不容易，因为我有上千本书。
b2-052-s003.whyLearn: 先用现在完成时给结论，再用 because 补理由，是解释难处的万能顺序。

b2-052-s006.skeleton: my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs

modifiers.text: to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs

b2-052-s006.gloss: 不久前，姐姐帮我把旧书柜搬上楼。
b2-052-s006.whyLearn: help sb to do sth 中间可换任意动作，up the stairs 点明方向，替换名词即可复用。

b2-052-s009.skeleton: She gazed at it for some time then added
b2-052-s009.gloss: 她盯着看了一会儿，说根本不需要书柜。
b2-052-s009.whyLearn: not…at all 把否定说到十足，可换成任何「完全不需要、完全不喜欢」的说法。

b2-052-s010.gloss: 你有空可以坐这儿读地毯！
b2-052-s010.whyLearn: can 表许可，in your spare time 是可替换的时间条件，and 再接第二个动作。

b2-053-s012.skeleton: it sent sparks down to the ground

modifiers.text: and these immediately started a fire

b2-053-s012.gloss: 它一这样做，火星落地立刻引燃大火。
b2-053-s012.whyLearn: did so 替代前面的动词避免重复，and 引出后果，适合按步骤讲事件经过。

b2-056-s003.skeleton: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost
b2-056-s003.gloss: 最漂亮的汽车之一是劳斯莱斯银魅。
b2-056-s003.whyLearn: One of the most + 复数名词 + was… 先评最高级再举代表，换名词就能介绍任何之最。

b2-058-s002.skeleton: the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased

modifiers.text: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper

b2-058-s002.gloss: 因报上提到这树，弗林利游客增多了。
b2-058-s002.whyLearn: 原因从句里用被动交代缘由，主句 the number of…has increased 专写数量变化。

modifiers.text: that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die
; if he picks a leaf, he will die

b2-058-s004.gloss: 据说碰这树会走霉运，摘片叶子就会死。
b2-058-s004.whyLearn: It is said that 引出传言，从句里用分号并列两个 if 条件加后果，是复述规矩的模板。

b2-060-s010.gloss: 你刚才一直躲到哪儿去了？
b2-060-s010.whyLearn: 现在完成进行时追问「一直在哪儿」，替换动词就能问别人这段时间的去向。

b2-061-s009.skeleton: the results of the trip will be announced immediately

modifiers.text: When the first radio messages have been received

b2-061-s009.gloss: 首批无线电讯号收到后，旅行结果将立即公布。
b2-061-s009.whyLearn: 时间从句用现在完成时代替将来时，主句 will be announced 被动，是公告的正式写法。

b2-062-s001.skeleton: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire

modifiers.text: before they could get it under control

b2-062-s001.gloss: 消防员奋战近三周才控制住林火。
b2-062-s001.whyLearn: had been fighting 强调持续之久，before…could 表示「才」，写长期努力后的转折最合适。

b2-064-s007.skeleton: This would solve the problem of ventilation

modifiers.text: for if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it
if a train entered this tunnel

b2-064-s007.gloss: 这能解决通风问题：列车进隧道会带进新风。
b2-064-s007.whyLearn: would 加 for 引出的原因句，再套 if 条件，是解释设计原理的标准搭配。

modifiers.text: that the police would never allow this sort of thing.

b2-065-s003.gloss: 他本该料到警方绝不会允许这种事。
b2-065-s003.whyLearn: should have done 表示“本该做却没做”，后接 that 宾语从句说明推测内容；把从句换成别的推测，就能表达各种责备或遗憾。

modifiers.text: When the bull got close to him,

b2-070-s007.gloss: 公牛逼近时，他笨拙地闪身让它过去。
b2-070-s007.whyLearn: when 时间状语从句加不定式表目的，主语与动作都可替换，用来描写任何“躲开逼近的某物”的场面。

modifiers.text: because microphones are connected to the clock tower.

b2-071-s009.gloss: 麦克风连着钟楼，所以钟响时你能听见。
b2-071-s009.whyLearn: 一句里 when 时间从句和 because 原因从句分层嵌套，主干 can hear 保持简短；三个分句的主语和动词都可替换后套用。

b2-074-s013.whyLearn: 一般疑问句用 Do 开头、句尾读升调；把 see that notice 换成任意动词短语即可提问，是日常提问最基础的框架。

modifiers.text: ' don't be too hard on us.

b2-074-s015.gloss: 罗克沃尔劝警长别太苛待他们。
b2-074-s015.whyLearn: 引号与said交错是小说对话写法；be hard on sb 可换成别的表责备说法。

b2-075-s001.skeleton: it crashed in the mountains and its pilot was killed.

modifiers.text: When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago,

b2-075-s001.gloss: 一架轻型客机偏离航线，坠毁山中，飞行员丧生。
b2-075-s001.whyLearn: when从句先交代背景再落到主句，是叙事开篇的常用框架；flew off course与crashed成对，可代入失事场景。

b2-075-s007.skeleton: she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it

modifiers.text: covering them with all the clothes she could find.

b2-075-s007.gloss: 她把衣箱改成床，把孩子放进去，再盖上能找到的衣服。
b2-075-s007.whyLearn: 两个并列过去式动词铺出动作顺序，句尾covering挂上补充动作；turn A into B 是高频短语。

b2-075-s010.skeleton: she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.

modifiers.text: how she could send a signal

b2-075-s010.gloss: 次日清早她听见飞机飞过，想怎样发出信号。
b2-075-s010.whyLearn: heard sb doing 与 wondered how 连用，把听到的动静和心里的盘算接在一起，叙事时很好套用。

b2-076-s004.skeleton: Here you can see two workers

modifiers.text: who, between them, have just finished cutting three cart-loads of golden brownmacaroni stalks.

b2-076-s004.gloss: 这里能看到两名工人刚切完三车金黄通心粉秆。
b2-076-s004.whyLearn: 介绍画面用 Here you can see；定语从句中插 between them，finished doing 表刚做完。

b2-076-s006.skeleton: you can see Mrs Brabante herself.
b2-076-s006.gloss: 右边这位就是布拉班特太太本人。
b2-076-s006.whyLearn: 介词短语置句首给方位，再you can see点出焦点，是看图解说的固定句式；herself强调本人。

b2-077-s006.skeleton: The operation, which lasted for over four hours, proved to be very difficult

modifiers.text: which lasted for over four hours
because of the hard resin which covered the skin.

b2-077-s006.gloss: 手术历时四小时多，因皮上硬树脂而极难进行。
b2-077-s006.whyLearn: prove to be夹在主语与补语之间，被定语从句隔开；because of后接名词短语说明难做的原因。

modifiers.text: that the mummy would fall to pieces
but fortunately this has not happened.

b2-077-s011.gloss: 他们担心切开木乃伊会碎裂，幸好并未发生。
b2-077-s011.whyLearn: fear that后接would表示当时的担忧，再用现在完成时收尾对比，担心与结果落差一目了然。

b2-078-s009.skeleton: it was more than I could bear.

modifiers.text: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette,

b2-078-s009.gloss: 老友布赖恩劝我接烟时，我实在受不住了。
b2-078-s009.whyLearn: more than I could bear 是好用的忍无可忍句型；urge sb to do 引出劝说，主句再说反应。

b2-079-s003.skeleton: An airhostess would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.
b2-079-s003.gloss: 会有空乘照管我，我从未遇到不快的经历。
b2-079-s003.whyLearn: would在此表示过去习惯做法，take charge of交代由谁负责；后半句用never加过去式概括长期经验。

b2-079-s004.skeleton: I am used to travelling by air

modifiers.text: and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.

b2-079-s004.gloss: 我习惯坐飞机，只有一次感到害怕。
b2-079-s004.whyLearn: be used to doing 与 used to do 易混，靠by air讲清习惯义；only置句首引起部分倒装。

b2-080-s003.skeleton: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
b2-080-s003.gloss: 它曾是史上最大的建筑之一，各国来客纷纷参观。
b2-080-s003.whyLearn: one of the biggest 是最高级常用框架，后接并列句用came to see交代结果，修饰语都可替换。

b2-080-s011.skeleton: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world

modifiers.text: until it was burnt down in 1936.

b2-080-s011.gloss: 它一直是世界最著名的建筑之一，1936年才被烧毁。
b2-080-s011.whyLearn: remain加最高级名词说明状态延续，until从句点出终止时刻，讲地方的兴衰可直接照搬。

b2-081-s001.skeleton: the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.

modifiers.text: When he had killed the guard,

b2-081-s001.gloss: 杀掉卫兵后，战俘迅速把他拖进灌木丛。
b2-081-s001.whyLearn: 主句用一般过去时推进，when从句用过去完成时交代更早的动作，一句理清先后层次。

b2-081-s004.skeleton: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
b2-081-s004.gloss: 他能听见营地里传来的喊声。
b2-081-s004.whyLearn: hear shouting 用动名词表示听见正在进行的声响，itself 强调就在营地内。

b2-081-s008.skeleton: the driver of the car came towards him.
b2-081-s008.gloss: 等他们走后，汽车司机朝他走来。
b2-081-s008.whyLearn: 与同课前句呼应：had gone表示先发生的动作，主句came towards him接续，of the car限定身份。

b2-084-s010.skeleton: The students are going to take the test
b2-084-s010.gloss: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。
b2-084-s010.whyLearn: be going to 表计划安排，'in + 一段时间' 表将来时点，可替换 take the test 与两天这个期限。

modifiers.text: that the day before his retirement, Mr Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
for a total of forty years.

b2-085-s006.gloss: 佩奇先生退休前一天，教龄正好满四十年。
b2-085-s006.whyLearn: will have been doing 表示到将来某时已持续多久，that 从句里再嵌时间状语，是分层表达时间的范本。

b2-087-s003.skeleton: Do you always catch such an early train ?
b2-087-s003.gloss: 你总是赶这么早的一班火车吗？
b2-087-s003.whyLearn: 一般疑问句用 Do+主语+动词原形，频度副词 always 放在实义动词前，such an early train 可换成任意名词短语。

modifiers.text: that I was there on time.

b2-087-s008.gloss: 我的雇主会证明我准时到了。
b2-087-s008.whyLearn: will confirm that... 用宾语从句转述证明内容，on time 强调不迟不早，与 in time 的'及时'不同。

modifiers.text: but I never catch a later train.

b2-087-s011.gloss: 我想是这样，但我从不坐更晚的火车。
b2-087-s011.whyLearn: but 连接两个对等分句，I suppose 后省略重复内容，never 表一贯习惯，口语中很常见。

b2-087-s012.skeleton: At what time did you arrive
b2-087-s012.gloss: 你是什么时候到车站的？
b2-087-s012.whyLearn: 疑问词前加介词 At what time 提问具体时点，did+主语+动词原形构成过去时特殊疑问句。

b2-088-s004.skeleton: vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
b2-088-s004.gloss: 若使用炸药，震动会使矿顶坍塌。
b2-088-s004.whyLearn: 条件句主将从现，从句用被动 are used；cause sth to do 里 to collapse 作宾语补足语。

modifiers.text: even if it is a bad one.

b2-089-s001.gloss: 人们为了看免费演出什么都肯做。
b2-089-s001.whyLearn: anything 后用不定式表目的，破折号引出 even if 让步补充；a free show 与 bad one 可替换成任意对象与评价。

b2-090-s001.skeleton: much of it has not yet been developed.

modifiers.text: Though Brazil is one of the richest countries in the world,

b2-090-s001.gloss: 虽然巴西是世界上最富的国家之一，但大部分尚未开发。
b2-090-s001.whyLearn: Though 引导让步从句，主句用现在完成时被动强调至今仍未开发；one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词是固定说法。

b2-090-s006.skeleton: Children do not have to cross busy streets
b2-090-s006.gloss: 孩子们不必穿过繁忙的街道去上学。
b2-090-s006.whyLearn: do not have to 表'不必'，与 mustn't 的'禁止'形成对比；句末不定式表目的。

modifiers.text: which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force Station nearby.

b2-091-s001.gloss: 飞行员注意到一个气球正飞向附近空军基地。
b2-091-s001.whyLearn: which 引导定语从句修饰 balloon，seem to be doing 表当时正在进行的推测，可替换主句动词与从句内容。

b2-091-s006.skeleton: He could make out three men in a basket under it

modifiers.text: and one of them was holding field-glasses.

b2-091-s006.gloss: 他辨出下面篮子里有三个人，其中一个拿着望远镜。
b2-091-s006.whyLearn: could make out 表勉强辨认，and 连接的第二个分句用过去进行时描写当时正在发生的动作。

b2-091-s007.skeleton: the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.

modifiers.text: When the balloon was over the station,

b2-091-s007.gloss: 气球飞到基地上空时，飞行员看见有人在拍照。
b2-091-s007.whyLearn: see sb doing 用现在分词作宾语补足语，强调看见动作正在进行；when 从句先交代时间背景。

modifiers.text: when a sarcastic voice below said,
' I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.
at this time of the night.

b2-092-s003.gloss: 我快到那里时，下面有人讽刺地开了口。
b2-092-s003.whyLearn: be almost there 表'快到了'，when 从句突然引出新事件；引号内 I don't think 是英语常见的否定转移。

b2-092-s006.gloss: 我也一样，警察用同样的语气答道。
b2-092-s006.whyLearn: So do I 用倒装表示'我也是'；引语前置时 answered the policeman 保持主谓不倒装，是叙事文的常见语序。

b2-094-s002.skeleton: children become expert at holding their breath under water

modifiers.text: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles,

b2-094-s002.gloss: 洛杉矶泳池里孩子先学水下憋气再学走路
b2-094-s002.whyLearn: become expert at doing 表擅长做某事，even before 把时间推到走路之前，可替换地点与能力短语

modifiers.text: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch,

b2-095-s001.gloss: 大使回家吃午饭时妻子吓了一跳
b2-095-s001.whyLearn: got a shock 是 get a shock 的过去式搭配，When 从句先铺时间，可替换人物与回家事由

b2-095-s022.gloss: 省略句加 don't you think 反问
b2-095-s022.whyLearn: 省略主语和系动词只留 Accurate 表赞同，don't you think 是口语插入语，可换成其他评价词

b2-095-s024.skeleton: I would not have been able to get home for lunch.
b2-095-s024.gloss: 若我当时在家就赶不回午饭了
b2-095-s024.whyLearn: 虚拟语气：If + had done 配 would not have been able to，可换 be able to 后动词

modifiers.text: for crowds of people stand on the shore watching the lanterns drifting away until they can be seen no more.

b2-096-s009.gloss: 人群立岸边看灯笼漂远直至消失
b2-096-s009.whyLearn: for 引出并列原因分句，until 加被动 can be seen 收束画面，可替换场景与人群动作

b3-002-s012.skeleton: You certainly did give me a surprise
b3-002-s012.whyLearn: did 强调谓语动词，比 You gave me a surprise 语气重，可替换动词与宾语部分

modifiers.text: and have a cup of tea

b3-002-s020.whyLearn: let's 提议句型，and 连接两个并列动作，可替换下楼与喝茶的具体内容

modifiers.text: When the archaeologists reconstructed the fragments,
that the goddess turned out to be a very modern-looking woman.

b3-003-s013.gloss: 复原碎片后众人惊觉女神竟是现代女性
b3-003-s013.whyLearn: were amazed to find 表惊讶发现，turned out to be 揭示意外结果，可替换发现内容

modifiers.text: for Alf has just found another job.

b3-004-s012.gloss: 阿尔夫的妻子始终不知道嫁了清洁工
b3-004-s012.whyLearn: has never discovered 表至今不知，she never will 承前省略，for 引出原因，可替换职业

b3-005-s003.skeleton: the editor read the first sentence

modifiers.text: and then refused to publish it

b3-005-s003.gloss: 文章到后编辑读了首句便拒绝发表
b3-005-s003.whyLearn: read 与 refused 由 and then 连成先后动作，refuse to do 表拒绝做，可替换动作对象

b3-005-s010.skeleton: the editor reluctantly published the article

modifiers.text: When the journalist again failed to reply,
as it had originally been written.

b3-005-s010.gloss: 记者未回复编辑照原稿发表文章
b3-005-s010.whyLearn: failed to reply 表未能做到，as 引出方式，had been written 过去完成被动，可替换方式

modifiers.text: when a large car, with its headlights on and its horn blaring, roared down the arcade.

b3-006-s007.gloss: 一辆大车轰鸣驶过拱廊打破寂静
b3-006-s007.whyLearn: was broken 被动突出被打断，when 从句内嵌 with 复合结构写车灯喇叭，可替换声响

b3-006-s010.gloss: 与此同时泰勒先生人在楼上
b3-006-s010.whyLearn: While 从句用过去进行时铺背景，主句 was upstairs 交代方位，可替换人物与地点

b3-006-s013.skeleton: One of the thieves was struck by a heavy statue

modifiers.text: but he was too busy helping himself to diamonds to notice any pain.

b3-006-s013.gloss: 小偷被雕像砸中却忙着抢钻石不觉痛
b3-006-s013.whyLearn: be struck by 被动，too busy doing to do 表太忙于某事而无暇，可替换无暇之事

b3-007-s005.skeleton: Doctors and nurses remained above ground

modifiers.text: in case anyone tried to leave the shelters too soon.

b3-007-s005.gloss: 医护留地面警察巡逻防人过早离避难所
b3-007-s005.whyLearn: while 表同时进行，in case 引出预防目的，tried to leave 用不定式，可换主体与对象

b3-007-s006.skeleton: The police did not have much to do

modifiers.text: because the citizens took the exercise seriously.

b3-007-s006.gloss: 市民认真演习警察因此无事可做
b3-007-s006.whyLearn: did not have much to do 否定加不定式，because 说明原因，took 加 seriously 可换主体

b3-009-s008.skeleton: scientists will be able to find out a great deal

modifiers.text: If a satellite can one day be put into orbit round Mars

b3-009-s008.gloss: 若卫星能进火星轨道，科学家就能查明许多情况
b3-009-s008.whyLearn: 条件从句里套被动与情态，主句用将来时加不定式；可替换 if 从句的主语和 be able to 后的动作。

b3-009-s010.skeleton: A rubber ball containing a radio transmitter could be dropped from a satellite

modifiers.text: so that it would fall towards the surface of the planet

b3-009-s010.gloss: 带发报机的橡皮球由卫星投下，落向行星表面
b3-009-s010.whyLearn: 分词短语作后置定语，so that 引结果从句，主干被前后包裹；可替换 ball 的定语与从句里的落点。

b3-009-s013.skeleton: will it be possible to plan a manned trip to Mars

modifiers.text: Only when a great deal more information has been obtained

b3-009-s013.gloss: 只有先取得更多资料，才可能规划载人火星之行
b3-009-s013.whyLearn: Only 加时间从句置句首引发主句倒装，是写作提分句式；可替换 obtained 的对象与 trip 的目的地。

b3-010-s005.skeleton: she would still be able to float

modifiers.text: Even if two of these were flooded

b3-010-s005.gloss: 即便有两个舱进水，她仍能浮在水上
b3-010-s005.whyLearn: even if 引让步、被动表假设，主句用 would 表虚拟结果；可替换 flooded 的部位与 float 的动作。

b3-011-s004.skeleton: a particularly officious young Customs Officer clearly regarded me as a smuggler

modifiers.text: When I returned from abroad recently

b3-011-s004.gloss: 我回国时，爱管闲事的年轻海关官员把我当走私犯
b3-011-s004.whyLearn: 时间从句先交代背景，主句连用形容词与 clearly 刻画人物；可替换 officer 前修饰语和 as 后的身份。

b3-011-s005.gloss: 海关问：你有要申报的东西吗？
b3-011-s005.whyLearn: 过关场景的固定问句，anything 用于疑问句，to declare 作后置定语；换掉 declare 即可套用到别的场合。

modifiers.text: I would never be able to close the case again

b3-011-s012.gloss: 我觉得再也没法把箱子合上了
b3-011-s012.whyLearn: felt sure 后省略 that 的宾语从句，would never 表过去将来的否定判断；可替换从句里的动作。

b3-012-s004.skeleton: Ripe fruit falls from the trees
b3-012-s004.gloss: 熟果自落，你根本无须劳作
b3-012-s004.whyLearn: and 并列两个一般现在时小句，对比田园幻想与闲适生活；可替换 fruit 与 work 的具体内容。

b3-012-s007.skeleton: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe

modifiers.text: waiting for a boat which never comes

b3-012-s007.gloss: 你要么饿死，要么像鲁滨逊苦等不来的船
b3-012-s007.whyLearn: either...or 并列两种命运，句末分词短语内嵌定语从句补细节；可替换 or 后的比喻和 boat 的修饰。

modifiers.text: When a passing tanker rescued them five days later

b3-012-s017.gloss: 五天后过路油轮救起二人，他们竟真舍不得走
b3-012-s017.whyLearn: 时间从句与 sorry that 从句并置，写出获救却留恋的矛盾；可替换 sorry 后交代的原因内容。

modifiers.text: When Mrs Richards walked towards him

b3-013-s016.gloss: 理查兹太太走近他时，他摔门而逃
b3-013-s016.whyLearn: 主干只有 he fled，靠时间从句交代起因、分词短语补动作；可替换 fled 与 slamming 的宾语。

b3-015-s004.skeleton: they rattle for months inside money-boxes

modifiers.text: If sixpences are not exchanged for sweets

b3-015-s004.gloss: 六便士不换成糖，便在钱箱里响上几个月
b3-015-s004.whyLearn: 条件从句用被动否定，主句以一般现在时表习惯结果；可替换 exchanged for 的对象与响声的地点。

modifiers.text: When Dimitri came in from the fields

b3-016-s006.gloss: 季米特里从田里回来，妻子讲了出的事
b3-016-s006.whyLearn: 时间从句加 tell 双宾语，what 从句作直接宾语并用过去完成时；可替换间接宾语与从句内容。

modifiers.text: he had better return it or he would call the police

b3-016-s011.gloss: 他叫他最好归还，否则就报警
b3-016-s011.whyLearn: told 后省略 that 的宾语从句里套 or 并列警告，had better 与 would 同现；可替换归还的动作。

b3-016-s016.skeleton: he was astonished to find that the little black lamb was almost white

modifiers.text: When he went outside half an hour later
that the little black lamb was almost white

b3-016-s016.gloss: 半小时后出门，他惊讶地发现黑羔羊几乎全白
b3-016-s016.whyLearn: 时间从句铺场景，be astonished to find 加 that 从句写出反差；可替换 astonished 的情感词与从句内容。

b3-018-s008.skeleton: The first thing I saw when I entered the art gallery was a notice

modifiers.text: when I entered the art gallery
which said: 'Do not touch the exhibits.

b3-018-s008.gloss: 进门首先看到的告示写着请勿触摸展品
b3-018-s008.whyLearn: 主语带省略关系词的定语从句，表语后 which 从句引告示内容；可替换 notice 的定语与引语。

b3-020-s015.skeleton: the first person to greet him was a local policeman
b3-020-s015.gloss: 他降落多佛附近，首先迎接他的是当地警察。
b3-020-s015.whyLearn: 范句：主干 the first person…was a policeman 可套用，when 从句置首交代背景。

b3-021-s003.gloss: 因此，他们被称为“职业拳击手”。
b3-021-s003.whyLearn: 范句：be known as 表被称为，称号 prize-fighters 可换成任意头衔。

b3-021-s005.skeleton: One of the most colourful figures in boxing history was Daniel Mendoza
b3-021-s005.gloss: 拳击史上最传奇人物之一是1764年出生的门多萨。
b3-021-s005.whyLearn: 范句：One of the most…was 句式记牢，主语 figures 与表语人名可换。

b3-022-s003.skeleton: One would expect them to know their parts by heart

modifiers.text: to know their parts by heart
and never have cause to falter

b3-022-s003.gloss: 人们以为他们会背熟台词，从不结巴。
b3-022-s003.whyLearn: 范句：expect sb to do 后接并列不定式，by heart、have cause to 可换。

b3-023-s002.skeleton: you would consider octopus a great delicacy

modifiers.text: If you lived in the Mediterranean

b3-023-s002.gloss: 若住地中海，你会觉得章鱼是美味。
b3-023-s002.whyLearn: 范句：虚拟条件句配 would，consider sth a delicacy 可换宾语与补语。

b3-023-s020.skeleton: I have never been able to look at a snail
b3-023-s020.gloss: 从那以后，我再没法看蜗牛一眼。
b3-023-s020.whyLearn: 范句：have never been able to do 表一直不能，since then 可换时间。

b3-024-s011.skeleton: I once spent an uncomfortable week-end
b3-024-s011.gloss: 我在他家度过一个难忘的不舒服周末。
b3-024-s011.whyLearn: 定语从句把 spent 与 at his house 拆开，读时须还原主干加地点。

b3-025-s011.skeleton: It seemed certain that she would be the first ship home

modifiers.text: that she would be the first ship home
but during the race she had a lot of bad luck

b3-025-s011.gloss: 她看似稳拿第一艘归航，赛中却运气很差。
b3-025-s011.whyLearn: 范句：It seemed certain that… 表推测，but 后转折句与 a lot of 可换。

b3-025-s016.skeleton: the Cutty Sark lost her lead
b3-025-s016.gloss: 因此，卡蒂萨克号失去了领先位置。
b3-025-s016.whyLearn: 范句：Because of this 承接上文，her 指船，是拟人化的所属表达。

b3-026-s009.skeleton: a company of biscuit manufacturers once asked listeners to bake biscuits and send them to their factory

modifiers.text: to bake biscuits and send them to their factory
and send them to their factory

b3-026-s009.gloss: 电台节目里，饼干厂商请听众烤饼干寄回厂。
b3-026-s009.whyLearn: 范句：ask sb to do 后接并列不定式，第二个动作共享 to。

b3-026-s018.skeleton: It seemed certain that this would win the prize

modifiers.text: that this would win the prize

b3-026-s018.gloss: 看来这必定会赢得大奖。
b3-026-s018.whyLearn: 范句：It seemed certain that… 后可换任意 would 从句，表当时确信。

b3-027-s007.skeleton: Tramps seem to be the only exception
b3-027-s007.gloss: 流浪汉似乎是这条通则的唯一例外。
b3-027-s007.whyLearn: 范句：seem to be 表推测，the only exception to 后可换名词。

b3-027-s011.skeleton: they do not sacrifice their human dignity
b3-027-s011.gloss: 他们在争取独立时，并不牺牲人的尊严。
b3-027-s011.whyLearn: 范句：In doing sth 表在做某事时，主句 do not sacrifice 可换动词。

b3-027-s012.skeleton: A tramp may ask you for money

modifiers.text: but he will never ask you to feel sorry for him

b3-027-s012.gloss: 流浪汉可能向你要钱，却绝不求你可怜他。
b3-027-s012.whyLearn: 范句：may…but will never… 对比句式，ask sb for sth 与 ask sb to do 并用。

b3-028-s004.skeleton: Many of the tourists on board had begun bargaining with the tradesmen

modifiers.text: but I decided not to buy anything until I had disembarked

b3-028-s004.gloss: 船上游客已开始与商人砍价，我决定下船再买。
b3-028-s004.whyLearn: but 前后时态对比：had begun 与 decided；until 从句用过去完成时。

b3-028-s012.skeleton: I examined one of the pens closely
b3-028-s012.gloss: 我仔细检查了其中一支钢笔。
b3-028-s012.whyLearn: 练 one of the + 复数名词作宾语，方式副词 closely 置句末。

b1-026-s009.gloss: 六月到八月天总是很热
b1-026-s009.whyLearn: It's + 天气形容词 + in + 月份，是谈论天气最基础的句型；并列最后一项前才加 and。

b1-026-s011.whyLearn: 选择疑问句用 or 连接两个形容词，不能用 yes / no 回答；in autumn 点明季节。

b1-026-s012.gloss: 九月和十月总是温暖的
b1-026-s012.whyLearn: 同一句型换季节，always 放在 be 动词之后；两个月份用 and 连接，无需逗号。

b1-026-s013.gloss: 十一月常冷，有时还下雨
b1-026-s013.whyLearn: 两个独立分句用 and 连接，often 在前句、sometimes 在后句，可见频率副词位置灵活。

b1-026-s014.whyLearn: 一般疑问句把 is 提到主语前；very 加强 cold 的程度，答语用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it isn't.

b1-026-s015.gloss: 十二月到二月常常很冷
b1-026-s015.whyLearn: 三个月份并列：前两项用逗号隔开，最后一项前加 and，是英语列举的固定写法。

b1-027-s003.gloss: 问对方国家的气候如何
b1-027-s003.whyLearn: What's the climate like...? 是问气候的固定句式，like 在这里是介词，不是动词“喜欢”。

b1-027-s004.gloss: 气候温和，但并非总是宜人
b1-027-s004.whyLearn: but 连接的转折并列句；not always 是部分否定，意为“并非总是”，不等于 always not。

b1-027-s005.whyLearn: 并列句第二分句省略重复的 It's often，只留形容词 + 介词短语，是英语避免重复的常用手段。

modifiers.text: and sometimes warm in the South

b1-027-s006.gloss: 西部常潮湿，南部有时温暖
b1-027-s006.whyLearn: and 后省略 It's often，让 wet in the West 与 warm in the South 对称。

b1-027-s008.whyLearn: like 后直接接名词，一般现在时表示长期的喜好；两个季节用 and 并列作宾语。

b1-027-s009.whyLearn: 两个分句结构完全对称，都用一般现在时陈述客观规律，and 连接后形成鲜明对比。

b1-027-s010.gloss: 太阳升起得早，落下得晚
b1-027-s010.whyLearn: 两个谓语共用一个主语 The sun，and 后省略主语；第三人称单数动词要加 -s。

b1-027-s012.whyLearn: 只对调上一句的 long 和 short 两个形容词，句式不变就能写出相反季节。

b1-027-s013.whyLearn: 把 early 和 late 互换就得到冬季日照的描写，可见这对副词常成对出现在同一句里。

b1-027-s014.skeleton: Our climate is not very good
b1-027-s014.gloss: 气候不太好，但确实有趣
b1-027-s014.whyLearn: not very good 是弱化的否定，听起来客气；but 后用 certainly 加强语气，结尾含英式幽默。

b3-028-s018.skeleton: The man said that the pen was worth &10

modifiers.text: he would let me have it for &8

b3-028-s018.gloss: 他先说笔值十镑，又改口八镑卖我。
b3-028-s018.whyLearn: that 宾语从句与 but 后 would 过去将来形成砍价对比；价格和 favour 都可替换。

modifiers.text: as if he found my offer outrageous
but he eventually reduced the price to &3

b3-028-s020.gloss: 他先夸张抗议，最后还是降到三镑。
b3-028-s020.whyLearn: 句首 Gesticulating 分词作状语，as if 引出方式从句；outrageous 与 &3 都能换词替换。

b3-029-s022.skeleton: he enjoyed himself thoroughly and kept telling everybody
b3-029-s022.gloss: 他乐在其中，还总说自己讨厌医院。
b3-029-s022.whyLearn: enjoyed himself 与 kept telling 并列，how much 从句可换；hospitals 可替换。

modifiers.text: that there might be someone else on the farm who had never been seen

b3-030-s009.gloss: 谁也没想到农场还藏着个从未露面的人。
b3-030-s009.whyLearn: No one 否定主语，suspected 后接 that 从句，再套 who 定语从句与被动完成。

b3-030-s022.gloss: 父亲去世后，他们决定把埃里克藏起来。
b3-030-s022.whyLearn: 形式宾语 it + their duty + 不定式；When 从句可换 After；Eric、duty 可替换。

b3-031-s001.skeleton: True eccentrics never deliberately set out
b3-031-s001.gloss: 真正的怪人从不刻意引人注目。
b3-031-s001.whyLearn: never 与 deliberately 夹在 set out to do 中间表否定强调；主语与 draw attention 均可替换。

b3-031-s004.skeleton: Richard Colson was one of the most notable figures

modifiers.text: Up to the time of his death

b3-031-s004.gloss: 理查德·科尔森生前是镇上最出名的人物之一。
b3-031-s004.whyLearn: one of the most + 复数名词表最高级之一；Up to the time of 可换 Until，town 可替换。

b3-031-s009.skeleton: he refused to carry an umbrella

modifiers.text: Even when it was raining heavily

b3-031-s009.gloss: 哪怕下着大雨，他也拒绝打伞。
b3-031-s009.whyLearn: Even when 让步时间从句用过去进行时铺垫，主句 refuse to do；heavily、umbrella 可替换。

b3-031-s016.skeleton: he presented the assistant with the cloth bag

modifiers.text: When Dickie was given the fur coat

b3-031-s016.gloss: 迪基拿到皮大衣后，把布袋递给了店员。
b3-031-s016.whyLearn: when 从句用被动，主句 present sb with sth；the fur coat 与 bag 可整体替换。

b3-033-s002.skeleton: everything seems to get out of control

modifiers.text: A day may begin well enough

b3-033-s002.gloss: 一天开头也许顺利，转眼就失控。
b3-033-s002.whyLearn: may 表可能 + seem to do，but 一转；well enough 与 out of control 可换成别的状态说法。

modifiers.text: that a great number of things choose to go wrong at precisely the same moment

b3-033-s003.gloss: 偏偏总有一堆事在同一刻出错。
b3-033-s003.whyLearn: What 主语从句 + is that 表语从句的双从句框架；a great number of 与 moment 可替换。

modifiers.text: as if a single unimportant event set up a chain of reactions

b3-033-s004.gloss: 仿佛一件小事就引发了连锁反应。
b3-033-s004.whyLearn: It is as if 固定框架，从句用一般过去时表虚拟；event 和 chain of reactions 可替换。

b3-033-s007.skeleton: the baby pulls the table-cloth off the table

modifiers.text: While you are on the phone
smashing half your best crockery and cutting himself in the process

b3-033-s007.gloss: 你打电话时，宝宝把桌布拉下砸了杯盘。
b3-033-s007.whyLearn: while 从句衬托主句，句尾两个 -ing 分词并列补充结果；table-cloth、crockery 可替换。

modifiers.text: As he had never been there before

b3-034-s012.gloss: 他初来乍到，觉得样样都有趣。
b3-034-s012.whyLearn: As 原因从句用过去完成时先说，主句 a great deal to do 表可看之物；there、him 可换。

modifiers.text: when he noticed a large packing-case lying on the floor

b3-034-s013.gloss: 上午飞逝，弗兰克正要走时发现地板上有只大箱子。
b3-034-s013.whyLearn: be about to do ... when 表正要做时突然；lying 分词后置修饰 packing-case，可换别的名词。

b3-035-s004.skeleton: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey and can never be sure
b3-035-s004.gloss: 追寻它的人要历尽艰辛，还未必找得到。
b3-035-s004.whyLearn: Those who 定语从句作主语，后接并列谓语 undertake 与 can never be sure；journey 可替换。

b3-035-s012.skeleton: a girl heard a muffled cry

modifiers.text: coming from behind one of the walls

b3-035-s012.gloss: 中午时分，一个女孩听见墙后传来闷闷的哭声
b3-035-s012.whyLearn: come from 用现在分词作后置定语，比定语从句轻；a girl、muffled cry 和墙的位置都可替换

b3-036-s008.skeleton: he stopped to talk to a workman

modifiers.text: While on a walking tour with his wife

b3-036-s008.gloss: 陪妻子徒步游览时，他停下来跟一个工人攀谈
b3-036-s008.whyLearn: While 后省略 he was，状语从句压缩成短语；stopped to do 表停下来去做，workman 可换任何对象

b3-036-s013.skeleton: Hans explained how it was that he was still alive
b3-036-s013.gloss: 兄弟重逢后，汉斯说明自己何以还活着
b3-036-s013.whyLearn: how it was that 是比 why 更委婉的强调说法，把原因藏进从句；主语和 was 后的内容可替换

modifiers.text: Ships may be delayed by storms
air flights may be cancelled because of bad weather

b3-037-s003.gloss: 船可能因风暴误点，航班可能因天气取消，火车却必须准点
b3-037-s003.whyLearn: 三个分句对照三种交通，may be done 表可能被，must 表必须，末句转折是点睛，主语原因均可替换

modifiers.text: that when mistakesoccur, they are more likely to be ours than theirs

b3-037-s006.gloss: 实情是出错时，多半是我们的错
b3-037-s006.whyLearn: be more likely to be A than B 是现成的比较句式，that 引表语从句，可把 ours、theirs 换成别的人或物

modifiers.text: when the train stopped at Widley
a tiny station a few miles along the line

b3-037-s012.gloss: 火车停靠威德利小站，我一点也不惊讶
b3-037-s012.whyLearn: Neither 置于句首引起倒装，语气强于 nor；Widley 后用同位语补出小站细节，两处名词都能整块替换

modifiers.text: when the train dawdled at station after station

b3-037-s014.gloss: 可火车一站一站地磨蹭，我开始纳闷
b3-037-s014.whyLearn: station after station 靠重复名词表接连不断，begin to do 表动作起点，两个槽位换成别的场景照样成立

modifiers.text: if this was the Westhaven Express
but he had not even heard of it

b3-037-s017.gloss: 我问一位乘客这是不是西黑文快车，他竟没听说过
b3-037-s017.whyLearn: if 在此引宾语从句表是否，别与条件句混；not even 加重否定，hear of 是听说，问话内容可替换

b3-038-s007.skeleton: He has to deduce what he can

modifiers.text: from the few scanty clues available

b3-038-s007.gloss: 他只能就手头寥寥无几的线索去推断
b3-038-s007.whyLearn: have to 表客观必须，what he can 是名词性从句作宾语，available 后置修饰 clues，线索类名词可替换

b3-038-s010.skeleton: Recent scientific evidence seems to indicate
b3-038-s010.gloss: 最新科学证据似乎表明这一假设并不成立
b3-038-s010.whyLearn: seem to do 表推测而非断言，比 It seems that 更紧凑；evidence 与 assumption 可换成别的论据与结论

modifiers.text: that man was making a real effort to understand the seasons 20,000 years earlier than has been supposed
20,000 years earlier than has been supposed

b3-038-s020.gloss: 看来两万年前人类就已认真探究季节
b3-038-s020.whyLearn: than has been supposed 后省略 it，是完成时被动的比较从句；was making 表当时持续，时间与动词都可替换

b3-039-s002.skeleton: Bruce was not in the least perturbed

modifiers.text: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes

b3-039-s002.gloss: 尽管路上乱石成堆、坑坑洼洼，布鲁斯毫不在意
b3-039-s002.whyLearn: Even though 先让一步，从句内两个被动语态并列，主句 not in the least 表毫不，形容词可替换

modifiers.text: why university students seem to enjoy pract

b3-040-s001.gloss: 始终无人解释大学生为何爱搞这一套
b3-040-s001.whyLearn: It 是形式主语，真正主语是 why 从句；现在完成被动 has been explained 表至今没人解释，从句内容可替换

b3-040-s008.skeleton: The student hid in an archway nearby

modifiers.text: where he could watch and hear everything that went on

b3-040-s008.gloss: 学生躲在附近的拱门里，能看清听到一切动静
b3-040-s008.whyLearn: where 引地点状语从句，从句内再套 that went on 定语从句；could 表当时能，地点与动词可替换

b3-040-s010.skeleton: he threatened to remove them by force

modifiers.text: When he received a very rude reply from one of the workmen

b3-040-s010.gloss: 工人出言不逊，他扬言强行赶走他们。
b3-040-s010.whyLearn: when 从句置首交代起因，主句用 threatened to do 表威胁意图；from one of 点明来源，可整句背。

b3-041-s012.skeleton: They could be saved so much misery and expense

modifiers.text: if they chose to live in the city where they rightly belong
to live in the city where they rightly belong

b3-041-s012.gloss: 若肯住进城，本可省去许多痛苦花费。
b3-041-s012.whyLearn: could be saved 后接双宾语属易错被动；if 从句里嵌 where 定语从句，多层嵌套值得整句背。

b3-041-s017.gloss: 对他们来说这是件大工程。
b3-041-s017.whyLearn: For them 置句首点明视角，which 从句补充说明 operation，是主系表加定语从句的干净范本。

b3-041-s019.skeleton: The city dweller never experiences anxieties
b3-041-s019.gloss: 城里人从没有这类焦虑。
b3-041-s019.whyLearn: never 加实义动词构成否定，dweller 式名词化表达地道；of this sort 后置限定，可换成 of that kind。

b3-042-s015.skeleton: The cave might never have been discovered

modifiers.text: had not the entrance been spotted by the distinguished French potholer, Berger
by the distinguished French potholer, Berger

b3-042-s015.gloss: 若不是入口被发现，洞穴永不会被发现。
b3-042-s015.whyLearn: 省略 if 的虚拟条件倒装 had not the entrance been spotted 是本句最大难点，主句为情态被动完成。

b3-043-s008.skeleton: It had been purchased by a local authority

modifiers.text: so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair

b3-043-s008.gloss: 地方当局买下它，为年度集市烤大馅饼。
b3-043-s008.whyLearn: so that 引出目的状语从句，配 could be baked 被动；过去完成加被动双重标记常考，可整句背。

b3-043-s021.skeleton: they fixed heavy metal clamps to both sides of the dish

modifiers.text: to both sides of the dish
so that they could fasten the chains

b3-043-s021.gloss: 这次他们在盘两侧装铁夹，好拴链子。
b3-043-s021.whyLearn: fix sth to sth 是固定搭配，so that 从句用 could 表目的，与主句主语一致时可改写为 so as to。

b3-043-s022.skeleton: The dish now had to be lifted vertically

modifiers.text: because one edge was resting against the side of the canal
against the side of the canal

b3-043-s022.gloss: 因一边抵着运河壁，盘子得垂直吊起。
b3-043-s022.whyLearn: had to be lifted 是情态动词加被动不定式的叠加；because 从句用过去进行时写当时状态，时态对比值得学。

b3-044-s007.skeleton: you rarely manage to do so

modifiers.text: when you really wish to go to sleep

b3-044-s007.gloss: 夜里想睡时，你反而难以入睡。
b3-044-s007.whyLearn: when 从句插在主语后作补充时间说明；manage to do so 用 so 回指前文避免重复，是很实用的替换手段。

b3-044-s014.skeleton: no form of transport could be worse

modifiers.text: If it is not, and you are likely to get sea-sick

b3-044-s014.gloss: 若非如此又易晕船，没有更糟的交通方式。
b3-044-s014.whyLearn: if 从句并列两个谓语，be likely to do 表可能性；主句 no 加比较级实为最高级，是地道的否定强调。

b3-044-s015.skeleton: sea journeys take a long time

modifiers.text: Even if you travel in ideal weather

b3-044-s015.gloss: 即便天气理想，海上旅行也很费时。
b3-044-s015.whyLearn: even if 把条件推到极端作让步，主句仍用一般现在时陈述事实；take a long time 是时间花费固定表达。

b3-044-s021.skeleton: You do not have to deviseways

modifiers.text: of taking your mind off the journey
for an aeroplane gets you to your destination rapidly

b3-044-s021.gloss: 你不必想法子打发旅途，飞机很快到。
b3-044-s021.whyLearn: do not have to 表不必，与 mustn't 有别；介词 of 后接 -ing 短语，for 引出原因并列句，层次清晰。

b3-045-s011.skeleton: the fact would have passed unnoticed

modifiers.text: If they had only had one more child

b3-045-s011.gloss: 若他们多一个孩子，这事就不会被注意。
b3-045-s011.whyLearn: 与过去相反的虚拟：if 从句 had done，主句 would have done；pass unnoticed 是动词加形容词补语。

modifiers.text: that their husbands are infinitely resourceful and versatile

b3-046-s008.gloss: 妻子总以为丈夫无所不能
b3-046-s008.whyLearn: tend to 让断言留有余地，resourceful and versatile 可换成任意褒义词

b3-046-s014.skeleton: It had broken down the previous summer

modifiers.text: and though I promised to repair it, I had never got round to it
though I promised to repair it

b3-046-s014.gloss: 车夏天就坏了，我答应修却一直没修
b3-046-s014.whyLearn: get round to 表总算腾出空去做，though 让步句嵌在并列结构里

b3-046-s022.skeleton: One of the links in the chain that drives the wheels had snapped

modifiers.text: of the links in the chain that drives the wheels
in the chain that drives the wheels

b3-046-s022.gloss: 链条上带动车轮的一节断了
b3-046-s022.whyLearn: one of + 复数名词后接定语从句，谓语仍用单数 had snapped

b3-048-s008.skeleton: This was more than we could bear

modifiers.text: so we decided to spend our last day exploring the countryside
to spend our last day exploring the countryside

b3-048-s008.gloss: 这我们再也受不了，决定最后一天去乡间
b3-048-s008.whyLearn: more than sb could bear 表忍无可忍，so 引出随之而来的决定

modifiers.text: that the path continued on the other side
but we had no idea how we could get across the stream
how we could get across the stream

b3-048-s012.gloss: 我们看见对岸有路，却不知怎么过溪
b3-048-s012.whyLearn: have no idea how... 表毫无头绪，比 don't know 更口语

modifiers.text: that my wife seemed to be filled with alarm

b3-048-s022.gloss: 我忽然发现妻子满脸惊恐
b3-048-s022.whyLearn: seem to be done 把被动塞进 seem 后，All at once 表突然

b3-048-s026.skeleton: we were followed by a silent procession of children

modifiers.text: When we later walked down the main street of the village
down the main street of the village
by a silent procession of children

b3-048-s026.gloss: 我们走过村中大街，身后跟着一队沉默的孩子
b3-048-s026.whyLearn: be followed by 表被人跟在身后，procession of 可换 stream of

modifiers.text: my aunt Harriet died years ago

b3-049-s001.gloss: 幸好哈里特姑妈多年前就去世了
b3-049-s001.whyLearn: It is a good thing (that) 省 that 接从句，可套 other 评述句

modifiers.text: because our schemes are too ambitious and we never have time to carry them out
and we never have time to carry them out

b3-050-s007.gloss: 我们想自我改进，却常因计划过大而失败
b3-050-s007.whyLearn: because 后并列两个分句说明原因，too ambitious 与 no time 呼应

b3-051-s001.skeleton: One of the greatest advances in modern technology has been the inventi

modifiers.text: of the greatest advances in modern technology

b3-051-s001.gloss: 现代技术最大的进步之一是这项发明
b3-051-s001.whyLearn: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数 has been

b3-051-s004.skeleton: They can solve the most complex mathematical problems

modifiers.text: or putthousands of unrelated facts in order

b3-051-s004.gloss: 它们能解最难的数学题，也能归类无数事实
b3-051-s004.whyLearn: can 后接 solve 与 put 两个并列谓语，the most 表最高级

b3-051-s007.skeleton: they save research workers years of hard work

modifiers.text: Because they work accurately and at high speeds

b3-051-s007.gloss: 因又快又准，它们替研究者省下多年苦功
b3-051-s007.whyLearn: save sb sth 双宾语结构，Because 从句点明省下苦功的原因

b3-051-s014.skeleton: They can never, as it were, lead independent lives

modifiers.text: or 'rule the world' by making decisions of their own
by making decisions of their own

b3-051-s014.gloss: 它们不能独立生活，一切由人替它决定
b3-051-s014.whyLearn: as it were 作插入语表「可以说」，by + doing 说明方式

modifiers.text: who do not share a common language
to talk to each other without any difficulty or to read foreign publications

b3-051-s020.gloss: 这能让语言不通的人轻松交谈、读外文
b3-051-s020.whyLearn: enable sb to do 后带两个并列不定式，定语从句隔开宾语与 to do

modifiers.text: If you were to ask Harry what was in the bottle
to ask Harry what was in the bottle

b3-052-s003.gloss: 你若问瓶里是什么，他会说是香泥
b3-052-s003.whyLearn: 与现在相反的虚拟：if + were to do，主句 would + 动词原形

modifiers.text: If you expressed doubt or surprise
to smell it and then to rub some into your skin
and then to rub some into your skin

b3-052-s004.gloss: 你若露出怀疑或惊讶，他就请你去闻
b3-052-s004.whyLearn: invite sb to do 带两个并列不定式，if 从句用过去式表假设

b3-052-s012.skeleton: he would pretend to be considerably put out

modifiers.text: If a shop girl told him she had not heard of it
she had not heard of it

b3-052-s012.gloss: 店员说没听过，他就装出很生气的样子
b3-052-s012.whyLearn: would pretend to be + 形容词是假装某状态的框架，put out 可换 pleased、surprised

b3-052-s021.skeleton: the girl promised to order some for him

modifiers.text: When Harry put on his act of being mildly annoyed

b3-052-s021.gloss: 哈里一装出微恼的样子，女孩就答应替他订
b3-052-s021.whyLearn: put on his act of being + 形容词表装样子，annoyed 可换 pleased、busy

b3-052-s026.skeleton: He picked up what seemed to be the smallest bottle

modifiers.text: what seemed to be the smallest bottle

b3-052-s026.gloss: 他拿起最小的瓶子，低声问价钱
b3-052-s026.whyLearn: pick up 可换 take、grab，the smallest bottle 与 the price 都是可换的槽位

b3-053-s016.skeleton: the Ombudsman will act on his behalf

modifiers.text: If a citizen's complaint is justified

b3-053-s016.gloss: 投诉若属实，监察官就代他出面
b3-053-s016.whyLearn: on one's behalf 是代人出面的固定说法，complaint、Ombudsman 都可换

modifiers.text: especially when we find that, like the praying mantis, they lead perfectly horrible lives

b3-054-s011.gloss: 我们爱读它们，尤其发现它们活得极惨时
b3-054-s011.whyLearn: enjoy doing 表一贯爱好，them 与 horrible 都是可替换的槽位，语气随之变

b3-055-s015.skeleton: One of the most likely stars is Tau Ceti

modifiers.text: which is eleven light years away

b3-055-s015.gloss: 最可能的星之一是十一光年外的天仓五
b3-055-s015.whyLearn: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，换 stars 与 Tau Ceti 就能介绍别的候选

b3-055-s018.skeleton: astronomers would not be able to rely on language

modifiers.text: Even if contact were eventually established

b3-055-s018.gloss: 即便联系上了，天文学家也无法靠语言交流
b3-055-s018.whyLearn: Even if + 虚拟条件配 would not be able to，language 与 beings 可换成别的手段

modifiers.text: as our climate seldom god to extremes

b3-056-s011.gloss: 这很少见，因为本地气候不常走极端
b3-056-s011.whyLearn: as 引原因比 because 轻，our climate 与 rare 都可换成别的主语与评价

b3-056-s015.skeleton: We were, however, worried about our nearest neighbours

modifiers.text: who were newcomers to the district

b3-056-s015.gloss: 我们却担心最近的邻居，农场低洼又是新来的
b3-056-s015.whyLearn: however 插在 be 动词后表转折，两个 whose/who 从句可换成任意背景说明

modifiers.text: when my father had taken me abroad
and that was eighteen years ago

b3-057-s003.gloss: 父亲带我出国时我才五岁，那是十八年前
b3-057-s003.whyLearn: was only five when... 是回忆往事的起手式，年龄与事件都可替换

b3-057-s004.skeleton: he did not quickly recover from the shock and loneliness

modifiers.text: When my mother had died after a tragic accident

b3-057-s004.gloss: 母亲死于一场事故后，他久久没走出伤痛
b3-057-s004.whyLearn: recover from + 打击类名词，shock、loneliness 可换 loss、grief 等

b3-057-s019.skeleton: I could see no valley, no farms, no cottages and no church spire

modifiers.text: no valley, no farms, no cottages and no church spire

b3-057-s019.gloss: 山谷农舍尖顶全不见，只有一片湖
b3-057-s019.whyLearn: no A, no B, no C 层层堆叠造出荒凉感，名词可全换成别的景物

b3-057-s024.skeleton: I felt as if I had stumbled into a nightmare country

modifiers.text: as if I had stumbled into a nightmare country
as you sometimes do in dreams

b3-057-s024.gloss: 我觉得像跌进了梦魇之地，梦里常有的事
b3-057-s024.whyLearn: felt as if + 过去完成时写虚幻感，nightmare country 可换任何诡异场景

b3-057-s032.gloss: 村子已因水淹不复存在，山谷也一样
b3-057-s032.whyLearn: no longer 配过去完成时被动，讲旧景消失；主语与 submerged 均可替换

b3-059-s001.whyLearn: tend to do 是讲普遍倾向的现成框架，amass possessions 可换 collect things

b3-059-s002.skeleton: Indeed they can have a delightful surprise

modifiers.text: when they find something useful which they did not know they owned
which they did not know they owned

b3-059-s002.gloss: 翻出忘了有的东西时，人会有意外惊喜
b3-059-s002.whyLearn: have a delightful surprise 可换成 have a shock，when 从句结构原样保留

b3-059-s003.skeleton: Those who never have to change house become indiscriminate collectors

modifiers.text: who never have to change house
of what can only be described as clutter
what can only be described as clutter

b3-059-s003.gloss: 从不搬家的人会不加选择地收集杂物。
b3-059-s003.whyLearn: 定语从句直接作主语，后面再套 what 名词性从句作介词宾语，是泛指一类人的高频句式。

b3-059-s008.skeleton: I would list string and brown paper

modifiers.text: kept by thrifty people when a parcel has been opened
when a parcel has been opened
to save buying these two requisites

b3-059-s008.gloss: 这类杂物里我要算上细绳和牛皮纸。
b3-059-s008.whyLearn: 过去分词短语与 when 从句紧接名词作后置修饰，最后用 to save 点明目的，可学多重后置成分的排序。

modifiers.text: If no accidents occur on the way
like punctured tyres, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog
punctured tyres, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog

b3-060-s009.gloss: 路上若不出意外，他们会准点到达。
b3-060-s009.whyLearn: 条件从句与 will be on time 相配，中间用 like 插入一长串并列意外，可学举例成分如何不打断主句。

b3-060-s010.skeleton: They are often more industrious, useful citizens than those

modifiers.text: than those who are never late

b3-060-s010.gloss: 他们比从不迟到的人更勤勉有用。
b3-060-s010.whyLearn: more...than 比较级后用 who 从句限定被比对象，they 回指前文，可学比较句的指代与收尾。

b3-060-s016.skeleton: it is always better to be comfortably early than even a fraction of a minute too late

modifiers.text: If you are catching a train
than even a fraction of a minute too late

b3-060-s016.gloss: 赶火车宁早勿晚，哪怕只晚片刻。
b3-060-s016.whyLearn: it is better to do A than B 是委婉提建议的框架，两个比较项一肯定一否定，可学对称写法。

modifiers.text: that happened 5,000 years ago in the Near East

b4-001-s001.gloss: 我们能读到近东五千年前的旧事。
b4-001-s001.whyLearn: read of 表示读到某事，things 后接 that 从句又叠 where 从句，可学定语从句的连续嵌套。

b4-001-s003.skeleton: The only way that they can preserve their history is to recount it as sagas

modifiers.text: that they can preserve their history
legends handed down from one generation of story-tellers to another
handed down from one generation of story-tellers to another

b4-001-s003.gloss: 他们保存历史的唯一办法是把它讲成传说。
b4-001-s003.whyLearn: The only way is to 是定义做法的典型句型，way 后从句与破折号同位语层层补足，层次清晰可仿写。

b4-001-s008.skeleton: So archaeologists have neither history nor legends

modifiers.text: to find out where the first 'modern men' came from
where the first 'modern men' came from

b4-001-s008.gloss: 考古学家既无史料也无传说可依。
b4-001-s008.whyLearn: neither...nor 后接两个递进的不定式，再嵌 find out 加从句，可学否定并列后如何层层补充。

b4-001-s009.skeleton: ancient men made tools of stone

modifiers.text: because this is easier to shape than other kinds

b4-001-s009.gloss: 古人用石头做工具，尤其用燧石。
b4-001-s009.whyLearn: because 从句用 this 回指前句名词，并补 to shape 比较，可学原因说明与指代衔接的写法。

b4-002-s002.skeleton: Because they destroy so many insects, and insects include some of the greatest enemies of the human race

modifiers.text: Because they destroy so many insects
insects include some of the greatest enemies of the human race

b4-002-s002.gloss: 它们消灭大量昆虫，而昆虫中有人类大敌。
b4-002-s002.whyLearn: 原因从句与 and 并列句合用，最高级 the greatest 加 of 短语限定范围，可学因果与并列混合的长句。

b4-002-s005.skeleton: spiders never do the least harm to us or our belongings

modifiers.text: unlike some of the other insect eaters

b4-002-s005.gloss: 蜘蛛绝不伤害我们和我们的东西。
b4-002-s005.whyLearn: never 加 the least harm 用否定配最高级强化语气，unlike 短语前置作对比，值得整体记下。

b4-002-s007.skeleton: One can tell the difference almost at a glance

modifiers.text: for a spider always has eight legs and an insect never more than six
a spider always has eight legs and an insect never more than six

b4-002-s007.gloss: 只看一眼就能分清蜘蛛和昆虫。
b4-002-s007.whyLearn: for 引出原因，后半并列句 an insect never more than six 省去 has，可学并列结构中的省略。

b4-002-s008.skeleton: How many spiders are engaged in this work on our behalf
b4-002-s008.gloss: 有多少蜘蛛在为我们效劳？
b4-002-s008.whyLearn: be engaged in 是“从事”的地道搭配，How many 提问数量，可学被动语态疑问句的语序。

b4-003-s001.skeleton: Modern alpinists try to climb mountains

modifiers.text: by a route which will give them good spo
which will give them good spo

b4-003-s001.gloss: 现代登山者设法沿称心的路线登山。
b4-003-s001.whyLearn: try to do 后接 by 方式状语，再挂 which 从句补充名词，可学主干加介词短语加定语从句的顺序。

modifiers.text: that although she could perceive things with her fingers this ability ceased the moment her hands were wet
although she could perceive things with her fingers
the moment her hands were wet

b4-004-s010.gloss: 研究发现，手一湿她就摸不出东西。
b4-004-s010.whyLearn: It was found that 引出客观结论，从句里让步与时间状语并存，可学长宾语从句的层次切分。

b4-006-s003.skeleton: Let us get down to fundamentals and agree

modifiers.text: that the young are after all human beings--people just like their elders

b4-006-s003.gloss: 我们该谈根本，承认年轻人也是人。
b4-006-s003.whyLearn: Let us 加并列祈使句提出主张，破折号后同位语再作界定，可学议论文表态与展开的句式。

b4-006-s006.skeleton: being a problem gives you a certain identity, and that is one of the things

modifiers.text: the young are busily engaged in seeking

b4-006-s006.gloss: 成为问题给人一个身份，年轻人正忙于追寻它
b4-006-s006.whyLearn: and 前抽象判断后具体现象；being a problem 这一主语可替换，engaged in 后接 -ing

b4-006-s010.skeleton: All this seems to me to link them with life

modifiers.text: to link them with life, and the origins of things

b4-006-s010.gloss: 这一切在我看来把他们与生命及万物本源相连
b4-006-s010.whyLearn: seem to me to do 双不定式；link A with B 的 A、B 都可替换，适合议论

modifiers.text: as if they were in some sense cosmic beings in violent an lovely contrast with us suburban creatures
in violent an lovely contrast with us suburban creatures

b4-006-s011.gloss: 他们仿佛是宇宙生命，与我们郊区人形成强烈反差
b4-006-s011.whyLearn: as if 后用 were 表虚拟；cosmic beings 与 suburban creatures 是可直接替换的对比槽

b4-007-s004.skeleton: You play to win, and the game has little meaning

modifiers.text: unless you do your utmost to win

b4-007-s004.gloss: 你为赢而赛；除非全力以赴，比赛便毫无意义
b4-007-s004.whyLearn: 两个 to win 前后呼应；unless 从句的条件可替换，写出规则式因果

modifiers.text: that if he shouts in the vicinity of a wall or a mountainside, an echo will come back
if he shouts in the vicinity of a wall or a mountainside
in the vicinity of a wall or a mountainside

b4-009-s003.gloss: 在墙壁或山边呼喊，就会有回声传回来
b4-009-s003.whyLearn: 宾语从句里再套 if 条件句，主将从现；in the vicinity of 可整体换成 near

b4-010-s002.skeleton: The manipulated do not understand them
b4-010-s002.gloss: 被操纵者不懂这些手段，操纵者却害怕它们
b4-010-s002.whyLearn: the + 过去分词与 the + 复数名词对举，两半都可替换成别的对立双方

b4-010-s004.skeleton: We could do with a few original, creative men in our political life

modifiers.text: if only to create some enthusiasm, release some energy

b4-010-s004.gloss: 政界需要的是有创见的人，可他们人在哪里
b4-010-s004.whyLearn: could do with 表需要，if only to 表哪怕只为，末尾反问；men 前形容词可替换

b4-015-s001.skeleton: he is lending the bank money

modifiers.text: When anyone opens a current account at a bank

b4-015-s001.gloss: 在银行开活期账户，等于把钱借给银行
b4-015-s001.whyLearn: when 引导时间状语，主句用进行时写持续行为；账户与银行可替换

b4-015-s010.skeleton: it is the bank which will lose, not the customer
b4-015-s010.gloss: 若这便利伪造，损失由银行而非客户承担
b4-015-s010.whyLearn: it is...which 强调句，把 the bank 换成任何责任方即可复用，not X 收尾对比

b4-016-s002.skeleton: we do not need to send men down to get the oil out

modifiers.text: to send men down to get the oil out
as we must with other mineral deposits

b4-016-s002.gloss: 我们不必像采其他矿藏那样派人下去取油
b4-016-s002.whyLearn: do not need to 与 as we must 构成省略比较，must 后省去重复动词，可套用

b4-016-s005.skeleton: we put up at the surface an oil derrick

modifiers.text: When it has been decided where we are going to drill
where we are going to drill

b4-016-s005.gloss: 钻井位置定了，我们就在地面竖起井架
b4-016-s005.whyLearn: when 从句套被动与 where 从句，主句把 at the surface 插在动词后，语序可模仿

b4-016-s009.skeleton: it usually flows to the surface

modifiers.text: Once we get down to the oil
because great pressure, either from gas or water, is pushing it

b4-016-s009.gloss: 钻到油层后，地层压力把油送上地面
b4-016-s009.whyLearn: once 与 because 双层状语，either...or 插入主谓之间，交代因果

b4-016-s012.skeleton: We want it to stay down the hole

modifiers.text: until we can lead it off in a controlled manner

b4-016-s012.gloss: 我们要它留在井下，直到能可控地引出
b4-016-s012.whyLearn: want sth to do 复合结构接 until 从句；in a controlled manner 可替换成别的方式

b4-018-s007.skeleton: Even more processes are never patented
b4-018-s007.gloss: 还有更多工艺根本不申请专利，只作保密处理
b4-018-s007.whyLearn: never 与 at all 双重加强；are patented 与 kept 共用 are，processes 可替换

b4-023-s006.skeleton: it is the brain that needs resting

modifiers.text: If it is not a question of resting the body

b4-023-s006.gloss: 如果不是让身体休息，那也许是大脑需要休息
b4-023-s006.whyLearn: it is...that 强调句落在 brain；if 从句用 of doing 铺垫，反问收尾引人思考

modifiers.text: The ideas that come so thick and fast to him in any room
that come so thick and fast to him in any room

b4-024-s005.gloss: 那些曾在他脑中密集涌现的念头，今何在
b4-024-s005.whyLearn: 把带定语从句的长主语前置成话题，再用疑问句收尾；thick and fast 可替换

b4-024-s010.skeleton: he adds that A is one of the best fellows he has ever met.

modifiers.text: that A is one of the best fellows he has ever met

b4-024-s010.gloss: 他又说，A 是他见过的最好的人之一。
b4-024-s010.whyLearn: adds that 后整句作宾语，one of the best 加完成时定语从句可整体替换评价对象和比较范围。

b4-025-s010.skeleton: one might suppose that a fixed process took place

modifiers.text: In the conversion of saliva into poison
that a fixed process took place

b4-025-s010.gloss: 人们或许会以为，唾液变毒是固定过程。
b4-025-s010.whyLearn: might suppose 表推测，从句用 took place 陈述过去事实，可替换推测主语与过程名词。

b4-026-s002.skeleton: Hart was, perhaps, the greatest of all Western stars

modifiers.text: for unlike Gary Cooper and John Wayne he appeared in nothing but Westerns
unlike Gary Cooper and John Wayne

b4-026-s002.gloss: 哈特也许是西部片明星中最伟大的。
b4-026-s002.whyLearn: 最高级 the greatest of all 后用 for 分句补原因，unlike 与 nothing but 可替换对比对象和限定范围。

b4-027-s002.skeleton: progress of a particular kind is actually taking place around us and is becoming more and more manifest

modifiers.text: because progress of a particular kind is actually taking place around us and is becoming more and more manifest
and is becoming more and more manifest
