b4-047-s004.gloss: 他从不与人平起，只索要尊重。
b4-047-s004.whyLearn: has never mixed...or spoken 并列否定，but has demanded 转折，due to 说明尊重来源。

b4-047-s007.skeleton: Industry and finance seem to him to be activities unworthy of gentlemen

modifiers.text: to be activities unworthy of gentlemen
although, alas, many are forced by exigencies of circumstance to take some part in them
to take some part in them

b4-047-s007.gloss: 他觉得工商金融非绅士所为。
b4-047-s007.whyLearn: seem to him to be 用不定式作补足语，although 从句 are forced to take 是被动加不定式。

b1-015-s007.whyLearn: 祈使句直接用动词原形开头，省略主语you，是英语下指令最基本也最常用的形式。

b1-016-s005.gloss: 问蒂姆是不是也在花园里。
b1-016-s005.whyLearn: be动词提到句首就构成一般疑问句，答语用Yes或No，是本课最核心的句型转换。

b1-016-s012.whyLearn: 口语里dog's等于dog is，这里的撇号s是is的缩写，不是所有格，容易混淆。

b1-017-s005.whyLearn: 现在进行时be加动词ing描述此刻正在发生的动作，over表示从上方越过。

b1-017-s008.skeleton: Jones and his wife are looking
b1-017-s008.gloss: 琼斯和妻子正看着他们。
b1-017-s008.whyLearn: 并列主语用and连接后谓语要用复数are，look at是固定搭配，表示看向某人。

b1-017-s009.whyLearn: 跟上一句同一框架，只换主语和宾语，注意look后面必须跟at才能接看的东西。

b1-017-s010.whyLearn: under表示在下方穿过，与over形成方向对照，是方位介词辨析的好例子。

b1-017-s011.whyLearn: aeroplane以元音音素开头，所以用an而不是a，是冠词选择规则的典型例子。

b1-017-s012.whyLearn: fly over表示飞越，over强调在正上方经过，可与上句的under配对记忆。

b1-018-s002.gloss: 我们的村庄坐落在山谷里。
b1-018-s002.whyLearn: Our是形容词性物主代词修饰village，in表示位置处在某范围之内。

b1-018-s004.whyLearn: on a river指依河而建，位移动词之外的on不同于in，说明地理位置用词很讲究。

b1-018-s006.skeleton: My wife and I are walking

modifiers.text: alone the banks of the river

b1-018-s006.gloss: 我和妻子正沿着河岸散步。
b1-018-s006.whyLearn: 并列主语my wife and I用复数are，英语习惯把自己放在后面，更显礼貌。

b1-018-s009.whyLearn: across表示从一侧横穿到另一侧，swim across是描述过河最常用的搭配。

b1-018-s013.whyLearn: on the right是固定短语表示在右边，问路指路时几乎句句都要用到。

b1-018-s014.gloss: 一些孩子正从楼里出来。
b1-018-s014.whyLearn: out of表示从内部出来，与into方向相反，是描述移动方向的高频短语。

b1-018-s015.gloss: 他们中一些人正走进公园。
b1-018-s015.whyLearn: some of them作主语时谓语仍用复数，into强调进入内部，注意与in的区别。

b3-035-s019.gloss: 他在那里已经待了将近十个小时。
b3-035-s019.whyLearn: for 加时间段与过去完成时搭配，说明动作一直延续到过去的某个时点。

modifiers.text: even before the man was handed over to the police

b3-035-s020.gloss: 在把人交给警察前，正义就已得到伸张。
b3-035-s020.whyLearn: 过去完成时加被动语态，表明正义早于移交这个过去动作前就已完成。

modifiers.text: that an obscure maid-servant was really the hero's mother

b3-036-s002.gloss: 读者欣然接受这个事实：卑微女仆真是英雄的母亲。
b3-036-s002.whyLearn: the fact that 引出同位语从句说明抽象名词的内容，别误当成宾语从句。

b3-036-s003.skeleton: A long-lost brother, who was presumed dead, was really alive

modifiers.text: wickedly plotting to bring about the hero's down- fall
to bring about the hero's down- fall

b3-036-s003.gloss: 失散多年的兄弟其实一直活着，还暗中策划报复。
b3-036-s003.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语后，再用分词并列谓语，长句仍能保持结构清楚。

b3-036-s005.skeleton: Modern readers would find such naive solutions
b3-036-s005.gloss: 现代读者会觉得这种天真的结局无法接受。
b3-036-s005.whyLearn: would 在此表主观判断，注意 find 后接形容词作宾语补足语的语序。

modifiers.text: to bring about coincidences which anyone but a nineteenth century novelist would find incredible
which anyone but a nineteenth century novelist would find incredible

b3-036-s006.gloss: 现实中，机缘有时真的会造成令人难以置信的巧合。
b3-036-s006.whyLearn: do 强调谓语，定语从句里再嵌 would 表虚拟判断，句子层次很典型。

b3-036-s007.skeleton: A German taxi-driver, Franz Bussman, recently found a brother

modifiers.text: who was thought to have been killed twenty years before

b3-036-s007.gloss: 德国司机弗朗茨找到了据说二十年前已死的弟弟。
b3-036-s007.whyLearn: 同位语交代身份，定语从句里用不定式完成式表示更早的被动事件。

b3-036-s009.skeleton: Mrs Bussman commented on the workman's close resemblance to her husband

modifiers.text: and even suggested that he might be his brother
that he might be his brother

b3-036-s009.gloss: 他们走后，布斯曼太太说工人像她丈夫，还猜是弟弟。
b3-036-s009.whyLearn: 一个主语连挂评论与推测两个谓语，might 让猜测的语气更委婉。

b3-036-s010.skeleton: Franz poured scorn on the idea

modifiers.text: pointingout that his brother had been killed in action during the war
that his brother had been killed in action during the war

b3-036-s010.gloss: 弗朗茨对这说法嗤之以鼻，指出弟弟已在战争中阵亡。
b3-036-s010.whyLearn: 分词短语补充同一主语的动作，poured scorn on 这类搭配值得整块记。

b3-036-s014.skeleton: he had been sent to hospital and was separated from his unit

modifiers.text: After having been wounded towards the end of the war

b3-036-s014.gloss: 战争末期受伤后，他被送进医院，与部队失去联系。
b3-036-s014.whyLearn: 介词后接完成被动分词作时间状语，主句两个被动谓语共用一个主语。

modifiers.text: and Hans had made his way back into Western Germany on foot

b3-036-s015.gloss: 医院被炸，汉斯只好步行回到西德。
b3-036-s015.whyLearn: 两个并列的过去完成时句子，一句被动一句主动，交代事件的两面。

modifiers.text: and all records of him had been destroyed

b3-036-s016.gloss: 同时，他的部队失散，有关他的记录也已被销毁。
b3-036-s016.whyLearn: 并列两个分句用不同时态，区分同时的状态与更早完成的被动动作。

modifiers.text: but the house had been bombed and no one in the neighbourhood knew what had become of the inhabitants
what had become of the inhabitants

b3-036-s017.gloss: 汉斯回到老家，房子已被炸，邻居没人知道住户下落。
b3-036-s017.whyLearn: 三个分句层层推进，what 引导的间接疑问句作 knew 的宾语。

b3-036-s018.skeleton: Hans settled down in a Village fifty miles away

modifiers.text: Assuming that his family had been killed during an air-raid
that his family had been killed during an air-raid
in a Village fifty miles away
where he had remained ever since

b3-036-s018.gloss: 汉斯以为家人已死于空袭，便在五十英里外村庄定居。
b3-036-s018.whyLearn: 分词短语交代前提，where 从句把定居后的持续状态一直延伸到如今。

modifiers.text: to expect that trains will be punctual

b3-037-s001.gloss: 我们已经习惯认为火车会准点。
b3-037-s001.whyLearn: learn to expect 连用表达养成的预期，that 从句说明 expect 的内容。

b3-037-s002.skeleton: most of us have developed an unshakable faith
b3-037-s002.gloss: 多年习惯养成后，我们大多对列车时刻表深信不疑。
b3-037-s002.whyLearn: have developed 表已形成的心态，faith 后面固定用 in 引出对象。

b1-053-s010.whyLearn: can 提到句首构成请求疑问句，tell 后跟双宾语 me；换动词就能造出各种礼貌问法。

b1-054-s004.gloss: 售货员问这一件怎么样
b1-054-s004.whyLearn: What about 直接抛出新选项，省掉完整问句，挑衣服、点菜时都能一句带过。

b1-054-s008.skeleton: Would you like to try it?
b1-054-s008.whyLearn: Would you like to 是礼貌邀请的固定框架，后面接不定式；把 try it 换成别的动作即可复用。

b1-054-s010.skeleton: I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well
b1-054-s010.gloss: 这件绿裙子对我来说也太小了
b1-054-s010.whyLearn: too...for sb 说明对谁而言太怎样，as well 补充'也'，试衣说尺码不合身时最常用。

b1-054-s014.skeleton: I think the blue dress is prettier
b1-054-s014.gloss: 我觉得那条蓝裙子更漂亮
b1-054-s014.whyLearn: I think 后接完整从句说明看法，比较级 prettier 直接作表语，换名词就能比较任何商品。

b1-054-s015.skeleton: Could you show me another blue dress?
b1-054-s015.gloss: 女士请售货员再拿一条蓝裙子
b1-054-s015.whyLearn: Could you 让请求更客气，show 后接 me 和 dress 双宾语，购物要求再拿一件直接套用。

b1-054-s017.skeleton: I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress
b1-054-s017.gloss: 抱歉，我们没有更大的裙子
b1-054-s017.whyLearn: I'm afraid 先软化语气再报坏消息，haven't got 代替 don't have，是英式口语说法。

b1-055-s006.gloss: 贝蒂提议加点糖怎么样
b1-055-s006.whyLearn: What about 后面直接跟名词提建议，省去动词，餐桌上换一个词就能提出新方案。

b1-055-s012.gloss: 贝蒂问要不要再来一点
b1-055-s012.whyLearn: Would you like 后省略名词，some more 泛指再来一些，是劝人添饭添水的固定问法。

b1-055-s015.whyLearn: May I 是最客气的许可请求，have 表示取用，句末 one 代替前面提过的可数名词。

b1-055-s017.skeleton: I think there are a few in that box

modifiers.text: there are a few in that box

b1-055-s017.gloss: 我想那个盒子里还有几个
b1-055-s017.whyLearn: I think 后接 there be 从句，a few 表示肯定性的'几个'，一句说清某处存在某物。

b1-055-s018.whyLearn: I'm afraid 后省略 that 接从句，先说客气话再报失望结果，找东西时很实用。

b1-056-s006.skeleton: We can't afford all that money
b1-056-s006.whyLearn: can't afford 表示买不起，后面直接接名词或金额，是拒绝高价与砍价的常用句。

b1-056-s009.skeleton: it's not as good as the expensive one
b1-056-s009.gloss: 当然，它没有贵的那件好
b1-056-s009.whyLearn: not as good as 是比较的否定说法，比 not better than 更地道，用来委婉说东西差一点。

b1-056-s017.skeleton: You always want the best, but we can't afford it
b1-056-s017.gloss: 你总想要最好的，可我们买不起
b1-056-s017.whyLearn: but 连接两个对立分句，the best 用最高级，can't afford 收尾点出矛盾，吵架式句型模板。

b1-057-s004.skeleton: I can't change a pound note
b1-057-s004.gloss: 我找不开一英镑的纸币
b1-057-s004.whyLearn: change 在这里指把大钞换成零钱，can't 表示做不到，是商店里极常见的一句话。

b2-019-s002.gloss: 苏珊说可能已经开始了
b2-019-s002.whyLearn: 引语在前、报告动词在后；may have done 表对过去的推测。

b2-019-s006.whyLearn: 票卖完的现状用现在完成时，报告动词用过去时，两句时态对照清楚。

b2-019-s009.skeleton: a man hurried to the ticket-office
b2-019-s009.gloss: 就在那时，一个男人赶往售票处
b2-019-s009.whyLearn: Just then 用来衔接叙事时间点，hurry to 比 go to 更有匆促的画面感。

b2-019-s015.skeleton: they are for next Wednesday's performance
b2-019-s015.gloss: 女孩说当然有票，是下周三场次的
b2-019-s015.whyLearn: 报告动词插进引语中间，构成引语加 he said 再加引语的常见引述格式。

b2-019-s016.skeleton: I might as well have them
b2-019-s016.gloss: 我无奈地说，那就买下吧
b2-019-s016.whyLearn: might as well 表示勉强接受，语气比 want 弱得多，是口语让步的利器。

b2-020-s002.gloss: 我常常钓上好几个小时却一无所获
b2-020-s002.whyLearn: without 加 doing 把否定结果收进介词短语，句子不必再用 but 转折。

b2-020-s003.whyLearn: 否定靠助动词 do；worry sb 是使某人烦恼，主语通常是事而不是人。

b2-020-s005.skeleton: they catch old boots and rubbish
b2-020-s005.gloss: 他们钓到的不是鱼，而是旧靴子和垃圾
b2-020-s005.whyLearn: Instead of 加 doing 放句首制造对比，再配 and 并列宾语，节奏紧凑。

modifiers.text: After having spent whole mornings on the river

b2-020-s008.gloss: 在河边耗掉整个上午后，我总空手回家
b2-020-s008.whyLearn: After having done 用完成形式点明动作先后，结尾 with 短语补出结果。

b2-020-s013.skeleton: I'm not really interested in fishing
b2-020-s013.gloss: 我对钓鱼其实没什么兴趣
b2-020-s013.whyLearn: be interested in 加 doing 是常见兴趣表达，not really 让否定更委婉。

modifiers.text: in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all

b2-020-s014.gloss: 我唯一感兴趣的，是坐船上什么也不干
b2-020-s014.whyLearn: 一个介词 in 后面挂两个 doing 并列宾语，only 与 at all 前后强化语气。

b2-021-s001.skeleton: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad
b2-021-s001.gloss: 飞机正慢慢把我逼得发疯
b2-021-s001.whyLearn: drive sb mad 是固定搭配，现在进行时写出持续升级的困扰。

b2-021-s002.skeleton: passing planes can be heard night and day
b2-021-s002.gloss: 我住在机场旁，飞机日夜都能听见
b2-021-s002.whyLearn: can be heard 用情态动词的被动表示客观经常发生，and 连接两个主句。

b2-021-s003.skeleton: it could not be used then

modifiers.text: The airport was built during the war

b2-021-s003.gloss: 机场战时建成，却因故当时无法使用
b2-021-s003.whyLearn: was built 与 could not be used 两个被动并列，but 转折引出原因的落空。

b2-021-s004.gloss: 不过，它在去年投入了使用
b2-021-s004.whyLearn: however 插在时间状语与主语之间，come into use 是开始使用的固定说法。

b2-021-s005.skeleton: Over a hundred people must have been driven away
b2-021-s005.gloss: 上百人一定已被噪音逼得搬离家园
b2-021-s005.whyLearn: must have been done 把推测、完成、被动叠在一起，是长句理解的关键。

b1-044-s017.gloss: 服务员说他们正在想办法修它。
b1-044-s017.whyLearn: are trying to do 把进行时和不定式叠在一起：先说动作正在进行，再补出努力的目标。

b1-044-s018.gloss: 说实话，你需要一辆新车了。
b1-044-s018.whyLearn: to tell you the truth 是固定开场白，用逗号隔开插在句首，给后面的判断加上实话实说的语气。

b1-045-s008.gloss: 韦斯特先生说他在此住了二十年。
b1-045-s008.whyLearn: for 加时间段是现在完成时的标配，表示从过去持续到现在；换掉 twenty years 就能讲自己的居住史。

b1-045-s011.gloss: 他说从一九四七年起就住在这里。
b1-045-s011.whyLearn: since 加时间点只标起点，和上句 for twenty years 一比，就明白完成时两种时间状语的分别。

b1-045-s014.skeleton: I want to buy a small house
b1-045-s014.gloss: 我想在乡下买一栋小房子。
b1-045-s014.whyLearn: want to do 是最基本的动词加不定式搭配；地点放句尾，注意 in the country 指乡下而不是国家。

b1-045-s017.gloss: 希尔先生说那可是一大笔钱。
b1-045-s017.whyLearn: a lot of 后面接不可数名词 money，感叹时直接 That's 起头；换成 a lot of time 就能造同类句。

b1-045-s018.gloss: 他说这房子值这个价钱。
b1-045-s018.whyLearn: be worth 加名词表示值多少，of it 回指前面谈的价钱，短短一句就能表达一分钱一分货。

b1-045-s020.whyLearn: must 表示说话人主观认为必须，first 放句尾点出先后顺序；My wife 可换成 his mother。

b1-045-s021.skeleton: Women always have the last word
b1-045-s021.gloss: 他说女人总是最后说了算。
b1-045-s021.whyLearn: have the last word 是固定说法，指最终拍板；always 放在实义动词前，正是频率副词的标准位置。

b1-046-s001.skeleton: Has Mr West sold his house
b1-046-s001.gloss: 她问韦斯特先生把房子卖了没有。
b1-046-s001.whyLearn: 完成时疑问句把 Has 提到主语前，yet 放句尾问是否已经；his house 用物主代词限定名词。

b1-046-s012.skeleton: He has always been a good neighbour
b1-046-s012.whyLearn: 完成时里频率副词 always 固定在 has 和 been 之间；a good neighbour 作表语说明身份。

b1-046-s013.gloss: 格林太太说他是个很好的人。
b1-046-s013.whyLearn: He's 是 He is 的缩写，口语里几乎不读全；very 直接修饰 nice，是最省事的加强语气办法。

b1-046-s015.skeleton: When will the new people move into this house
b1-046-s015.gloss: 她问新住户何时搬进这所房子。
b1-046-s015.whyLearn: When 引导特殊疑问句时 will 紧跟疑问词再放主语；move into 是搬进的固定搭配，into 不能省。

b1-046-s017.skeleton: Will you see Mr West today
b1-046-s017.gloss: 她问布朗太太今天去不去见韦斯特。
b1-046-s017.whyLearn: 一般疑问句把 Will 提到句首，句尾用逗号加称呼 Mrs Brown，问安排时常这样收尾。

b1-046-s023.skeleton: He didn't want to leave this house
b1-046-s023.whyLearn: 否定式 didn't 已经承担了时态，后面 want 用原形；want to do 的肯定与否定只差一个 didn't。

b1-046-s024.gloss: 说他不愿走，而他妻子想走。
b1-046-s024.whyLearn: 并列句用 did 代替重复的 wanted to leave，避免啰嗦；he didn't 与 his wife did 正相反。

b3-060-s026.skeleton: The porter went to fetch one and arrived back with the stationmaster

modifiers.text: who produced it with a flourish and pointed out a microscopic 'o' beside the time of the arrival of the train at his station
beside the time of the arrival of the train at his station
this little 'o' indicated that the train only stopped for water
that the train only stopped for water

b3-060-s026.gloss: 站长指出小写o表示列车只停靠加水。
b3-060-s026.whyLearn: who 引导的非限制性定语从句补充站长的动作，注意它由 and 连接两个并列谓语，并用分号另起一句交代 o 的含义。

b4-001-s002.skeleton: there are some parts of the world

modifiers.text: where even now people cannot write

b4-001-s002.gloss: 世界上有些地方的人至今不会写字。
b4-001-s002.whyLearn: there be 说明存在，where 从句修饰 parts，把地点拆成 'where + 完整主谓'，比 of which 更口语。

modifiers.text: because they can tell us something about migrations of people who lived long ago
about migrations of people who lived long ago
but none could write down what they did

b4-001-s004.gloss: 传说之所以有用，在于能说明远古迁徙。
b4-001-s004.whyLearn: because 交代原因，but 转折出局限：传说能讲远古人群的迁徙，却因无人会写而无法记录他们做过什么。

b4-001-s007.skeleton: the first people who were like ourselves lived so long ago

modifiers.text: that even their sagas, if they had any, are forgotten

b4-001-s007.gloss: 最早像我们的人太久远，传说纵有也已被遗忘。
b4-001-s007.whyLearn: so...that 引导结果状语从句，if they had any 插在主谓之间，是被动语态加虚拟语气的好例子。

b4-001-s011.skeleton: the tools of long ago have remained

modifiers.text: when even the bones of the men who made them have disappeared without trace

b4-001-s011.gloss: 石头不朽，远古工具留存，造它的人连骨头都消失了。
b4-001-s011.whyLearn: and so 把因果串成一句，when 从句用现在完成时，who made them 限定 the men。

b4-002-s003.skeleton: Insects would make it impossible for us to live in the world

modifiers.text: for us to live in the world
they would devour all our crops and kill our flocks and herds
if it were not for the protection we get from insect-eating animals

b4-002-s003.gloss: 若无食虫动物，昆虫会毁掉我们的庄稼和牲畜。
b4-002-s003.whyLearn: would 加 if it were not for 构成现在虚拟；it 是形式宾语，真正宾语是 for us to live。

b4-002-s009.skeleton: One authority on spiders made a census

modifiers.text: of the spiders in a grass field in the south of England
in a grass field in the south of England
and he estimated that there were more than 2,250,000 in one acre, that is something like 6,000,000 spiders of different kinds on a football pitch
that there were more than 2,250,000 in one acre, that is something like 6,000,000 spiders of different kinds on a football pitch
that is something like 6,000,000 spiders of different kinds on a football pitch

b4-002-s009.gloss: 学者统计草地里的蜘蛛，推算一英亩达六百万只。
b4-002-s009.whyLearn: made a census of 是固定搭配；that 从句套 there be，that is 再补一个惊人体量。

modifiers.text: that the weight of all the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year would be greater than the total weight of all the human beings in the country
of all the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year
destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year
greater than the total weight of all the human beings in the country
of all the human beings in the country

b4-002-s012.gloss: 据估算，英国蜘蛛一年吃掉的昆虫比全国人还重。
b4-002-s012.whyLearn: It has been estimated that 是引述数据的高频句型，过去分词 destroyed 后置修饰 insects。

b4-003-s003.skeleton: The early climbers were looking for the easiest way

modifiers.text: because the summit was the prize they sought, especially if it had never been attained before
especially if it had never been attained before

b4-003-s003.gloss: 早期登山者冲着顶峰去，因为顶峰是未曾被征服的奖赏。
b4-003-s003.whyLearn: because 说明动机；the prize they sought 是省略关系词的定语从句，especially if 再加一层条件。

b4-003-s004.skeleton: they often faced difficulties and dangers of the most perilous nature

modifiers.text: equipped in a manner which would make a modern climber shudder at the thought
which would make a modern climber shudder at the thought
but they did not go out of their way to court such excitement

b4-003-s004.gloss: 他们确实常遇极险的困难，但不会刻意去自找刺激。
b4-003-s004.whyLearn: It is true that 先让步，but 再转折；equipped 分词作状语，which 从句说明装备差到让现代登山者发抖。

b4-003-s006.skeleton: It is hard for us to realize nowadays

modifiers.text: how difficult it was for the pioneers

b4-003-s006.gloss: 今天很难体会当年先驱者的艰难。
b4-003-s006.whyLearn: It 是形式主语，真正主语是 for us to realize；how difficult 从句作 realize 的宾语。

b4-003-s009.skeleton: Often a valley boasted no inn at all, and climbers found shelter

modifiers.text: sometimes with the local priest (who was usually as poor as his parishioners)
who was usually as poor as his parishioners

b4-003-s009.gloss: 山谷常无旅店，登山者就地借宿，或神父家或牧羊人家。
b4-003-s009.whyLearn: and 连接两个并列主句，wherever 引导让步状语从句，括号里的 who 从句和 as...as 结构补出神父一样穷。

modifiers.text: who has normal vision but who can also perceive things with different parts of her skin, and through solid walls
with different parts of her skin

b4-004-s002.gloss: 一例：女孩维拉视力正常，却能用皮肤和隔墙感知。
b4-004-s002.whyLearn: 两个 who 并列修饰 schoolgirl，中间用同位语给出姓名；介词短语 with... 与 through... 说明感知方式。

b4-004-s006.skeleton: Vera's curious talent was brought to the notice of a scientific research institute

modifiers.text: to the notice of a scientific research institute in the town of UIyanovsk
and in April she was given a series of tests by a special commission of the Ministry of Health of the Russian Federal Republic
by a special commission of the Ministry of Health of the Russian Federal Republic
of the Ministry of Health of the Russian Federal Republic

b4-004-s006.gloss: 她的才能引起研究所注意，四月接受卫生部测试。
b4-004-s006.whyLearn: 两处被动语态；bring to the notice of 为固定搭配，near where 从句作介词宾语。

b4-004-s007.skeleton: During these tests she was able to read a newspaper through an opaque screen

modifiers.text: and, stranger still, by moving her elbow over a child's game of Lotto she was able to describe the figures and colours printed on it
by moving her elbow over a child's game of Lotto
and, in another instance, wearing stockings and slippers, to make out with her foot the outlines and colours of a picture hidden under a carpet
of a picture hidden under a carpet

b4-004-s007.gloss: 她隔着不透明屏读报，还用肘部和脚辨认图案颜色。
b4-004-s007.whyLearn: be able to 后接三个并列动作；stranger still 是插入语，wearing 与 printed 都是分词修饰。

b4-005-s007.skeleton: No really satisfactory photograph has ever been taken of one in a wild state

modifiers.text: of one in a wild state
no zoologist, however intrepid, has been able to keep the animal under close and constant observation in the dark jungles in which he lives
to keep the animal under close and constant observation in the dark jungles in which he lives
in the dark jungles in which he lives

b4-005-s007.gloss: 没人拍到野生照片，学者也难在丛林持续观察。
b4-005-s007.whyLearn: 两个 no 并列否定；however intrepid 插入让步，in which he lives 是介词加关系代词的定语从句。

b2-073-s001.skeleton: Little boys who play truant from school are unimaginative.
b2-073-s001.gloss: 逃学的小男孩缺乏想象力。
b2-073-s001.whyLearn: 主语被定语从句隔开后再接 are，是主谓一致的坑；看清 who 从句到 school 结束，才不会把 play 当主句谓语。

b2-073-s004.skeleton: He hitch- hiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat
b2-073-s004.gloss: 他搭便车到多佛，傍晚钻进一条船想找地方睡。
b2-073-s004.whyLearn: and 连接两个过去式谓语，towards evening 插入其中；to find 表目的，后接 somewhere 这类不定代词。

b2-073-s006.gloss: 没人注意到那男孩悄悄溜走。
b2-073-s006.whyLearn: as 引导时间状语从句，交代 noticed 发生的当口；notice 后直接接宾语，不加 that，这是和 think 之类动词的区别。

b2-073-s007.skeleton: he hitch-hiked to Paris in a lorry
b2-073-s007.gloss: 他从那里搭卡车去了巴黎。
b2-073-s007.whyLearn: 句首 From there 承接上文地点，in a lorry 说明交通方式；同一骨架换上城市名和交通工具就能续写行程。

b2-073-s008.skeleton: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.

modifiers.text: a few biscuits and a cup of coffee

b2-073-s008.gloss: 司机给他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，让他在城外下车。
b2-073-s008.whyLearn: 一个主语带 gave 和 left 两个并列谓语；a few 修饰可数名词复数，a cup of 用容器计量不可数名词。

b2-073-s009.skeleton: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
b2-073-s009.gloss: 第二辆车没送他去巴黎，而把他带到边境佩皮尼昂。
b2-073-s009.whyLearn: 定语从句 the boy stopped 省略了 that 紧贴 car；not…but… 对比两个去向，as 从句点出结果与预期相反。

b2-073-s010.skeleton: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
b2-073-s010.gloss: 他在那儿被警察抓住，由当地当局遣返英国。
b2-073-s010.whyLearn: was picked up 与 sent back 共用 was 构成并列被动；两个 by 分别引出施动者。

b2-073-s011.skeleton: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of boys who dream of evading school.
b2-073-s011.gloss: 他无疑为千万个想逃学的男孩创下了纪录。
b2-073-s011.whyLearn: 现在完成时 has set up 强调纪录保持至今；介词 of 后必须用动名词 evading，写成 evade 就错了。

b2-074-s001.skeleton: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
b2-074-s001.gloss: 一辆旧巴士停在干涸的河床边，一群名演员下了车。
b2-074-s001.whyLearn: and 连接两个各有主谓的独立分句，两边都用过去式；a party of 表示一群人，是英语常见的集合表达。

modifiers.text: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes
so that no one should recognize them

b2-074-s002.gloss: 他们戴上墨镜、穿上旧衣，百般小心以免被认出。
b2-074-s002.whyLearn: 过去分词 Dressed 作状语，逻辑主语就是 they；so that 从句用 should 表目的，与过去时保持呼应。

b2-074-s003.skeleton: disguises can sometimes be too perfect
b2-074-s003.gloss: 但正如他们很快发现的，伪装有时过于完美。
b2-074-s003.whyLearn: as 从句插在句首作评注，主句照样完整；can 在此表客观可能，too 加形容词点出过了头的意味。

b2-074-s005.gloss: 布林克斯利·米尔斯附和说：再好不过了。
b2-074-s005.whyLearn: 否定式 couldn't 加比较级 better 表达最高级含义，是英语特有的说法；引号外的 agreed 交代是谁在说。

b2-074-s006.skeleton: No newspaper men, no film fans
b2-074-s006.whyLearn: 省略句：No 加名词并列，等于 There are no newspaper men and no film fans。

b2-074-s008.skeleton: Meanwhile, two other actors, Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves, had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
b2-074-s008.gloss: 同时，另两位演员把两大篮食物搬到树荫下。
b2-074-s008.whyLearn: 两个人名夹在逗号间作同位语，补充说明 actors；had carried 用过去完成时，表示先于故事主线的动作。

b2-074-s011.gloss: 你们现在都给我从这儿出去！
b2-074-s011.whyLearn: 祈使句用 Now 开头加强催促语气，句尾 all of you 是同位语，重申并强调 you，口语呵斥的典型说法。

b2-074-s016.skeleton: I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves
b2-074-s016.gloss: 我是罗克沃尔·斯林格，这位是梅林·格里夫斯。
b2-074-s016.whyLearn: 介绍自己用 I'm，介绍身边人用 this is，两个一般现在时短句由 and 并列，是英语介绍的标准搭配。

b2-048-s009.skeleton: I was able to tell him

modifiers.text: When the dentist at last removed the cotton-wool from my mouth
that he had pulled out the wrong tooth

b2-048-s009.gloss: 牙医取出棉花后，我告诉他拔错了牙。
b2-048-s009.whyLearn: when 从句给时间背景，主句 was able to 表当时能做成；tell him that 后用过去完成时，点明拔错牙发生在说之前。

b2-049-s002.skeleton: he became the proud owner of a bed

modifiers.text: For the first time in his life
which had springs and a mattress

b2-049-s002.gloss: 他平生第一次拥有带弹簧和床垫的床。
b2-049-s002.whyLearn: the proud owner of 是“自豪地拥有”的地道说法；which 从句补充床的构造，比另起一句更紧凑，值得整块模仿。

b2-049-s006.skeleton: The young man did not wake up

modifiers.text: until the bed had struck the ground

b2-049-s006.gloss: 床砸到地上，年轻人才醒过来。
b2-049-s006.whyLearn: not...until 表“直到…才”，用 did 加动词原形的否定式，until 从句用过去完成时，说明先砸地后醒人。

b2-050-s009.whyLearn: as far as 既可指距离也可指程度界限，这里整块作表语；go 用一般现在时，说明是眼下的界限，可直接套用。

b2-051-s001.skeleton: My friend, Herbert, has always been fat, but things got so bad recently

modifiers.text: that he decided to go on a diet

b2-051-s001.gloss: 朋友赫伯特一直胖，最近胖得他决定节食。
b2-051-s001.whyLearn: but 连接两个主句：has always been 讲一直胖，got so bad...that 引出节食的结果。

b2-051-s006.skeleton: I rang the bell and was not surprised

modifiers.text: to see that Herbert was still as fat as ever
that Herbert was still as fat as ever

b2-051-s006.gloss: 我按了门铃，见他还是那么胖，毫不意外。
b2-051-s006.whyLearn: and 后省略主语 I 与 rang 共用；be surprised to do 表做某事时不惊讶，as fat as ever 是同级比较。

b2-051-s009.skeleton: he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk

modifiers.text: When I asked him what he was doing

b2-051-s009.gloss: 我问他在干什么，他心虚地笑笑，把包裹放桌上。
b2-051-s009.whyLearn: when 从句里套了 what 引导的间接疑问句，要用陈述语序；主句用 and then 把 smiled 和 put 两个动作顺接起来。

modifiers.text: that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally
that he had to reward himself occasionally

b2-051-s010.gloss: 他解释说节食太严，只能偶尔奖励自己。
b2-051-s010.whyLearn: explained 后接 that 宾语从句，从句里又套 so...that 结果句；had to 用过去时，与主句时态保持一致。

modifiers.text: to persuade her to ring back later

b2-054-s009.gloss: 我花十分钟劝她晚点再打电话。
b2-054-s009.whyLearn: It took sb. some time to do 是花时间的固定框架；persuade sb. to do 再套一个不定式。

b2-054-s012.gloss: 我手指、电话和门把手上都是油酥面。
b2-054-s012.whyLearn: There be 引出某处有某物，后面用三个 on 短语并列铺开现场；注意 and 前加逗号的列举写法，可照此描述一片狼藉。

b2-054-s013.skeleton: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen

modifiers.text: than the door-bell rang loud enough to wake the dead

b2-054-s013.gloss: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响得惊天动地。
b2-054-s013.whyLearn: no sooner...than 表“刚一…就…”，主句用过去完成时，than 从句用一般过去时。

b2-055-s002.skeleton: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented and it has been used to detect gold

modifiers.text: which has been buried in the ground

b2-055-s002.gloss: 新机器“揭示器”已发明，用于探测地下埋藏的金子。
b2-055-s002.whyLearn: 一句连用两个现在完成时的被动语态，第二次用 it 指代机器避免重复；which 从句再叠一层被动，是密集的被动练习句。

modifiers.text: in a cave near the seashore
where--it is said--pirates used to hide gold

b2-055-s003.gloss: 机器曾在海边山洞用过，据说海盗在那儿藏金。
b2-055-s003.whyLearn: where 从句修饰 cave，中间插入 it is said；used to do 表过去常做，别与被动 was used 混。

b2-055-s006.skeleton: The leader of the party was examining the soil

modifiers.text: near the entrance to the cave
when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground
that there was gold under the ground

b2-055-s006.gloss: 队长正检查洞口泥土，机器显示地下有金子。
b2-055-s006.whyLearn: was examining 铺背景，when 引出突然发生的事；showed 后接 there be 宾语从句，语序与中文“显示有金”正好一致。

b2-056-s002.skeleton: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement
b2-056-s002.gloss: 去年许多车参赛，开赛前气氛十分热烈。
b2-056-s002.whyLearn: A lot of 接可数名词复数，a great deal of 接不可数；后句 there be 加 before 从句交代时间。

modifiers.text: As soon as she saw it

b2-057-s009.whyLearn: As soon as 引导时间状语从句，主句 said 后接省略 that 的宾语从句；否定的说法要按英语习惯前移成 did not like。

modifiers.text: to have the tree cut down
but so far he has refused

b2-058-s006.gloss: 牧师被要求把树砍掉，他至今拒绝。
b2-058-s006.whyLearn: 一句兼练完成时被动、使役 have sth done 与并列转折，读熟能直接改写自用。

b2-059-s001.skeleton: used to sit outside our front gate
b2-059-s001.gloss: 我们的狗雷克斯过去常坐在前门外叫。
b2-059-s001.whyLearn: used to 讲过去习惯，同位语用逗号夹住补充名字，写宠物或人物介绍可照用。

modifiers.text: when I was going out shopping last week
in the garden near the gate

b2-059-s005.gloss: 上周我出门购物时，发现它在园中门边。
b2-059-s005.whyLearn: 过去进行时铺时间背景，一般过去时给出主事件，注意句首 However 必须加逗号。

modifiers.text: so that someone would let him out

b2-059-s006.gloss: 这次它不停地叫，好让人把它放出去。
b2-059-s006.whyLearn: so that 引目的从句，配 would 表过去将来，写目的句可直接套这个框架。

b2-059-s008.skeleton: he comes into the garden and waits

modifiers.text: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside

b2-059-s008.gloss: 他一从外面开门，就进园等到门关上。
b2-059-s008.whyLearn: as soon as 与 until 两个时间从句一前一后，练连词搭配和主句双谓语并列。

b2-060-s009.skeleton: I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky

modifiers.text: As soon as I went outside
because my wife hurried towards me

b2-060-s009.gloss: 我一出门就忘了她，因为妻子朝我走来。
b2-060-s009.whyLearn: 同句串起时间从句和原因从句，as soon as 后主句用过去式，because 引出真正原因。

modifiers.text: whether the experiment has been successful
until we have received a radio message

b2-061-s006.gloss: 收到无线电消息前，我们无从知道实验成败。
b2-061-s006.whyLearn: not...until 夹着 whether 宾语从句，练将来时与现在完成时的时态配合。

b2-062-s005.skeleton: the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed

modifiers.text: When the fire had at last been put out

b2-062-s005.gloss: 大火扑灭后，当局订购了几吨速生草籽。
b2-062-s005.whyLearn: 过去完成被动点明先发生，which would 表过去将来的定语从句补说明，叙事长句范例。

modifiers.text: As soon as he had finished

b2-063-s007.gloss: 他一说完，珍妮就告诉他想回家。
b2-063-s007.whyLearn: 过去完成时标出先发生的动作，told 后接省略 that 的宾语从句，时间层次很清晰。

modifiers.text: and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him

b2-063-s011.gloss: 杰弗里问她缘由，她说不想看众人笑他。
b2-063-s011.whyLearn: 并列句一边是间接疑问句一边是宾语从句，还含 see sb doing，一句见多种从句。

modifiers.text: that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel

b2-064-s002.gloss: 他说可以在海峡中央建一座平台。
b2-064-s002.whyLearn: 宾语从句里 it 作形式主语、真正主语不定式后置，是英语安排长主语的常见手法。

b2-064-s011.skeleton: it will connect Britain to Europe

modifiers.text: for the first time in history

b2-064-s011.gloss: 若建成，它将首次把英国与欧洲连起来。
b2-064-s011.whyLearn: 主将从现的典型句，条件从句用被动，主句 connect A to B，一句学两个考点。

modifiers.text: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a 'guard of honour' of six pretty girls
down the main street of the city
riding a baby elephant called Jumbo

b2-065-s002.gloss: 他扮成圣诞老人，骑小象沿主街出发。
b2-065-s002.whyLearn: 句首两个过去分词并列作状语，句尾现在分词补充动作，修饰再多主干仍只有三词。

modifiers.text: Jumbo must weigh a few tons
that we didn't have to carry him

b2-065-s008.gloss: 警察说大象有几吨重，幸好不用抬它。
b2-065-s008.whyLearn: 引语配倒装 said a policeman，再用 it was fortunate that 表态，口语叙事很地道。

modifiers.text: After Mr Wimpenny had the plane built

b2-066-s004.gloss: 温彭尼先生让人造好飞机后，飞机被彻底测试。
b2-066-s004.whyLearn: have sth done 使役结构嵌在时间从句里，主句用被动，两种句式一句话掌握。

b2-066-s006.skeleton: the plane crashed on an airfield

modifiers.text: While being flown by a champion amateur cyclist in 1963

b2-066-s006.gloss: 1963年被冠军骑手驾驶时，飞机坠毁在机场。
b2-066-s006.whyLearn: While 加分词被动的省略式时间从句，比完整从句更书面，写叙事句值得模仿。

b2-086-s001.skeleton: the steering-wheel came away in his hands

modifiers.text: As the man tried to swing the speed-boat round

b2-086-s001.gloss: 快艇转弯时，方向盘从他手中脱落。
b2-086-s001.whyLearn: As引导时间状语从句，came away写出方向盘意外脱手的动作。

b2-086-s002.skeleton: He waved desperately to his companion

modifiers.text: who had been water-skiing for the last fifteen minutes

b2-086-s002.gloss: 他向同伴拼命挥手，同伴已滑水一刻钟。
b2-086-s002.whyLearn: 非限制性定语从句用过去完成进行时补充同伴滑水已久，衬托处境危险。

b2-086-s004.skeleton: The speed-boat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water

modifiers.text: to move very quickly across the water

b2-086-s004.gloss: 快艇撞上浮标，却仍在水面疾驰。
b2-086-s004.whyLearn: but连接两个并列分句，continued to do与had struck形成撞后仍不停的对比。

b2-086-s005.skeleton: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore
b2-086-s005.gloss: 两人刚开始向岸边游去。
b2-086-s005.whyLearn: begin后接不定式to swim，had just begun强调动作刚刚开始。

b2-086-s006.skeleton: when they noticed with dismay that the speed-boat was moving in a circle

modifiers.text: that the speed-boat was moving in a circle

b2-086-s006.gloss: 他们惊慌地发现快艇正绕圈行驶。
b2-086-s006.whyLearn: when引导时间状语从句，noticed后接that宾语从句，从句用过去进行时。

b2-086-s007.skeleton: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed
b2-086-s007.gloss: 它此刻正以惊人的速度直冲他们。
b2-086-s007.whyLearn: came towards与at tremendous speed连用，方位加程度写速度之快。

b2-086-s008.skeleton: it roared past them only a few feet away
b2-086-s008.gloss: 不到一分钟，船在几英尺外呼啸掠过。
b2-086-s008.whyLearn: less than写时间之短，a few feet away写距离之近，两处数量叠加惊险感。

b2-086-s010.skeleton: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger

modifiers.text: when the boat again completed a circle

b2-086-s010.gloss: 他们刚游离危险，船又转了一圈。
b2-086-s010.whyLearn: had enough time to do与when从句并用，写出刚脱险又遇险的紧迫。

b2-086-s011.gloss: 不过这一次，船已明显慢了下来。
b2-086-s011.whyLearn: however作插入语置于句中，与上一圈形成对比，过去完成时表已发生的变化。

b2-086-s012.skeleton: The petrol had nearly all been used up
b2-086-s012.whyLearn: 过去完成时的被动语态，nearly all插在助动词后写汽油几乎耗尽。

b2-086-s013.skeleton: the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water

modifiers.text: to drift gently across the water

b2-086-s013.gloss: 不久，响声全消，船缓缓漂流。
b2-086-s013.whyLearn: and并列两个过去时谓语，dropped与began to drift写出由动转静的过渡。

b2-087-s002.gloss: 那人说，是去伦敦的十点班车。
b2-087-s002.whyLearn: 引语内容前置、said the man倒装后置，是引述对话的典型语序。

b2-087-s005.whyLearn: 用do代替上文动词作简答，answered the man倒装承接引语。

b2-087-s006.skeleton: I must be at work at 10
b2-087-s006.whyLearn: must表必须，be at work是固定表达，两个at短语分别交代状态与时间。

b2-087-s009.skeleton: Would a later train get you to work on time
b2-087-s009.gloss: 晚一班的火车能让你准时上班吗？
b2-087-s009.whyLearn: Would提出试探性询问，get you to work on time问能否准点到岗。

b2-087-s014.skeleton: I bought a paper and waited for the train
b2-087-s014.gloss: 我买了份报纸，然后等火车。
b2-087-s014.whyLearn: and连接bought与waited两个并列谓语，按顺序叙述连续发生的动作。

b1-037-s013.skeleton: He opened the book and found a phrase
b1-037-s013.gloss: 他打开书，发现一个短语。
b1-037-s013.whyLearn: 两个过去式动词用 and 并列，构成连续动作，是叙述过去事件最基础的双谓语句型。

b1-038-s008.skeleton: my sister bought this pair last month
b1-038-s008.gloss: 我姐姐上个月买了这一双。
b1-038-s008.whyLearn: my 表所属、bought 用过去式、last month 点明过去时间，一句话里三件初级必会的事都齐了。

b1-038-s010.skeleton: she bought them in the U
b1-038-s010.whyLearn: 用代词 them 代替前文提到的 shoes，避免重复，是对话中很实用的回指技巧。

b1-038-s012.skeleton: We had some shoes like those a month ago
b1-038-s012.gloss: 一个月前我们有那样的鞋，现在没了。
b1-038-s012.whyLearn: 过去与现在对照，后半句用现在完成时省略 any 后的名词，可体会时态对比与省略。

b1-038-s015.skeleton: They were in fashion last year and the year before last
b1-038-s015.gloss: 它们去年和前年都流行。
b1-038-s015.whyLearn: in fashion 表示流行，两个过去时间用 and 并列，可学时间状语并列与过去时搭配。

b1-038-s016.skeleton: they're not in fashion this year
b1-038-s016.whyLearn: be not in fashion 否定形式和 this year 呼应上一句 last year，可体会今年与去年的对照。

b1-038-s017.skeleton: These shoes are in fashion now
b1-038-s017.whyLearn: 现在时 be in fashion 表示当下状态，与上一句过去式形成时态对比，适合练习时态切换。

b1-038-s020.gloss: 可女人总穿不舒服的鞋！
b1-038-s020.whyLearn: always 与一般现在时搭配表达习惯，形容词 uncomfortable 直接修饰名词，结构短却典型。

b1-039-s003.skeleton: I want to see the dentist
b1-039-s003.whyLearn: want to do 是最常用的动词不定式搭配，please 放句尾表示礼貌，就医场景高频。

b1-039-s012.skeleton: I must see the dentist now
b1-039-s012.gloss: 我现在必须看牙医，护士。
b1-039-s012.whyLearn: must 表示说话人自己认定的必要，比 have to 更强，适合体会情态动词的语气分量。

b1-039-s013.whyLearn: at the moment 等于 now，却更书面，是替换 now 的现成说法，值得直接记住。

b1-039-s016.skeleton: Can't the dentist see me now
b1-039-s016.gloss: 牙医现在不能给我看吗？
b1-039-s016.whyLearn: 否定疑问句 Can't... 用来表达急切请求，语气比 Can 更强烈，口语中很常见。

b1-039-s018.gloss: 你不能等到今天下午吗？
b1-039-s018.whyLearn: till 引出等待的截止时间，配合否定疑问句表示委婉催促，是排队场景的实用句型。

b1-040-s002.whyLearn: 现在进行时表示此刻正在做的事，shopping-list 是名词作定语构词的好例子。

b1-040-s004.skeleton: We need a lot of things
b1-040-s004.gloss: 这周我们需要买很多东西。
b1-040-s004.whyLearn: a lot of 后接可数复数，this week 作时间状语，一句话练数量表达和时间状语。

b1-040-s005.skeleton: I must go to the grocer's
b1-040-s005.whyLearn: must 表示当下必须做，grocer's 用所有格表示店铺，是英语里一类固定的店名说法。

b2-034-s004.skeleton: Ted wondered why he was wanted by the police, but he went to the station yesterday and now he is not worried any more.

modifiers.text: why he was wanted by the police
but he went to the station yesterday and now he is not worried any more.

b2-034-s004.gloss: Ted 不知警察为何通缉他，昨天去了警局，现在不再担心。
b2-034-s004.whyLearn: 同一句里 why 引导的间接疑问句内嵌被动语态，再用 but 并列三个时态，是学被动与从句衔接的好例子。

b2-034-s005.skeleton: he was told by a smiling policeman

modifiers.text: that his bicycle had been found.

b2-034-s005.gloss: 在警局，一位微笑的警察告诉他，他的自行车已被找到。
b2-034-s005.whyLearn: 被动语态带 by 施动者，后接 that 宾语从句且从句用过去完成被动，双层被动是中级精读必学的结构。

b2-034-s006.skeleton: the bicycle was picked up in a small village four hundred miles away.
b2-034-s006.gloss: 警察告诉他，五日前车在四百英里外的小村被找到。
b2-034-s006.whyLearn: 插入语把主句隔开，被动语态后又接介词短语和距离后置成分，一句话展示新闻叙述里常见的多重后置结构。

b2-034-s007.skeleton: It is now being sent to his home by train.
b2-034-s007.gloss: 它现在正被用火车送回他家。
b2-034-s007.whyLearn: 现在进行时的被动语态把时态与语态两个难点叠加，掌握 be being done 这一形式是关键。

b2-034-s008.gloss: Ted 听到这个消息时非常惊讶。
b2-034-s008.whyLearn: 主句是主语加系动词加形容词的简单结构，重点在 most 此处等于 very 的用法和 when 从句作时间状语。

b2-034-s010.skeleton: It was stolen twenty years ago

modifiers.text: when Ted was a boy of fifteen

b2-034-s010.gloss: 它是在二十年前 Ted 十五岁时被偷的。
b2-034-s010.whyLearn: 被动语态后接 ago 时间状语再由 when 从句补充具体年龄，a boy of fifteen 用 of 表年龄是常见搭配。

b2-035-s003.skeleton: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
b2-035-s003.gloss: 他觉得自己的新工作要有趣得多。
b2-035-s003.whyLearn: find 在此表示觉得，后接形容词作宾语补足语，far 用来加强比较级，与 very 的用法需区分。

b2-035-s005.skeleton: One of them was carrying a bag
b2-035-s005.gloss: 他们中有一个人拿着一个装满钱的包。
b2-035-s005.whyLearn: one of 加复数代词作主语时谓语用单数，full of money 是形容词短语后置修饰 bag，两个高频结构同现。

b2-035-s006.skeleton: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
b2-035-s006.gloss: Roy 迅速行动，开着公交车直冲那伙小偷。
b2-035-s006.whyLearn: and 连接两个并列谓语动词，动作有先后，straight at 是介词短语表示方向，简单句也能写出紧张节奏。

b2-035-s008.skeleton: Roy drove his bus into the back of it.

modifiers.text: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car,

b2-035-s008.gloss: 小偷们正试图开车逃跑时，Roy 把公交车撞上了车尾。
b2-035-s008.whyLearn: as 引导时间状语从句表示两事同时发生，是描写同时动作的常用句型，还含 try to do 与 get away。

b2-035-s010.skeleton: The thieves' car was badly damaged
b2-035-s010.gloss: 小偷的车损坏严重，很容易辨认。
b2-035-s010.whyLearn: 被动语态后并列一个形容词加不定式结构，easy to recognize 用主动形式表被动含义，值得专门记。

b2-035-s011.gloss: 不久之后警察拦下了那辆车，两名男子都被逮捕了。
b2-035-s011.whyLearn: and 并列主动与被动两种语态，被动句省略 by the police 而施动者不言自明，是新闻叙述的典型笔法。

b2-036-s003.skeleton: Erna is only fourteen years old

modifiers.text: and she hopes lo set up a new world record.
lo set up a new world record.

b2-036-s003.gloss: Erna 只有十四岁，她希望创造一项新的世界纪录。
b2-036-s003.whyLearn: and 连接并列句，后半句用 hope to do 表达愿望，only 强调年龄之小，是学 hope 句型的基础例句。

b2-036-s005.skeleton: Erna's father will set out with her
b2-036-s005.gloss: Erna 的父亲将和她一起乘一只小船出发。
b2-036-s005.whyLearn: will 表将来的计划，set out with 表示与某人一同出发，with her 交代同行者，结构简单但搭配实用。

b2-036-s006.skeleton: Mr Hart has trained his daughter
b2-036-s006.gloss: Hart 先生训练他的女儿已有多年。
b2-036-s006.whyLearn: 现在完成时配 for 加时间段，表示动作从过去持续至今，这是完成时最核心的用法之一，必须掌握。

b2-036-s007.skeleton: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously

modifiers.text: as she swims the long distance to England.

b2-036-s007.gloss: 明天她游向英国的长距离时，他会焦急地看着她。
b2-036-s007.whyLearn: 将来进行时描写明天某时正在发生的动作，as 引导同时性时间状语从句，从句用一般现在时表将来。

b2-080-s001.skeleton: the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century was the Crystal Palace

modifiers.text: which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851

b2-080-s001.gloss: 十九世纪最非凡的建筑是水晶宫
b2-080-s001.whyLearn: 主语很长时用 which 定语从句补充建造信息，是介绍历史建筑的典型句式

b2-080-s002.skeleton: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world

modifiers.text: for it was made of iron and glass

b2-080-s002.gloss: 水晶宫与世上其他建筑不同，因为它由铁和玻璃建成
b2-080-s002.whyLearn: be different from 后接 for 引导的原因分句，一句内完成对比与解释

b2-080-s004.skeleton: A great many goods were sent

modifiers.text: from various parts of the world

b2-080-s004.gloss: 大量货物从世界各地运到博览会
b2-080-s004.whyLearn: a great many 修饰可数名词复数，配被动语态说明货物的去向与来源

b2-080-s006.skeleton: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer
b2-080-s006.gloss: 展品中最精妙的机械是蒸汽锤
b2-080-s006.whyLearn: 最高级修饰长主语 piece of machinery，on show 作后置定语限定展品

b2-080-s008.skeleton: they were taken to the Crystal Palace by train
b2-080-s008.gloss: 他们一到英国就被火车送往水晶宫
b2-080-s008.whyLearn: on + doing 表示一……就，被动语态表明主语是动作的承受者

b2-080-s010.skeleton: the Crystal Palace was moved to South London
b2-080-s010.gloss: 后来水晶宫被迁往伦敦南部
b2-080-s010.whyLearn: 时间副词 Later 置句首，被动语态 was moved 客观陈述建筑的迁移

b2-081-s002.skeleton: he soon changed into the dead man's clothes
b2-081-s002.gloss: 他在黑暗中迅速换上死者的衣服
b2-081-s002.whyLearn: 现在分词短语作状语交代背景动作，主句用一般过去时推进情节

b2-081-s003.skeleton: the prisoner marched boldly up and down

modifiers.text: with a rifle over his shoulder

b2-081-s003.gloss: 囚犯身着蓝制服肩挎步枪，在营前大步走动
b2-081-s003.whyLearn: 分词短语与 with 复合结构并列作状语，密集铺陈人物外貌与装备

b2-081-s005.skeleton: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there

modifiers.text: and men were running here and there
they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped

b2-081-s005.gloss: 营中灯火通明，人们刚发现囚犯逃跑了
b2-081-s005.whyLearn: 过去进行时铺陈现场，过去完成时交代更早动作，冒号后补出原因

b2-081-s006.skeleton: a large black car with four officers inside it, stopped at the camp gates
b2-081-s006.gloss: 那一刻，一辆载着四名警官的黑车停在营门口
b2-081-s006.whyLearn: with 复合结构插在主语后作后置定语，长主语与谓语间须用逗号隔开

b2-081-s007.skeleton: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted

modifiers.text: and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted

b2-081-s007.gloss: 警官们下车，囚犯立正敬礼，目送他们经过
b2-081-s007.whyLearn: 多个 and 串联连续动作，末尾 as 从句点出同时发生的背景

b2-081-s009.skeleton: The man obviously wanted to talk
b2-081-s009.whyLearn: want 后接不定式作宾语，副词 obviously 插在主语与谓语之间

modifiers.text: with grey hair and clear blue eyes

b2-081-s010.gloss: 他相当年长，灰白头发，碧蓝眼睛
b2-081-s010.whyLearn: with 短语内并列两个名词补充外貌，不必另起一句，描写更紧凑

b2-081-s012.skeleton: the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow
b2-081-s012.gloss: 那人一走近，囚犯一拳把他打倒在地
b2-081-s012.whyLearn: as 引导时间状语从句与主句衔接紧凑，knock sb to the ground 很实用

b2-082-s001.gloss: 渔民和水手有时声称在海里见过怪物
b2-082-s001.whyLearn: claim to have done 用不定式完成式表示先于谓语的动，转述传闻常用

b2-082-s003.skeleton: unusual creatures are washed to the shore

modifiers.text: but they are rarely caught out at sea

b2-082-s003.gloss: 奇异生物偶尔被冲上岸，在海里却极少被捕获
b2-082-s003.whyLearn: 两个被动句用 but 对比，occasionally 与 rarely 形成频率反差

b4-047-s009.skeleton: His genuine passions are for literature and the philosophy of science and he would gladly spend all his time in studying them.
b4-047-s009.gloss: 他真正热爱的是文学和科学哲学。
b4-047-s009.whyLearn: would gladly spend…in doing 示范过去将来时加介词后动名词；passions are for 后接并列名词。

b4-047-s012.skeleton: they must step down into the arena and save the masses for themselves

modifiers.text: Since he and his kind are the only representatives of decency combined with intelligence

b4-047-s012.gloss: 他这类人必须下场去拯救大众。
b4-047-s012.whyLearn: Since 引出原因状语从句，主句用 must 表责任；combined with 是过去分词短语作后置定语。

b4-048-s001.skeleton: I have known very few writers

modifiers.text: but those I have known, and whom I respected,

b4-048-s001.gloss: 我认识的作家少之又少。
b4-048-s001.whyLearn: 两个定语从句并列修饰 writers，一个省略 whom，一个保留 whom，可直观对比。

b4-048-s005.skeleton: This organic process, often leading to moments of extraordinary self-discovery, is of an indescribable fascination.

modifiers.text: often leading to moments of extraordinary self-discovery

b4-048-s005.gloss: 这一过程自有难以言说的魅力。
b4-048-s005.whyLearn: 插入的分词短语用逗号隔开，删掉后主句 process is of…fascination 依然完整。

modifiers.text: he adds a brushstroke and another
but something was there, and he will not rest till he has captured it

b4-048-s006.gloss: 他不停落笔，直到抓住那模糊的影像。
b4-048-s006.whyLearn: 分号与 but 连接多个并列分句，till 引导时间状语从句，will not rest 与 has captured 对比时态。

b4-048-s007.skeleton: the yeast within a writer outlives a book
b4-048-s007.gloss: 有时作家的酵母比他的书活得更久。
b4-048-s007.whyLearn: outlives 后接省略了 that/which 的定语从句 he has written，现在完成时落在从句里。

modifiers.text: who read nothing but their own books
they stand before the mirror, and still cannot fathom the exact outline of the vision before them

b4-048-s008.gloss: 有些作家只读自己的书，如对镜自照。
b4-048-s008.whyLearn: hear of 后接 who 定语从句，nothing but 表“仅仅”，后面用 like 比喻再并列一个否定分句。

b4-048-s009.skeleton: writers talk interminably about their own books

modifiers.text: begging response from those around them

b4-048-s009.gloss: 作家们没完没了地谈论自己的书。
b4-048-s009.whyLearn: 三个并列的现在分词短语作伴随状语，逐层展开作家谈自己书时的具体举动。

b4-048-s010.skeleton: a writer doing this is misunderstood

modifiers.text: to explain a crime or a love affair
he might as well try to explain a crime or a love affair

b4-048-s010.gloss: 这样做的作家难免被误解。
b4-048-s010.whyLearn: doing this 是分词作后置定语；冒号后 might as well 表“倒不如”，后接动词原形。

b4-048-s011.skeleton: He is also, incidentally, an unforgivable bore.
b4-048-s011.gloss: 他还是个不可原谅的讨厌鬼。
b4-048-s011.whyLearn: 插入语 incidentally 用双逗号夹在 be 与表语之间，删掉后句子照样成立。

b4-049-s001.skeleton: Rockets and artificial satellites can go far above the ionosphere
b4-049-s001.gloss: 火箭和人造卫星能飞到电离层之上。
b4-049-s001.whyLearn: can 表能力，主语由 and 并列两个名词，and even 继续追加更强的动作。

b4-049-s003.skeleton: Balloons are much easier to handle
b4-049-s003.gloss: 气球操作起来容易得多，也便宜得多。
b4-049-s003.whyLearn: easier to handle 用不定式主动表被动，much 修饰比较级，and 并列第二个 be 表语。

modifiers.text: that they are incapable of rising to the ionosphere

b4-049-s004.gloss: 它们的主要局限是无法升到电离层。
b4-049-s004.whyLearn: be incapable of 后必须接动名词 rising；that 从句说明 limitation 的具体内容。

b4-049-s005.skeleton: A height of between 80,000 and 90,000 feet is as much as can reasonably be expected

modifiers.text: as much as can reasonably be expected
and so balloon-borne instruments can contribute little to either ultra-violet astronomy or X-ray astronomy
to either ultra-violet astronomy or X-ray astronomy

b4-049-s005.gloss: 八万到九万英尺已是合理上限。
b4-049-s005.whyLearn: as much as 引出可达到的极限，被动 can be expected，either…or 与 and so 层层并列。

b4-049-s007.skeleton: water-vapour and carbon dioxide in the lower air absorb most of the infra-red radiations

modifiers.text: sent to us from the planets

b4-049-s007.gloss: 低层空气里的水汽和二氧化碳吸收大部分红外辐射。
b4-049-s007.whyLearn: 主语是两个并列名词，sent to us 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 radiations。

b4-049-s008.gloss: 乘气球升空轻易避开了这个难题。
b4-049-s008.whyLearn: with ease 是介词短语作方式状语，相当于 easily；overcome 后直接带宾语 this hazard。

b3-051-s011.skeleton: an expert, on automation, Sir Leon Bagrit, pointed out

modifiers.text: that it was a mistake to believe that these machines could 'think'
to believe that these machines could 'think'

b3-051-s011.gloss: 专家指出，认为机器会思考是错误的。
b3-051-s011.whyLearn: 主语后插入介词短语和同位语，谓语再带that宾语从句，句中还嵌套不定式，长主语句式很典型。

modifiers.text: that human beings will be 'controlled by machines'

b3-051-s012.gloss: 人类受机器控制是不可能的。
b3-051-s012.whyLearn: possibility后接同位语从句说明具体内容，抽象名词加that从句是写作常用搭配。

modifiers.text: that in the future, computers would be developed which would be small enough to carry in the pocket
which would be small enough to carry in the pocket

b3-051-s015.gloss: 预言将来电脑小到能装进口袋。
b3-051-s015.whyLearn: 宾语从句内套定语从句，且从句与被修饰词被谓语隔开，正是长句理解的难点。

b3-051-s018.skeleton: people going on holiday could be informed about weather conditions; car drivers could be given alternative routes

modifiers.text: car drivers could be given alternative routes

b3-051-s018.gloss: 举例说，电脑可通知旅客天气、为司机另指路线。
b3-051-s018.whyLearn: 分号连接两个并列被动句，后句带when状语从句和there be，可练分层断句。

modifiers.text: to keep a check on a patient's health record and bring it up to date
and bring it up to date

b3-051-s024.gloss: 机器可用来核查并更新病人病历。
b3-051-s024.whyLearn: be used to do表示被用来做，与used to do过去习惯形近义远，此句正好对比辨析。

b3-052-s002.skeleton: an observant visitor would soon notice

modifiers.text: Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green
that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green
that it is filled with what looks like a thick greyish substance
with what looks like a thick greyish substance
what looks like a thick greyish substance

b3-052-s002.gloss: 尽管瓶子呈绿色，访客仍会看出里面是灰色稠物。
b3-052-s002.whyLearn: despite the fact that引让步，主句再套宾语从句与with宾语从句，多层嵌套值得精读。

b3-052-s009.skeleton: Harry used to consider it a great joke

modifiers.text: to go into expensive cosmetic shops and make outrageous requests for goods that do not exist
and make outrageous requests for goods that do not exist
for goods that do not exist

b3-052-s009.gloss: 哈里常把进高档化妆品店提怪要求当乐事。
b3-052-s009.whyLearn: it作形式宾语、真宾语后置的不定式，还带并列动词与定语从句，一句多考点。

modifiers.text: to be told that one of his imaginary products was temporarily out of stock
that one of his imaginary products was temporarily out of stock
and he would faithfully promise to call again at some future date
to call again at some future date
but of course he never did

b3-052-s013.gloss: 他爱听缺货的答复，还总许诺再来却从不兑现。
b3-052-s013.whyLearn: 三句并列加转折，含被动不定式与never did省略谓语，训练指代和省略理解。

modifiers.text: When the girl shook her head in bewilderment
to explain that 'myrolite' was a hard, amber-like substance which could be used to remove freckles
that 'myrolite' was a hard, amber-like substance which could be used to remove freckles
which could be used to remove freckles

b3-052-s018.gloss: 女孩困惑时，哈里解释myrolite可去雀斑。
b3-052-s018.whyLearn: 时间状语从句开场，主干后接不定式、宾语从句再套定语从句，是三层嵌套范本。

modifiers.text: to recognize that public officials like civil servants, collectors can make mistakes or act over-zealously in the belief that they are serving the public
that public officials like civil servants, collectors can make mistakes or act over-zealously in the belief that they are serving the public
in the belief that they are serving the public
that they are serving the public

b3-053-s005.gloss: 瑞典人最早承认公务员也会犯错或过激。
b3-053-s005.whyLearn: the first to do后接长宾语从句，句尾同位语从句解释belief，层层递进。

b3-053-s015.skeleton: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work

modifiers.text: for his correspondence is open to public inspection

b3-053-s015.gloss: 监察专员的工作不保密，信件公开可查。
b3-053-s015.whyLearn: there be加介词短语后接for并列分句说明原因，书面表达中很值得模仿。

b3-053-s020.skeleton: A foreigner living in a Swedish village wrote to the Ombudsman

modifiers.text: complaining that he had been ill-treated by the police
that he had been ill-treated by the police
simply because he was a foreigner

b3-053-s020.gloss: 住瑞典村庄的外国人投诉被警察虐待。
b3-053-s020.whyLearn: 现在分词一处作定语一处作状语，句尾because交代动机，叙事句经典写法。

b3-053-s022.skeleton: There was nothing in the record to show

modifiers.text: to show that the foreigner's complaint was justified
that the foreigner's complaint was justified
and the Chief of Police stoutly denied the accusation

b3-053-s022.gloss: 记录显示投诉不成立，警长断然否认指控。
b3-053-s022.whyLearn: there be后接不定式交代依据，再用and并列第二主句，信息组织清晰有力。

b3-053-s023.skeleton: It was impossible for the Ombudsman to take action

modifiers.text: for the Ombudsman to take action
but when he received a similar complaint from another foreigner in the same village, he immediately sent one of his lawyers to investigate the matter
when he received a similar complaint from another foreigner in the same village

b3-053-s023.gloss: 监察专员无权行动，收到类似投诉后派律师调查。
b3-053-s023.whyLearn: it作形式主语的for sb to do结构，与but引出的时间状语从句对照，句式有张力。

b3-053-s027.skeleton: The policeman in question was severely reprimanded

modifiers.text: and was informed that if any further complaints were lodged against him, he would be prosecuted
that if any further complaints were lodged against him, he would be prosecuted
if any further complaints were lodged against him

b3-053-s027.gloss: 该警察被严斥，并被警告再遭投诉就起诉。
b3-053-s027.whyLearn: 并列被动谓语后，宾语从句里再套条件状语从句与过去将来，层次分明。

modifiers.text: not only of unpleasant insects like spiders or wasps, but of quite harmless ones like moths
of unpleasant insects like spiders or wasps
of quite harmless ones like moths

b3-054-s005.gloss: 我们不但怕害虫，也怕飞蛾这类无害的虫子。
b3-054-s005.whyLearn: not only...but...并列两个of短语，介词搭配与避免重复的省略手法值得注意。

b4-035-s012.skeleton: various types of hovercraft have appeared and taken up regular service

modifiers.text: cruises on the Thames in London, for instance, have become an annual attraction.

b4-035-s012.gloss: 此后各类气垫船投入定班运营，泰晤士河游船成年度盛事
b4-035-s012.whyLearn: 用现在完成时串起气垫船从出现到定班运营的历程，破折号后另起分句举例，可学 since 起点与补充说明的衔接。

b4-035-s013.skeleton: we are only at the beginning of a development

modifiers.text: that may transport net-sea and land transport
at the beginning of a development

b4-035-s013.gloss: 我们才刚起步，这项发展或将改变海陆运输
b4-035-s013.whyLearn: 主句是主系表，that 从句修饰 development，情态动词 may 表推测，适合练限定从句与可能性的表达。

b4-036-s001.skeleton: Our knowledge of the oceans a hundred years ago was confined to the two-dimensio
b4-036-s001.gloss: 百年前人类对海洋的认识只限于二维
b4-036-s001.whyLearn: 主语后接 of 短语与过去时间状语，谓语用 was confined to 被动式，可学长主语的切分与所属限定。

b4-036-s003.skeleton: Sir James Clark Ross had obtained a sounding of over 2,400 fathoms in 1836

modifiers.text: butit was not until 1800, when H.

b4-036-s003.gloss: 罗斯1836年测深逾2400英寻，转折后另说突破
b4-036-s003.whyLearn: 前半句用过去完成时交代更早成果，but 引出 not until 与 when 从句，可学过时对照与转折推进。

b4-036-s007.whyLearn: 句首时间状语 Shortly after this 承接上文时间线，是叙事中衔接前后事件的常用开头。

b4-036-s010.skeleton: Challenger expedition established the study of the sea-floor

modifiers.text: as a subject worthy of the most qualified physicists and geologists
worthy of the most qualified physicists and geologists

b4-036-s010.gloss: 挑战者号考察让海底研究跻身顶尖学者的课题
b4-036-s010.whyLearn: establish A as B 说明学科地位，worthy of 后接最高级短语，可学用 as 短语评价事物价值。

modifiers.text: to enable a relief map of the Atlantic to be drawn
and we know something of the great variety of the sea-bed's topography.
of the great variety of the sea-bed's topography

b4-036-s012.gloss: 如今测深数据足以绘出大西洋地形图，海底地貌已知大概
b4-036-s012.whyLearn: enable ... to be drawn 是宾语加不定式被动的复合结构，与 and 并列的第二分句配合，可练不定式与被动结合。

modifiers.text: which stand nearly three miles above the floor of the open ocean
above the floor of the open ocean

b4-036-s014.gloss: 大陆是高出洋底近三英里的崎岖台地
b4-036-s014.whyLearn: which 从句补充高度数据，stand 加距离再加 above 的搭配典型，可学用从句量化说明地理特征。

b4-036-s016.skeleton: The real dividing-line between continents and oceans occurs at the foot of a steeper slope.

modifiers.text: at the foot of a steeper slope

b4-036-s016.gloss: 大陆与海洋的真正分界在陡坡脚下
b4-036-s016.whyLearn: dividing-line between A and B 与 at the foot of 连用，句子短而结构完整，适合练介词定位。

b4-036-s017.skeleton: This continental slope usually starts at a place somewhere near the ice-fathom mark

modifiers.text: at a place somewhere near the ice-fathom mark
and in the course of a few hundred miles reaches the true ocean-floor at 2,500-3,000 fathoms.
in the course of a few hundred miles

b4-036-s017.gloss: 大陆坡从约百英寻处起，延伸数百英里降至洋底
b4-036-s017.whyLearn: 同一主语带两个并列谓语，中间插入 in the course of 与数字范围，可学数量表达与长距离推进的写法。

modifiers.text: realizing that the greatest happiness accorded to man is that pr
that the greatest happiness accorded to man is that pr

b4-037-s001.gloss: 维多利亚人相信最大的幸福在于……
b4-037-s001.whyLearn: 主语后接 realizing 分词短语，其中 that 从句说明他们的信念，可学分词作状语与从句嵌套的写法。

b4-037-s003.skeleton: The Victorians would have considered it 'painful' or 'unpleasant'

modifiers.text: were one to point out that only four marriages out of every ten are anything but forced servitudes.
that only four marriages out of every ten are anything but forced servitudes.

b4-037-s003.gloss: 维多利亚人若被告知四成婚姻实为奴役，会斥之为痛苦
b4-037-s003.whyLearn: would have considered 表虚拟判断，were one to 是省略 if 的倒装条件句，可学虚拟语气的高级句式。

b4-037-s004.skeleton: We ourselves start from this very assumption

modifiers.text: and try to build from it a theory of more sensible relations between the sexes.
to build from it a theory of more sensible relations between the sexes
of more sensible relations between the sexes

b4-037-s004.gloss: 我们从这一假设出发，构建更合理的两性关系理论
b4-037-s004.whyLearn: 两个并列谓语共用主语，try to build 后带 from it 与 of 短语，可学如何说清抽象理论的构建。

b4-037-s006.skeleton: Truth, therefore, is an attitude of the mind.
b4-037-s006.gloss: 因此，真理性是心灵的一种态度
b4-037-s006.whyLearn: 短句用 therefore 插入语衔接上文，of the mind 限定 attitude，可学简洁下定义的写法。

modifiers.text: if one does not wish to inconvenience and to bore one's friends
to inconvenience and to bore one's friends

b4-037-s007.gloss: 若不想麻烦或烦扰朋友，就别说谎
b4-037-s007.whyLearn: It is important 后插入条件句，句末才出现真正主语 not to tell lies，可学外置主语与插入语序。

b4-037-s009.skeleton: The victorian habit of mind (which I consider to have been a bad habit of mind) was unduly preoccupied by what was socially and morally convenient.

modifiers.text: (which I consider to have been a bad habit of mind)
which I consider to have been a bad habit of mind
to have been a bad habit of mind
by what was socially and morally convenient
what was socially and morally convenient

b4-037-s009.gloss: 维多利亚式思维过度在意社交与道德上的便利
b4-037-s009.whyLearn: 主语后插括号评论，谓语用 be preoccupied by 加 what 从句，可学插入语与名词性从句并用的长句。

b3-020-s010.gloss: 他也在同一天带着一架新的安东妮特抵达加来附近。
b3-020-s010.whyLearn: 主语与谓语被插入语 too 隔开,再叠加三个介词短语交代地点、时间和方式,语序仍是英语的标准排列。

modifiers.text: as if there would be an exciting race across the Channel

b3-020-s011.gloss: 看起来海峡上将有一场激动人心的比赛。
b3-020-s011.whyLearn: look as if 后接 would 表推测,把 there be 句型装进状语从句,是预测未来事件的高频开头。

b3-020-s012.skeleton: Both planes were going to take off

modifiers.text: but Latham failed to get up early enough

b3-020-s012.gloss: 两架飞机原定7月25日起飞,但莱瑟姆没能早起。
b3-020-s012.whyLearn: be going to 表原定计划,fail to do 表未能做到,两种不定式结构一正一反写出赛前的意外。

b3-020-s013.skeleton: Bleriot set off half an hour later

modifiers.text: After making a short test flight

b3-020-s013.gloss: 凌晨四点一刻试飞后,布莱里奥半小时后出发。
b3-020-s013.whyLearn: after 接动名词把先发生的动作压进句首状语,主句只留关键动作,叙事因此干净利落。

b3-020-s014.skeleton: His great flight lasted thirty seven minutes.
b3-020-s014.gloss: 他这次伟大的飞行持续了三十七分钟。
b3-020-s014.whyLearn: last 后直接跟时间长度表示持续多久,是所有格 His 与一般过去时搭配的最简描述句。

modifiers.text: and got within half a mile of Dover
within half a mile of Dover

b3-020-s016.gloss: 莱瑟姆一周后再试,飞到离多佛半英里处,又失败了。
b3-020-s016.whyLearn: 三件事靠 and、but 顺次连接,一句之内完成尝试、接近目标、再度失败的全过程。

modifiers.text: and he landed on the sea for the second time

b3-020-s017.gloss: 他的引擎失灵,他第二次落在海面上。
b3-020-s017.whyLearn: 两个短句以 and 并列,一因一果,是英语叙述事故时最省力的句式。

b3-021-s001.gloss: 两百年前拳击比赛在英格兰非常流行。
b3-021-s001.whyLearn: 主系表骨架后面依次加地点和时间,用 years ago 谈旧日风俗,结构短小却五脏俱全。

b3-021-s002.gloss: 那时拳手赤手空拳为奖金而战。
b3-021-s002.whyLearn: 三个介词短语分别交代时间、方式和目的,一句话就勾勒出那个年代的拳台面貌。

b3-021-s007.skeleton: Mendoza did much to change crude prize-fighting into a sport

modifiers.text: Though he was technically a prize-fighter
to change crude prize-fighting into a sport
for he brought science to the game

b3-021-s007.gloss: 门多萨虽是职业拳手,却把粗野拳击变成一项运动。
b3-021-s007.whyLearn: 让步从句先退一步,for 原因分句再给理由,中间用不定式点明贡献,评价因此周全有力。

b3-021-s008.gloss: 在他那个年代,门多萨极其受欢迎。
b3-021-s008.whyLearn: In his day 是比 at that time 更地道的时间状语,可用来谈人物当年的境况。

b3-021-s009.skeleton: He was adored by rich and poor alike.
b3-021-s009.gloss: 他受到富人和穷人同样的爱戴。
b3-021-s009.whyLearn: 被动语态省去 the,用 rich and poor alike 概括全体人群,一句话写尽声望。

modifiers.text: when he was only fourteen years old

b3-021-s010.gloss: 一场拳赛之后,门多萨迅速成名,年仅十四岁。
b3-021-s010.whyLearn: when 从句补出年龄,把成名这一结果落到具体的时间与条件上,信息格外具体。

b3-021-s011.skeleton: This attracted the attention of Richard Humphries

modifiers.text: who was then the most eminent boxer in England

b3-021-s011.gloss: 这引起了当时英国最著名拳手汉弗莱斯的注意。
b3-021-s011.whyLearn: 定语从句紧跟人名补充身份,介绍人物时不必另起一句,还能顺带用上最高级。

modifiers.text: and his young pupil was quick to learn

b3-021-s012.gloss: 他主动提出训练门多萨,这个年轻学生学得很快。
b3-021-s012.whyLearn: offer to do 与 be quick to do 两个不定式结构前后呼应,一句写清教导与天赋。

modifiers.text: and it was clear that the argument could only be settled by a fight
that the argument could only be settled by a fight

b3-021-s014.gloss: 两人激烈争吵,显然只能靠一场拳赛来解决。
b3-021-s014.whyLearn: it was clear that 加被动语态 could be settled,冷静陈述结果,与前半句的争吵形成反差。

b4-018-s002.skeleton: One is the general atmosphere of secrecy

modifiers.text: in which it is carried out
the other the lack of freedom of the individual research worker

b4-018-s002.gloss: 一是研究的保密氛围，二是研究者缺乏自由。
b4-018-s002.whyLearn: One 与 the other 对称列举两点，后者省去重复的 is；in which 从句把“如何实施”接在名词后面。

b4-018-s004.skeleton: The degree of secrecy naturally varies considerably.
b4-018-s004.gloss: 保密的程度自然差异很大。
b4-018-s004.whyLearn: 主语是带 of 短语的名词，谓语前插 naturally、后接 considerably，展示修饰语把主谓夹在中间的常态。

b4-018-s008.skeleton: This applies particularly to chemical industries

modifiers.text: where chance discoveries play a much larger part than they do in physical and mechanical industries

b4-018-s008.gloss: 这尤其适用于化学工业，那儿偶然发现作用更大。
b4-018-s008.whyLearn: 逗号后 where 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明，再用 than they do 的比较结构避免重复谓语，书面语很常见。

b4-019-s001.gloss: 绅士在于身份，而不在于做事。
b4-019-s001.whyLearn: is 与 does 对照，rather than 连接两个谓语动词，一句话点出“是”与“做”的区别，极短好记。

b4-019-s002.gloss: 他对任何事都没有职业意义上的兴趣。
b4-019-s002.whyLearn: be interested in 是高频搭配，nothing 作介词宾语，in a professional way 限定范围。

b4-019-s003.skeleton: He is allowed to cultivate hobbies

modifiers.text: but must not practise a vocation

b4-019-s003.gloss: 他可以养爱好甚至怪癖，却不能以此为业。
b4-019-s003.whyLearn: 被动 be allowed to 与情态 must not 由 but 并列，后一分句承前省略主语，是“一许一禁”的典型写法。

modifiers.text: how to ride and shoot and cast a fly
and shoot and cast a fly

b4-019-s004.gloss: 他必须会骑马、打枪和甩竿钓鱼。
b4-019-s004.whyLearn: 情态动词后接“疑问词 how + 不定式”作宾语，三个动词用 and 平列，是间接疑问句最简形式。

modifiers.text: at least one connection in the diplomatic service

b4-019-s005.gloss: 他该有陆海军亲属，还有一位外交界关系。
b4-019-s005.whyLearn: should 表“理应”，and 并列两个宾语，at least 修饰数量，简单句就把绅士的社会关系交代清楚。

modifiers.text: about how foreign countries are governed

b4-019-s007.gloss: 他不懂政治经济学，对外国政体知道得更少。
b4-019-s007.whyLearn: knows nothing 与 less 用 and 并列，比较级后省略重复谓语，how 从句作介词 about 的宾语。

b4-019-s008.gloss: 他不尊重学问，更喜爱“运动”。
b4-019-s008.whyLearn: 否定谓语与肯定谓语由 and 并列共用主语，注意 does not 后用原形、prefers 用第三人称单数。

b4-019-s009.skeleton: The problem set for society is not the virtues of the type

modifiers.text: so much as its adequacy for its function

b4-019-s009.gloss: 社会要问的不是绅士的品德，而是他是否称职。
b4-019-s009.whyLearn: not...so much as 构成比较式否定，把评价重点移到后项；再用 and 接新分句推进，议论文常见。

b4-019-s010.skeleton: He refuses to consider sufficiently the wants of the customer

modifiers.text: who must buy, not the thing he desires but the thing the English gentleman wants to sell
not the thing he desires but the thing the English gentleman wants to sell

b4-019-s010.gloss: 他不充分考虑顾客需求，顾客只能买绅士想卖的。
b4-019-s010.whyLearn: refuse to do 后带长宾语，who 定语从句内再套 not...but 对比，说明从句能容纳完整语义。

b4-019-s011.skeleton: He attends inadequately to technological development.
b4-019-s011.gloss: 他对技术发展关注得很不够。
b4-019-s011.whyLearn: 副词 inadequately 插在动词与介词之间修饰整个动作，attends to 表“致力于”，语序值得留意。

b4-019-s012.skeleton: he is passionately devoted to excessive secrecy

modifiers.text: Disbelieving in the necessity of large-scale production in the modern world
both in finance and method of production
in finance and method of production

b4-019-s012.gloss: 他不信大规模生产有必要，却热衷过度保密。
b4-019-s012.whyLearn: 现在分词短语置于句首作原因状语，主句用 be devoted to；句尾 both...and 把保密范围收成一对。

b4-019-s013.skeleton: He has an incurable and widespread nepotism in appointment

modifiers.text: discounting ability and relying upon a mystic entity called 'character,'
which means, in a gentleman's mouth, the qualities he traditionally possesses himself

b4-019-s013.gloss: 他用人任人唯亲，轻视能力，只信所谓“品格”。
b4-019-s013.whyLearn: 主句后接两个并列分词补充说明，再用 which 从句加插入语逐层解释 character，长句全靠标点分层。

b4-019-s014.skeleton: His lack of imagination and the narrowness of his social loyalties have ranged against him one of the fundamental estates of the realm.

modifiers.text: one of the fundamental estates of the realm

b4-019-s014.gloss: 他缺乏想象、忠诚狭隘，招来一个基本阶层的反对。
b4-019-s014.whyLearn: 主语由两个带 of 所有格的名词并列，现在完成时里 range 的宾语后置到 against him 之后，语序特殊。

b3-048-s018.skeleton: The place consisted of a straggling unmade road

modifiers.text: which was lined on either side by small houses

b3-048-s018.gloss: 那地方只有一条荒草丛生的未铺路面的路
b3-048-s018.whyLearn: consist of 引出构成，which 从句补充路两旁，was lined 被动使描写客观。

modifiers.text: Even under a clear blue sky
as all the houses were built of grey mud bricks

b3-048-s019.gloss: 即使在蓝天下，村子仍显得阴森可怕
b3-048-s019.whyLearn: Even under 让步短语前置形成反差，as 引出原因，look forbidding 写观感。

modifiers.text: the only sign of life being an ugly-looking black goat tied to a tree on a short length ofrope in a field nearby
tied to a tree on a short length ofrope in a field nearby

b3-048-s020.gloss: 村子似乎荒无人烟，只剩一只山羊
b3-048-s020.whyLearn: 独立主格 being 补出唯一生机，过去分词 tied 再作定语，介词链层层定位。

b3-048-s021.skeleton: we opened a couple of tins of sardines and had a picnic lunch

modifiers.text: Sitting down on a dilapidated wooden fence near the field

b3-048-s021.gloss: 我们在破木栏上坐下吃沙丁鱼罐头
b3-048-s021.whyLearn: 现在分词短语前置表伴随动作，主句 opened 与 had 并列，叙事连贯可仿写。

b3-048-s023.skeleton: I saw that we were surrounded by children in rags

modifiers.text: who were looking at us silently

b3-048-s023.gloss: 抬头一看，我们被一群衣衫褴褛的孩子围着
b3-048-s023.whyLearn: 分词状语加宾语从句、被动、定语从句与 as 时间从句，四层嵌套信息密集。

b3-048-s024.skeleton: We offered them food and spoke to them kindly
b3-048-s024.gloss: 我们送食物又和气搭话，他们却一动不动
b3-048-s024.whyLearn: and 连两个动作，but 转出反差结果，remained 后接形容词写状态。

modifiers.text: that they were simply shy of strangers

b3-048-s025.whyLearn: conclude 后接 that 宾语从句表推断，simply 让判断语气克制。

b3-048-s027.skeleton: The village which had seemed deserted, immediately came to life.
b3-048-s027.gloss: 原本死寂的村子顿时活了起来
b3-048-s027.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语后面，had seemed 与 came to life 对照写出转变。

b3-048-s029.skeleton: Men in shirt sleeves stood outside their houses
b3-048-s029.gloss: 男人们站在自家屋外怒视我们
b3-048-s029.whyLearn: in shirt sleeves 后置修饰 men，stood 与 glared 并列推进画面。

b3-048-s030.skeleton: Old women in black shawls peered at us
b3-048-s030.gloss: 披黑披肩的老妇人从门口盯着我们
b3-048-s030.whyLearn: in black shawls 后置修饰人，from door-ways 交代方位，一句写出群像。

b3-048-s031.skeleton: The most frightening thing of all was

modifiers.text: that not a sound could be heard

b3-048-s031.gloss: 最可怕的是听不到一点声音
b3-048-s031.whyLearn: 最高级主语加 that 表语从句，情态被动 could be heard 写出死寂。

b3-048-s034.skeleton: we quickened our pace and made our way rapidly towards the stream

modifiers.text: Turning back down the main street
and made our way rapidly towards the stream where we hoped the boatman was waiting
where we hoped the boatman was waiting

b3-048-s034.gloss: 我们转身加快脚步，赶往船夫等候的小溪
b3-048-s034.whyLearn: 分词短语开句，quickened 与 made one's way 并列，where 从句收尾交目的地。

b3-049-s002.skeleton: she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation

modifiers.text: on her favourite topic of conversation

b3-049-s002.gloss: 她若活到今天，就不能再谈佣人话题
b3-049-s002.whyLearn: were 加 would 的虚拟条件句表与现在相反，冒号后同位语点明话题。

b3-049-s003.skeleton: Aunt Harriet lived in thatleisurely age

modifiers.text: when servants were employed to do housework

b3-049-s003.gloss: 哈丽特姑妈生活在雇人做家务的年代
b3-049-s003.whyLearn: when 从句修饰 age，were employed to do 用被动加不定式交代时代背景。

b3-049-s004.skeleton: She had a huge, rambling country house
b3-049-s004.gloss: 她有一所叫“山墙”的大乡间宅子
b3-049-s004.whyLearn: 过去分词 called 作后置定语引出宅名，rambling 让房子自带画面。

b3-049-s005.skeleton: She was sentimentally attached to this house

modifiers.text: for even though it was fartoo big for her needs, she persisted in living there long after her husband's death
even though it was fartoo big for her needs

b3-049-s005.gloss: 她依恋这宅子，丈夫去世后仍住着不走
b3-049-s005.whyLearn: for 引出原因，even though 让步与 long after 时间层层嵌套，persist in doing。

b1-045-s019.gloss: 希尔先生喜欢这房子，但还没拿定主意。
b1-045-s019.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列谓语，先肯定再转折，是表达犹豫时最常用的句式。

modifiers.text: that they will move in the day after tomorrow

b1-046-s016.gloss: 布朗太太认为他们后天搬家。
b1-046-s016.whyLearn: that 引导宾语从句，从句用 will 表将来，时间状语放句尾。

b1-048-s012.whyLearn: there be 句型说某处存在某物，地点用介词短语跟在名词后。

b1-049-s002.gloss: 服务员问：您能描述一下它吗？
b1-049-s002.whyLearn: 情态动词 can 提到句首构成一般疑问句，称呼语 sir 放句尾。

modifiers.text: with my name and address on it

b1-049-s004.gloss: 把手上有个标签，上面写着我的姓名和地址。
b1-049-s004.whyLearn: there be 后连用两个介词短语，分别说明位置和附着的内容。

b1-049-s007.whyLearn: What about...? 是询问看法的省略问句，口语里极常用。

b1-050-s006.gloss: 我觉得自己把背弄伤了。
b1-050-s006.whyLearn: 宾语从句用现在完成时，强调受伤对现在造成的影响。

b1-050-s008.whyLearn: stand up 是动词短语，情态动词 can 置于句首提问。

b1-050-s012.whyLearn: I'm afraid that... 委婉说出坏消息，从句说明担心的事。

modifiers.text: that the doctor had better see you

b1-050-s013.gloss: 帕特觉得最好让医生给你看看。
b1-050-s013.whyLearn: had better 表建议，后接动词原形，嵌在宾语从句中转述建议。

b1-051-s020.whyLearn: afraid 后省略 that 接从句，can't 表能力上做不到。

b1-051-s026.gloss: 他没法在卡片上写很多字。
b1-051-s026.whyLearn: very much 修饰动词表程度，介词短语说明书写的处所。

modifiers.text: I passed in English and Mathematics

b1-052-s003.gloss: 我想我英语和数学都及格了。
b1-052-s003.whyLearn: think 后省略 that 接宾语从句，passed in 表示某科目及格。

b1-052-s005.whyLearn: How about you? 是反问对方的省略句，人名放句末作呼语。

b1-052-s008.gloss: 迪克觉得自己智力测验没通过。
b1-052-s008.whyLearn: 省略 that 的宾语从句，fail 后直接接考试名称表未通过。

b1-052-s011.gloss: 可剩下的题我都答不上来。
b1-052-s011.whyLearn: couldn't 表过去的能力不足，the rest 指剩余的题目。

b4-041-s007.skeleton: wewould have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable

modifiers.text: If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past

b4-041-s007.gloss: 若教育照搬无书的过去，大学将最民主
b4-041-s007.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句用were fashioned表与过去相反，主句接最高级，imaginable后置修饰。

modifiers.text: which only our most progressive forms of modern education try to regain

b4-041-s009.gloss: 平等起点是理想状态，进步教育想恢复它
b4-041-s009.whyLearn: It is...which结构突出唯一理想；定语从句里only...try to regain点明谁在努力恢复。

b4-041-s010.skeleton: the obligation to seek and to receive the traditional instruction is binding to all

modifiers.text: to seek and to receive the traditional instruction

b4-041-s010.gloss: 原始文化里人人必须接受传统教导
b4-041-s010.whyLearn: 主语后接两个并列不定式说明义务内容，binding to all表对所有人都有约束力。

b4-041-s013.skeleton: Education in the wilderness is not a matter of monetary means
b4-041-s013.gloss: 荒野中的教育无关金钱手段
b4-041-s013.whyLearn: not a matter of简洁否定金钱决定论，两个介词短语分层限定education。

b4-041-s014.skeleton: All are entitled to an equal start
b4-041-s014.gloss: 所有人都有权获得平等起点
b4-041-s014.whyLearn: be entitled to是被动语态表权利的固定说法，句式极短却可直接套用。

b4-041-s016.skeleton: a child grows up under the ever-present attention of his parents

modifiers.text: under the ever-present attention of his parents
therefore the jungles and the savannahs know of no 'juvenile delinquency.'

b4-041-s016.gloss: 孩子受父母时刻照看，丛林里没有青少年犯罪
b4-041-s016.whyLearn: therefore前用逗号连接两个独立分句，体现书面语中因果的自然衔接。

b4-041-s017.skeleton: No necessity of making a living away from home results in neglect of children

modifiers.text: of making a living away from home
and no father is confronted with his inability to 'buy' an education for his child.
to 'buy' an education for his child

b4-041-s017.gloss: 无须离家谋生，父亲不必为孩子买教育
b4-041-s017.whyLearn: 两个no开头的分句层层排除外部压力，of making a living展示介词后接动名词。

modifiers.text: when their children praise the homes of their friends

b4-042-s001.gloss: 孩子夸朋友家时，父母常会不高兴
b4-042-s001.whyLearn: when引导时间状语从句配be upset，主句表被动情绪，是日常高频句式。

b4-042-s002.skeleton: They may even accuse them of disloyalty

modifiers.text: or make some spiteful remark about the friends' parents.

b4-042-s002.gloss: 他们可能指责孩子不忠或贬损朋友父母
b4-042-s002.whyLearn: or并列两个谓语动词，accuse sb of与make a remark about都是实用搭配。

b4-042-s005.skeleton: Disillusionment with the parents, however good and adequate they may be both as parents and as individuals, is to some degree inevitable.

modifiers.text: however good and adequate they may be both as parents and as individuals
both as parents and as individuals

b4-042-s005.gloss: 父母再好，孩子的失望也难免
b4-042-s005.whyLearn: however加形容词引导让步从句插入主谓之间，is inevitable落到冷静结论。

b4-042-s010.skeleton: What the child cannot forgive is the parents' refusal to admit these charges

modifiers.text: if the child knows them to be true

b4-042-s010.gloss: 孩子无法原谅的是父母拒不认错
b4-042-s010.whyLearn: What引导主语从句作主语，refusal后用不定式补足内容，再加if条件层层推进。

b4-042-s013.skeleton: It is always wiser and safer to face up to reality

modifiers.text: however painful it may be at the moment

b4-042-s013.gloss: 直面现实更明智，无论当下多痛苦
b4-042-s013.whyLearn: It作形式主语、不定式作真主语，however加形容词引导让步状语从句。

b4-043-s001.skeleton: Faith in controlled nuclear fission is now being shown
b4-043-s001.gloss: 对受控核裂变的信心正由建设体现
b4-043-s001.whyLearn: is being shown是进行时被动，表信心正持续显现，Faith in是常见名词搭配。

b4-043-s002.skeleton: Calder Hall on the coast of Cumberland first made its contribution to the National Electricity grid in 1957.
b4-043-s002.gloss: 1957年考尔德豪尔首次向国家电网供电
b4-043-s002.whyLearn: 多个介词短语依次交代地点、对象与时间，是叙事句的典型排布方式。

b4-043-s003.skeleton: a chain of nuclear power stations was planned
b4-043-s003.gloss: 随后规划了一连串核电站
b4-043-s003.whyLearn: a chain of表一连串，被动was planned隐去规划者，突出事件本身。

b4-043-s004.skeleton: they are sited near the coasts or tidal water

modifiers.text: near the coasts or tidal water
because of the need of much water for cooling and a certain discharge of possible radioactive effluent.

b4-043-s004.gloss: 核电站须建在近水处便于冷却排污
b4-043-s004.whyLearn: because of后接名词短语说明原因，near...or...并列地点，全靠介词链串因果。

modifiers.text: and the muzzles peeped wickedly from them

b4-033-s013.gloss: 炮门全开，炮口从中阴森地探出。
b4-033-s013.whyLearn: and 并列静态描写与拟人动词 peeped，两个小句就把备战气氛写活。

modifiers.text: and the ship made a strange movement

grammarRefs: 倒装 · 地点状语前置
b4-033-s014.gloss: 风势增强，突来一阵狂风，船身怪异地倾侧向左。
b4-033-s014.whyLearn: there came 引出突发事件，as 从句交代起因，listing 分词收尾，节奏可模仿。

b4-033-s015.skeleton: The Ordnance Officer ordered all the port cannon to be heaved to starboard

modifiers.text: but the steepening angle of the decks increased

b4-033-s015.gloss: 炮官命左舷炮移向右舷抵消倾斜，但甲板倾角更大了。
b4-033-s015.whyLearn: ordered sth to be heaved 是被动不定式作宾补，to counteract 表目的，but 转折写努力落空。

b4-033-s017.skeleton: The lower gun-ports were now below water

modifiers.text: and the inrush sealed the ship's fate

b4-033-s017.gloss: 下层炮门已没入水中，涌进的海水注定了船沉没。
b4-033-s017.whyLearn: and 把物理事实与 sealed the ship's fate 的判决式隐喻并置，写出不可逆的后果。

b4-034-s005.skeleton: the bottle, the box, and the jar are almost always granted them

modifiers.text: the bottle, the box, and the jar

b4-034-s005.gloss: 瓶子、盒子与罐子几乎总会赏给他们。
b4-034-s005.whyLearn: 三个名词并列作主语，被动句中 almost always 摆在 are 之后，可学副词的位置。

modifiers.text: whether his friend accepted his medical help
but in all probability he did

b4-034-s009.gloss: 史书没写他朋友是否接受治疗，但很可能接受了。
b4-034-s009.whyLearn: 否定主句加 whether 从句留悬，but in all probability he did 用代动词收尾，很地道。

b4-035-s001.skeleton: Many strange new means of transport have been developed
b4-035-s001.gloss: 本世纪发展出许多奇特的新型运输工具。
b4-035-s001.whyLearn: 现在完成时被动表“迄今已被发展出”，of transport 后置限定 means，适合科技综述。

modifiers.text: of supporting a craft on a' pad ', or cushion, of low-pressure air
ringed with a curtain of higher pressure air

b4-035-s003.gloss: 构想是让船托在低压气垫上，外圈围着高压气帘。
b4-035-s003.whyLearn: It was the idea of 加动名词先给核心，再用 or cushion 同位语和 ringed 分词补细节。

b4-035-s004.skeleton: people have had difficulty in deciding

modifiers.text: in deciding whether the craft should be ranged among ships, planes, or land vehicles
whether the craft should be ranged among ships, planes, or land vehicles
among ships, planes, or land vehicles
for it is something in between a boat and an aircraft

b4-035-s004.gloss: 此后人们难以判定它算船、飞机还是陆上车辆。
b4-035-s004.whyLearn: have had difficulty in deciding 后接 whether 从句，再用 for 分句解释原因，是争论式论述的骨架。

b4-035-s005.skeleton: Cockerell was trying to find a solution

modifiers.text: to find a solution to the problem of the wave resistance
to the problem of the wave resistance
which wastes a good deal of a surface ship's power and limits its speed

b4-035-s005.gloss: 身为造船师，科克雷尔想解决兴波阻力的问题。
b4-035-s005.whyLearn: was trying to find 表持续攻关，which 从句说明阻力如何耗功率、限速度，学术叙述典型。

b4-035-s006.skeleton: His answer was to lift the vessel out of the water

modifiers.text: by making it ride on a cushion of air
no more than one or two feet thick

b4-035-s006.gloss: 他的办法是让船浮在气垫上离开水面。
b4-035-s006.whyLearn: was to lift 提出方案，by making it ride 交代手段，末尾补气垫厚度，层层收紧。

modifiers.text: by a great number of ring-shaped air jets
on the bottom of the craft

b4-035-s007.gloss: 这是靠船底大量环形喷气孔完成的。
b4-035-s007.whyLearn: 被动语态配 by 引出手段，再用 on/of 介词短语精确定位，科技说明文的典型写法。

modifiers.text: its action de- pends on the surface, water or ground, over which it rides

b4-035-s008.gloss: 它能“飞”，却不能飞更高，要靠下方的水面或地面。
b4-035-s008.whyLearn: but 转折后用破折号补原因，over which 从句说明依托的表面，逻辑一步不松。

b4-035-s009.skeleton: The first tests on the Solent in 1959 caused a sensation
b4-035-s009.gloss: 1959年索伦特海峡的首次试验引起轰动。
b4-035-s009.whyLearn: 两个介词短语依次限定地点与时间，再用 caused a sensation 收束，是新闻式笔法。

b4-035-s010.skeleton: The hovercraft travelled first over the water

modifiers.text: then mounted the beach, climbed up the dunes, and sat down on a road

b4-035-s010.gloss: 气垫船先过水面，再上海滩、爬沙丘，最后停在路上。
b4-035-s010.whyLearn: 过去式动词按 then、and 串成行程链，四个动作动词让描写有推进感。

b4-035-s011.gloss: 后来它横渡英吉利海峡，平稳滑过波浪。
b4-035-s011.whyLearn: 主句后接 riding 分词描写姿态，which 从句轻补评价，主次分明的叙事。

b2-068-s006.skeleton: I had to think of a way

modifiers.text: of preventing him from following me around all morning

b2-068-s006.gloss: 我得想办法不让他整个上午跟着我。
b2-068-s006.whyLearn: 一句串起 have to、a way of doing 和 prevent sb from doing，练不定式与介词后 -ing。

b2-068-s010.skeleton: I was just wondering how to spend the morning
b2-068-s010.gloss: 我正琢磨上午怎么过，直到看见你。
b2-068-s010.whyLearn: wonder how to do 是口语常用结构，until 从句点出时间转折。

b2-068-s011.whyLearn: be busy doing 与反意疑问句同现，口语中常用来确认对方是否有空。

b2-068-s012.whyLearn: not at all 是最常用的否定回应，引语前置、主句后置的语序值得记。

b2-068-s015.gloss: 我话还没说完，他就问了。
b2-068-s015.whyLearn: before 从句用过去完成时，突出没等我说完的时间差。

b2-068-s017.gloss: 他回答：那我跟你一起去。
b2-068-s017.whyLearn: come with sb 表随行，引语前置加 he answered 后置，叙事对话典型句式。

b2-069-s002.skeleton: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic
b2-069-s002.gloss: 我曾被要求在拥堵车流中开车并做到了。
b2-069-s002.whyLearn: had been asked 与并列谓语 had done so 共用助动词，两个动作一气呵成。

modifiers.text: After having been instructed to drive out of town

b2-069-s003.gloss: 被指示开出城后，我开始有了信心。
b2-069-s003.whyLearn: after 加完成被动动名词把时间先后压进短语，主句只留 began to do。

b2-069-s004.skeleton: I was almost beginning to enjoy my test
b2-069-s004.gloss: 确信已过关，我几乎开始享受考试。
b2-069-s004.whyLearn: 句首形容词短语 Sure that... 作原因状语，比 because 从句更紧凑。

b2-069-s005.skeleton: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance

modifiers.text: for he smiled and said, 'Just one more thing, Mr Eames.

b2-069-s005.gloss: 考官想必满意我的表现，他笑着又说了一件事。
b2-069-s005.whyLearn: must have been pleased 表对过去的肯定推测，for 引出的原因更书面。

modifiers.text: and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.

b2-069-s008.gloss: 我继续开车，过一会儿考官大声敲了敲。
b2-069-s008.whyLearn: continue doing 后接动名词，并列句插入 after some time 转换场景。

b2-069-s010.skeleton: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard

modifiers.text: and we were both thrown forward.

b2-069-s010.gloss: 我突然猛踩刹车，我俩都向前冲去。
b2-069-s010.whyLearn: press the brake hard 是驾驶场景高频搭配，被动 were thrown 写后果。

b2-069-s011.skeleton: The examiner looked at me sadly
b2-069-s011.whyLearn: look at sb 加副词 sadly，一词写尽考官表情，副词位置标准。

modifiers.text: ' you have just killed that child !'

b2-069-s012.gloss: 他声音哀伤地说：你刚刚撞死了那孩子。
b2-069-s012.whyLearn: in a mournful voice 描写说话方式，引语用现在完成时强调刚发生。

b2-070-s001.skeleton: a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring

modifiers.text: into the middle of the ring

b2-070-s001.gloss: 斗牛时，一个醉汉突然晃进场地中央。
b2-070-s001.whyLearn: 地点状语 During a bullfight 前置，主干用 wandered into 写移动。

modifiers.text: but the drunk was unaware of the danger.

b2-070-s002.gloss: 人群开始喊叫，醉汉却没察觉危险。
b2-070-s002.whyLearn: begin to do 与 be unaware of 都常考，but 并列句制造反差。

b3-047-s005.skeleton: Drilling a hole under the sea has proved to be even more difficult.
b3-047-s005.gloss: 在海底钻孔已被证明更加困难。
b3-047-s005.whyLearn: 主语用动名词短语，谓语是现在完成时has proved，后接不定式to be作补语，三种结构叠用。

b3-047-s006.skeleton: The deepest hole bored under sea has been about 20,000 feet.
b3-047-s006.gloss: 在海下钻的最深的孔约两万英尺。
b3-047-s006.whyLearn: 最高级deepest加过去分词bored under sea作后置定语，谓语用现在完成时，可学后置定语的压缩写法。

b3-047-s007.skeleton: scientists have been unable to devise a drill

modifiers.text: which would be capable of cutting through hard rock at great depths

b3-047-s007.gloss: 直到最近，科学家仍无法造出钻穿深处硬岩的钻头。
b3-047-s007.whyLearn: 主句用have been unable to加不定式，which从句里would be capable of后接动名词，三处结构连考。

b3-047-s008.skeleton: This problem has now been solved.
b3-047-s008.gloss: 这个问题现在已经解决了。
b3-047-s008.whyLearn: 七词短句却把现在完成时和被动语态叠成has been solved，适合直接记这个高频组合。

b3-047-s009.gloss: 科学家发明了一种听起来简单得惊人的方法。
b3-047-s009.whyLearn: which指代method作从句主语，sounds后接形容词simple，可练定语从句与感官动词的搭配。

modifiers.text: As the diamond tip of the drill revolves

b3-047-s011.gloss: 钻头钻石尖端旋转时，它由泥浆润滑。
b3-047-s011.whyLearn: As引导时间状语从句在前，主句用一般现在时被动is lubricated by，可学by引出施动者。

modifiers.text: to find that it can cut through the hardest rock with great ease
that it can cut through the hardest rock with great ease

b3-047-s012.gloss: 科学家惊讶地发现它能轻易钻穿最硬的岩石。
b3-047-s012.whyLearn: be amazed to find that把完成被动、不定式和宾语从句串成一条链，还带最高级和情态动词。

modifiers.text: to bore through the earth to a depth of 35,000 feet

b3-047-s013.gloss: 这种钻头被设计成可钻入地下三万五千英尺深。
b3-047-s013.whyLearn: has been designed to do是被动加不定式的固定说法，后面两个to短语一个表路径一个表深度。

b3-047-s014.skeleton: It will enable scientists to obtain samples

modifiers.text: which lies immediately below the earth's crust

b3-047-s014.gloss: 它将使科学家能获取地壳下神秘层的样本。
b3-047-s014.whyLearn: enable sb to do的宾语补足语结构，samples后接of短语再挂which定语从句，层次很清晰。

b3-047-s015.skeleton: This layer is known as the Mohorovicic Discontinuity

modifiers.text: but is commonly referred to as 'the Moho'

b3-047-s015.gloss: 这一层叫莫霍洛维奇不连续面，通常简称莫霍面。
b3-047-s015.whyLearn: but连接两个并列谓语，be known as与be referred to as同义替换，可学同义表达与省略主语。

b3-047-s017.skeleton: Geological tests will be carried out

modifiers.text: to find the point at which the earth's crust is thinnest
at which the earth's crust is thinnest

b3-047-s017.gloss: 将进行地质测试，找出地壳最薄的地点。
b3-047-s017.whyLearn: will be carried out是被动将来时，to find后接at which引导的限制性定语从句，介词提前很典型。

b3-047-s018.skeleton: The three possible sites which are being considered are all at sea: two in the Atlantic Ocean and one in the Pacific.

modifiers.text: : two in the Atlantic Ocean and one in the Pacific

b3-047-s018.gloss: 考虑中的三个地点都在海上：大西洋两个，太平洋一个。
b3-047-s018.whyLearn: which are being considered是进行时被动定语从句，冒号后并列短语补充说明sites，可一并学。

b3-047-s019.skeleton: they will have to erect a drilling vessel

modifiers.text: Once they have determinded on a site
which willnot be swept away by ocean currents

b3-047-s019.gloss: 一旦选定地点，他们就得建造不会被洋流冲走的钻井船。
b3-047-s019.whyLearn: Once引导的完成时状语从句配主句will have to，后面which从句用将来被动，逻辑线很完整。

b3-047-s020.skeleton: The vessel will consist of an immense platform

modifiers.text: which will rise to 70 feet above the water

b3-047-s020.gloss: 这艘船将由一个高出水面七十英尺的巨大平台组成。
b3-047-s020.whyLearn: consist of不能用于被动，后面which从句继续用will描述平台高度，是易错点与常见写法。

b3-047-s021.skeleton: It will be supported by six hollow columns

modifiers.text: which will descend to a depth of 60 feet below the ocean surface where they will be fixed to a huge float
where they will be fixed to a huge float

b3-047-s021.gloss: 它由六根空心柱支撑，柱子下伸并固定在大浮体上。
b3-047-s021.whyLearn: 句尾which从句里再套where地点状语从句，两层嵌套，还有by引出施动者，值得拆解。
