b3-047-s022.skeleton: A tall steel tower rising to a height of nearly 200 feet will rest on the platform.

modifiers.text: rising to a height of nearly 200 feet
to a height of nearly 200 feet

b3-047-s022.gloss: 一座高近两百英尺的钢塔将立在平台上。
b3-047-s022.whyLearn: rising分词短语插在主语和谓语之间作后置定语，要学会隔开主语与will rest的干扰。

b2-025-s004.skeleton: I not only spoke English very carefully
b2-025-s004.gloss: 我不仅说英语很仔细，还说得非常清楚。
b2-025-s004.whyLearn: not only…but…as well 并列两个状语，but 后省略了 spoke English，容易误读成转折。

modifiers.text: but I could not understand him

b2-025-s008.gloss: 他说得很慢，可我还是听不懂。
b2-025-s008.whyLearn: but 前后时态对比：前半实义动词过去式，后半 could not 表过去能力，情态动词否定很典型。

modifiers.text: that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else

b2-026-s007.gloss: 我认为小孩子往往比别人更懂现代画。
b2-026-s007.whyLearn: that 宾语从句里套 better than anyone else 比较级，appreciate 意为“欣赏”，主句用现在时表看法。

modifiers.text: As soon as this was done

b2-027-s002.gloss: 这事一做完，他们就在明火上做了饭。
b2-027-s002.whyLearn: As soon as 时间从句用被动 was done，主句 cooked 用过去式，“一……就……”的复制句型。

modifiers.text: and there were some people rowing on the river

b2-030-s004.gloss: 孩子们在岸边做游戏，河上还有人在划船。
b2-030-s004.whyLearn: and 并列过去进行时与 there be 句，rowing 作后置定语，一次学会“有人正在……”的两种说法。

modifiers.text: so hard that he nearly fell into the water

b2-030-s007.gloss: 球重重打在他身上，他差点掉进水里。
b2-030-s007.whyLearn: so…that 表结果，so 后接副词 hard 而非 such；nearly fell into 描写差一点发生的动作。

b2-031-s002.skeleton: Frank is now the head of a very large business company

modifiers.text: but as a boy he used to work in a small shop
to work in a small shop

b2-031-s002.gloss: 弗兰克现在是大公司老板，小时候在小店干活。
b2-031-s002.whyLearn: 前半现在时讲现状、后半 used to 讲过去，今昔对比是复述人物经历的经典写法。

modifiers.text: and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day

b2-031-s003.gloss: 修自行车是他的活儿，那时他每天干十四小时。
b2-031-s003.whyLearn: It was his job to do…用 it 作形式主语把不定式后置，后半再用 used to 补背景，重点与细节分层。

b2-031-s005.skeleton: Frank used to make spare parts
b2-031-s005.gloss: 战时弗兰克常为飞机制造零件。
b2-031-s005.whyLearn: used to 后必须接动词原形 make，配合 During the war 时间状语，一句话交代过去的生活状态。

modifiers.text: when the door opened and his wife came in

b2-031-s009.gloss: 门开了，妻子走进来时他还笑着。
b2-031-s009.whyLearn: when 从句用 and 并列两个过去动作，主句用过去进行时铺垫“正笑着”的背景，时态配合典型。

b2-035-s001.skeleton: Rov Trenton used to drive a taxi
b2-035-s001.gloss: 罗夫·特伦顿过去开出租车。
b2-035-s001.whyLearn: 最短的 used to 例句：主语+used to+动词原形，注意后接 drive 而非 drove，用来对比今昔。

modifiers.text: When he was driving along Catford Street recently
and run towards a waiting car

b2-035-s004.gloss: 他最近开车时看见两个贼从店里冲出来。
b2-035-s004.whyLearn: see sb do sth 用省略 to 的不定式，配合 when 过去进行时从句，把目击动作连成一条链。

b2-035-s007.skeleton: The one with the money got such a fright
b2-035-s007.gloss: 拿钱那个吓得把包都掉了。
b2-035-s007.whyLearn: such a+名词+that 引导结果从句，与 so…that 的分工是 such 修饰名词短语，注意 a fright 语序。

modifiers.text: than he bought a fine house

b2-038-s003.gloss: 他刚回来就买下好房子住了进去。
b2-038-s003.whyLearn: no sooner…than 时间句型，主句用过去完成时、than 后接过去式，比 as soon as 更书面。

b2-038-s008.skeleton: He had hardly had time to settle down

modifiers.text: when he sold the house and left the country

b2-038-s008.gloss: 他还没安顿下来就卖了房子出国。
b2-038-s008.whyLearn: hardly…when 表示“还没来得及……就……”，主句过去完成时配 when 从句过去式，写作中很出彩。

b2-039-s001.skeleton: he asked his doctor to tell him

modifiers.text: While John Gilbert was in hospital
to tell him whether his operation had been successful
whether his operation had been successful
but the doctor refused to do so

b2-039-s001.gloss: 住院时他问医生手术是否成功，医生不肯说。
b2-039-s001.whyLearn: 一句含 while 状语、ask sb to do 与 whether 间接疑问，末尾 but 转折并省略重复动词。

b4-023-s005.skeleton: a basic amount of movement occurs

modifiers.text: which is specifically concerned with preventing muscle inactivity

b4-023-s005.gloss: 事实上，睡眠中也发生基本运动，以防肌肉不活动。
b4-023-s005.whyLearn: which 从句被 during sleep 隔开，练会跨过状语找回先行词 movement，句子才读得通。

b4-023-s007.skeleton: This might be a plausible hypothesis

modifiers.text: were it not for two factors

b4-023-s007.gloss: 若不是有两个因素，这或许是个合理的假设。
b4-023-s007.whyLearn: were it not for 是省略 if 的倒装虚拟条件，认出倒装就能立刻断定全句是假设语气。

b4-023-s009.gloss: 第二个因素更有趣，也更根本。
b4-023-s009.whyLearn: 两个比较级用 and 并列作表语，一次递进两层意思，论述时可直接套用这种升级写法。

b4-023-s010.skeleton: an American psychiatrist named William Dement published experiments

modifiers.text: dealing with the recording of eye-movements during sleep

b4-023-s010.whyLearn: 过去分词与现在分词各带一个后置定语，练会在同一句里分清两种分词修饰的对象。

modifiers.text: that the average individual's sleep cycle is punctuated with peculiar bursts of eye-movements

b4-023-s011.gloss: 他发现睡眠周期中夹杂着奇怪的眼动爆发。
b4-023-s011.whyLearn: 宾语从句里套被动语态，后面再用两个独立主格补充眼动类型，句法层次很值得拆。

b4-023-s012.skeleton: People woken during these periods of eye-movements generally reported

modifiers.text: woken during these periods of eye-movements

b4-023-s012.gloss: 眼动期间被唤醒的人多半报告说正在做梦。
b4-023-s012.whyLearn: 过去分词短语后置修饰 People，宾语从句用过去完成进行时交代醒来前已开始的梦。

b4-023-s013.gloss: 在别的时间被叫醒，他们就报告没有做梦。
b4-023-s013.whyLearn: 时间状语从句省略了 they were，只剩 When woken，练会补出省略成分再理解句意。

b4-023-s015.skeleton: The implications of all this were

modifiers.text: that it was not the disturbance of sleep that mattered, but the disturbance of dreaming
it was not the disturbance of sleep that mattered

b4-023-s015.gloss: 这一切意味着：要紧的不是睡眠受扰，而是做梦被打断。
b4-023-s015.whyLearn: that 从句里嵌 it was...that 强调结构，再配 not...but 对比，一句叠加两种句式。

b4-024-s001.skeleton: Walking for walking' s sake may be

modifiers.text: as highly laudable and exemplary a thing as i

b4-024-s001.gloss: 为走路而走路，本身或许就是值得称赞的事。
b4-024-s001.whyLearn: as + 形容词 + a thing as 的比较结构，动名词 Walking 作主语，是地道的抽象表达。

b4-024-s002.gloss: 我反对它，因为它让大脑停转。
b4-024-s002.whyLearn: My 物主代词加 that 引导的表语从句说明反对的理由，是表明立场最省力的句式。

b4-024-s006.gloss: 他举重若轻的那份渊博学识，如今哪里去了？
b4-024-s006.whyLearn: 省略系动词的疑问句加 which 定语从句，练会在残缺句里找到被修饰的名词。

modifiers.text: that played like summer lightning over any topic that was started

b4-024-s007.gloss: 那份曾像夏日闪电般点亮任何话题的才思，如今何在？
b4-024-s007.whyLearn: 两个 that 各引一个定语从句，一个修饰 fancy 一个修饰 topic，练会分层断句。

b4-024-s008.skeleton: The man's face that was so mobile is set now

modifiers.text: gone is the light from his fine eyes

b4-024-s008.gloss: 他从前表情丰富的脸如今僵住了，眼里的光也熄了。
b4-024-s008.whyLearn: 被动 is set 与倒装 gone is 连用写人物衰老，句式与内容贴合，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: that A (our host) is a thoroughly good fellow

b4-024-s009.gloss: 他说A（我们的东道主）是个十足的好人。
b4-024-s009.whyLearn: 宾语从句中间插进括号补充说明，练会跳过插入成分，抓住从句主干。

modifiers.text: that she is one of the most charming women he has ever known
of the most charming women he has ever known

b4-024-s012.gloss: 接着他又说，她是他见过的最迷人的女性之一。
b4-024-s012.whyLearn: one of the + 最高级 + 省略关系词的定语从句，是评价人物常用的高级句式。

b4-024-s014.gloss: 他对着我大声念道：“国王的纹章”。
b4-024-s014.whyLearn: read aloud to sb 后接冒号引出的直接引语，练会朗读动词带引语的常见说法。

b3-047-s023.skeleton: The drill will be stored in the towerand will have to be lowered
b3-047-s023.gloss: 钻头存塔内，须下放一万五千英尺水下才能开工
b3-047-s023.whyLearn: 一句里叠了一般将来时、被动语态、have to 和 before 从句，是科技说明文压缩长句的典型样本。

b3-047-s024.skeleton: there will be a laboratory, living accommodation and a helicopter landing station

modifiers.text: a laboratory, living accommodation and a helicopter landing station

b3-047-s024.gloss: 塔内将设有实验室、生活舱和直升机停机坪
b3-047-s024.whyLearn: there be 的将来时接三项并列名词，可顺带记住并列项只在最后一项前加 and，以及地点状语前置。

b3-047-s025.skeleton: Keeping the platform in position at sea will give rise to further problems

modifiers.text: Keeping the platform in position at sea

b3-047-s025.gloss: 让平台在海上保持定位将带来更多难题
b3-047-s025.whyLearn: 动名词短语充当主语，谓语用 give rise to 这一正式搭配；主语长谓语短的句法平衡值得留意。

b3-047-s026.skeleton: scientists will have to devise methods
b3-047-s026.gloss: 为此科学家须设计出用雷达和水下电视的方法
b3-047-s026.whyLearn: 句首不定式表目的，句末分词短语后置修饰 methods，两个非谓语同现是科技文的常见压缩手段。

b3-047-s027.skeleton: it must be possible to re-insert it

modifiers.text: If, during the operations the drill has to be withdrawn

b3-047-s027.gloss: 若作业中钻头须取出，就必须能重新放回
b3-047-s027.whyLearn: 真实条件从句被 during the operations 插入打断，主句用 must be possible to 结构，练从句与主句的切分。

modifiers.text: that villagers in remote places are friendly and hospitable

b3-048-s002.gloss: 我们总以为偏远地方的村民友善又好客
b3-048-s002.whyLearn: assume that 从句是表达成见的常用句式，in remote places 后置修饰 villagers，别误当成谓语。

b3-048-s004.skeleton: Visits to really remote villages are seldom enjoyable

modifiers.text: --as my wife and I discovered during a tour through the Balkans
during a tour through the Balkans

b3-048-s004.gloss: 去极偏远村庄的旅行很少愉快，巴尔干之行便是证明
b3-048-s004.whyLearn: to 短语作后置定语，破折号后 as 从句补充亲历证据，可学先下判断再给佐证的行文节奏。

b3-048-s005.skeleton: We had spent several days in a small town and visited a number of old churches

modifiers.text: and visited a number of old churches in the vicinity

b3-048-s005.gloss: 我们在小镇待了几天，参观了附近不少老教堂
b3-048-s005.whyLearn: 两个并列谓语共用一个主语，and 后省略 had，可看清过去完成时与一般过去时的搭配与省略。

b3-048-s007.skeleton: several bus loads of tourists descended on the town

modifiers.text: On the day before our departure

b3-048-s007.gloss: 我们离开前一天，几车游客涌进了小镇
b3-048-s007.whyLearn: the day before 加名词所有格表示时间点，descend on 生动写出人群涌入，可整块用于叙事开头。

modifiers.text: Taking a path which led out of the town
which led out of the town
until we came to a dense wood

b3-048-s009.gloss: 我们沿出镇的小路走过几片田野，直到一片密林
b3-048-s009.whyLearn: 分词短语前置作状语，中间嵌定语从句，结尾接 until 从句，一句串起三种修饰结构。

b3-048-s010.skeleton: We expected the path to end abruptly, but we found

modifiers.text: but we found that it traced its way through the trees
that it traced its way through the trees

b3-048-s010.gloss: 我们本以为小路会突然到头，却发现它穿过树林延伸
b3-048-s010.whyLearn: expect 加宾语加不定式，与 find 加 that 从句形成预期和发现的对照，but 连接两种不同句型。

b3-048-s011.skeleton: We tramped through the wood for over two hours

modifiers.text: until we arrived at a deep stream

b3-048-s011.gloss: 我们在林中跋涉两个多小时，来到一条深溪边
b3-048-s011.whyLearn: for 加时长与 until 从句并用，同时交代持续时间和终点，是叙事推进路线的标准组合。

b3-048-s013.skeleton: Suddenly my wife spotted a boat
b3-048-s013.gloss: 突然，我妻子发现一条拴在岸边的小船
b3-048-s013.whyLearn: spot 后接名词加过去分词短语作后置定语，相当于省略 which was，学名词后置修饰的压缩写法。

b3-048-s015.skeleton: We gently woke him up and asked him to ferry us

modifiers.text: and asked him to ferry us to the other side
to ferry us to the other side

b3-048-s015.gloss: 我们轻轻唤醒他，请他摆渡到对岸去
b3-048-s015.whyLearn: wake up 的代词宾语必须夹在中间，ask sb to do 接不定式，两个动词短语的用法可一并记住。

b3-048-s016.skeleton: we eventually persuaded him to take us

modifiers.text: Though he was reluctant to do so at first

b3-048-s016.gloss: 尽管他起初不情愿，我们最终说服他载我们
b3-048-s016.whyLearn: Though 让步从句配 persuade sb to do，其中 reluctant to do so 回指前文动作，是避免重复的好办法。

b3-048-s017.skeleton: The path led to a tiny village

modifiers.text: perched on the steep sides of a mountain
on the steep sides of a mountain

b3-048-s017.gloss: 小路通向一座坐落在陡峭山坡上的小村庄
b3-048-s017.whyLearn: 过去分词短语 perched 后置修饰 village，几个词就补出村庄的高险位置，写景很省笔墨。

b2-079-s001.skeleton: I used to travel by air a great deal
b2-079-s001.gloss: 我小时候常坐飞机出行。
b2-079-s001.whyLearn: used to 加动词原形表过去习惯，when 从句交代时间背景，是讲童年往事的典型句式。

b2-079-s002.skeleton: My parents, used to live in South America

modifiers.text: and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays

b2-079-s002.gloss: 父母住南美，我假期从欧洲飞去看他们。
b2-079-s002.whyLearn: 两个 used to 由 and 并列，说明过去反复发生的动作，注意前后分句结构对称。

modifiers.text: that there was a very important person on board

b2-079-s008.gloss: 后来我们得知机上有一位要人。
b2-079-s008.whyLearn: learn that 引出宾语从句，从句用 there be 存在句交代情况，是转述消息的常用组合。

b2-080-s005.skeleton: There was also a great deal of machinery
b2-080-s005.whyLearn: a great deal of 修饰不可数名词 machinery，与 there be 结构配合描写展品数量。

b2-080-s007.skeleton: steam boats carried thousands of visitors

modifiers.text: Though in those days, travelling was not as easy as it is today

b2-080-s007.gloss: 当年渡船仍把成千上万欧洲游客送过海峡。
b2-080-s007.whyLearn: Though 让步从句用 not as easy as it is today 对比今昔，主句再用一般过去时陈述事实。

b2-080-s009.skeleton: There were six million visitors in all

modifiers.text: and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges

b2-080-s009.gloss: 共六百万参观者，展览收益用于建馆办学。
b2-080-s009.whyLearn: be used to build 是被动语态加不定式，表资金被用于某事，别与 used to do 过去习惯混淆。

b2-081-s011.skeleton: The prisoner felt sorry for him

modifiers.text: but there was nothing else he could do

b2-081-s011.gloss: 囚犯替他难过，却也无可奈何。
b2-081-s011.whyLearn: nothing else he could do 是省略关系词的定语从句，配合 but 分句表达无能为力。

b2-081-s013.whyLearn: 句首现在分词短语作伴随状语，主句用 as quickly as he could 表示尽全力开快。

modifiers.text: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen
that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish
which have at times been sighted

b2-082-s002.gloss: 如今已知所谓海怪不过是怪鱼。
b2-082-s002.whyLearn: Though 让步从句加 it is known that 被动结构，中间再套 which 定语从句，层层包裹。

b2-082-s007.skeleton: it was found to be over thirteen feet long

modifiers.text: When it was eventually brought to shore
to be over thirteen feet long

b2-082-s007.gloss: 它被拖上岸后，发现身长超过十三英尺。
b2-082-s007.whyLearn: When 从句用被动语态，主句 be found to be 后接不定式说明测量结果。

b2-082-s008.skeleton: It had a head like a horse, big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail

modifiers.text: big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail
The fish, which has since been sent to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish
which has since been sent to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist

b2-082-s008.gloss: 它形似马，蓝眼银皮红尾，名叫桨鱼。
b2-082-s008.whyLearn: 先并列铺陈外形，再用非限定定语从句补叙鱼的去向，最后点出名称与学名。

b2-083-s005.skeleton: the policeman on duty told him

modifiers.text: When he asked if Mr Lane lived there
that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad

b2-083-s005.gloss: 值班警员告诉他，前首相落选后已出国。
b2-083-s005.whyLearn: ask if 的间接疑问句作宾语，主句用 that 从句配过去完成时交代更早发生的事。

b2-084-s006.skeleton: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides'

modifiers.text: to people on their way to work

b2-084-s006.gloss: 许多私家车主将向上班族提供免费搭车。
b2-084-s006.whyLearn: be going to 表计划，of private cars 与 on their way to work 分别限定车主和乘客。

b2-084-s011.skeleton: people are going to find it difficult to get to work
b2-084-s011.gloss: 即便如此，人们上班仍会很困难。
b2-084-s011.whyLearn: find it difficult to do 用 it 作形式宾语、不定式后置，Even so 承接上文表示转折。

b2-085-s003.skeleton: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names

modifiers.text: who have contributed towards the gift
which will be sent to the headmaster's home

b2-085-s003.gloss: 所有送礼者将在纪念册上签名，册子寄往校长家。
b2-085-s003.whyLearn: who 从句限定 All those，which 从句修饰 album，一句话里前后两处后置修饰。

modifiers.text: for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn

b2-085-s009.gloss: 但这无妨，正如他所言，学无止境。
b2-085-s009.whyLearn: for 引出原因分句，as 从句插入其中作补充，never too old to learn 是名言式表达。

b1-061-s001.gloss: 顾客说自己在这儿买了两本贵词典。
b1-061-s001.whyLearn: bought 是 buy 的不规则过去式，后接 two+名词复数；expensive 作定语放在名词前修饰 dictionaries。

modifiers.text: who is standing behind the counter

b1-061-s003.gloss: 指柜台后面站着的那位女士。
b1-061-s003.whyLearn: 先行词是人，用 who 引导定语从句；is standing 是现在进行时，说出此刻正站着的状态。

b1-061-s005.gloss: 指柜台上放着的那几本书。
b1-061-s005.whyLearn: 先行词是物，关系代词用 which 而不是 who；复数 books 配 are，be on 表示“在……上面”。

modifiers.text: he's the man who bought these books

b1-061-s007.gloss: 他说他就是买下这些书的人。
b1-061-s007.whyLearn: says 后是宾语从句，连接词 that 被省略；从句里又套一个 who 引导的定语从句，都用过去时 bought。

b1-061-s009.skeleton: The man whom I served was wearing a hat.
b1-061-s009.gloss: 我招待过的那位男士当时戴着帽子。
b1-061-s009.whyLearn: 先行词 the man 作 served 的宾语，关系代词用 whom 且不省略；主句用过去进行时描摹当时的穿着。

b1-062-s003.gloss: 鲍勃让比尔把东西给他看看。
b1-062-s003.whyLearn: 祈使句以动词原形开头，省略主语 you；let me see 是“让我看看”的固定说法，称呼 Bill 放句末。

b1-062-s006.gloss: 他们是我旅行途中认识的人。
b1-062-s006.whyLearn: 定语从句省略了关系代词 whom/that，先行词 people 后直接接 I met；during the trip 交代认识的场合。

b1-062-s007.gloss: 那就是我们乘过的那条船。
b1-062-s007.whyLearn: 关系代词被省略，介词 on 留在从句末尾，形成“介词后置”的定语从句；travel on a ship 是固定搭配。

b1-062-s010.gloss: 那就是我跟你提过的那个人。
b1-062-s010.whyLearn: tell sb about sb 的介词 about 留在句尾，关系代词省略；told 是 tell 的过去式，双宾语语序要记牢。

modifiers.text: who offered you a job in Australia

b1-062-s013.gloss: 就是那个在澳大利亚给你工作的人。
b1-062-s013.whyLearn: 先行词 the one 指人，用 who 引导；offer sb a job 是双宾搭配，in Australia 在从句里补充地点。

b1-062-s017.whyLearn: 陈述部分否定，附加问句就用肯定形式 is it；主语用代词 it，回指前文谈到的人或物。

b1-062-s019.skeleton: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off
b1-062-s019.gloss: 我旅行时留了胡子，回家就刮了。
b1-062-s019.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列的过去时句子，构成前后对比；when 引导时间状语从句，shave off 是“刮掉”的动词短语。

b1-062-s021.whyLearn: didn’t 后接动词原形 like，不能再用过去式；My 是形容词性物主代词，直接放在名词前表示所属。

b1-063-s001.skeleton: Can't you come in and have tea now
b1-063-s001.gloss: 苏珊问彼得现在能不能进来喝茶。
b1-063-s001.whyLearn: 否定形式的 can’t 提问语气更像邀请；come in 与 have tea 由 and 并列，共用前面的情态动词 can。

b1-063-s003.whyLearn: must 后接动词原形，water 在这里是动词“浇水”而不是名词；first 作副词说明做事次序。

b1-063-s009.skeleton: Last summer it was very dry
b1-063-s009.gloss: 去年夏天天气也非常干旱。
b1-063-s009.whyLearn: was 是 is 的过去式，主语 it 指天气；句末 too 表示“也”，只用于肯定句，位置固定在句尾。

b3-007-s018.skeleton: The child looked around for a moment and said
b3-007-s018.gloss: 孩子环顾片刻，说他们都疯了。
b3-007-s018.whyLearn: looked、said 用过去时叙述动作，引号里的 they're 用现在时，一句里两种时态各管一层。

b3-008-s006.skeleton: the Pass is less dangerous, but each year, the dogs are still sent out into the snow

modifiers.text: Now that a tunnel has been built through the mountains
whenever a traveller is in difficulty

b3-008-s006.gloss: 隧道修通后山路仍险，雪中救援照常出动。
b3-008-s006.whyLearn: Now that 表原因、whenever 表随时；has been built 是完成被动，are sent 是一般现在被动。

b3-008-s007.skeleton: there are still a few people

modifiers.text: who rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot

b3-008-s007.gloss: 虽有新隧道，仍有人冒失地徒步翻越山口。
b3-008-s007.whyLearn: Despite 后只接名词就表让步，who 定语从句修饰 people，a few 与 there be 搭配出『仍有少数』的语气。

modifiers.text: for it is visited by thousands of people who cross the Pass in cars
who cross the Pass in cars
As there are so many people about
the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure

b3-008-s008.gloss: 夏季僧院很忙，人多时狗得关进专门的围栏。
b3-008-s008.whyLearn: for 引并列的原因分句，As 引原因状语从句，who 是定语从句；三种原因表达和被动 be kept 同现。

b3-009-s005.skeleton: they may solve a number of problems about Mars and provide information about the markings on its surface

modifiers.text: about the markings on its surface
which, nearly 100 years ago, the astronomer, Schiaparelli, thought to be canals

b3-009-s005.gloss: 照片若拍成功，或能解开火星斑纹之谜。
b3-009-s005.whyLearn: 主句 may 后并列两个动词；which 从句里夹着同位语和时间状语，thought to be 表过去时的判断。

b3-010-s002.skeleton: She was carrying 1316 passengers and a crew of 89l.
b3-010-s002.gloss: 她当时载着 1316 名乘客和 89 名船员。
b3-010-s002.whyLearn: 过去进行时交代当时船上的状态，数字后接 and 并列的宾语，crew 是另一个中心词。

b3-010-s004.skeleton: she was not only the largest ship

modifiers.text: for she had sixteen water- tight compartments

b3-010-s004.gloss: 当时它最大、被誉为不沉，且有十六个防水舱。
b3-010-s004.whyLearn: not only...but 连接两个谓语，that had ever been built 用过去完成被动，for 再补一层原因。

b3-010-s010.skeleton: there was a slight trembling sound from below, and the captain went down
b3-010-s010.gloss: 突然下方传来轻微震动声，船长下去查看。
b3-010-s010.whyLearn: and 并列存在句与动作句，went down to see 用不定式表目的，what 从句里用过去完成时。

b3-010-s011.skeleton: The noise had been so faint

modifiers.text: that no one thought that the ship had been damaged
that the ship had been damaged

b3-010-s011.gloss: 声响太轻，没人想到船已经受损。
b3-010-s011.whyLearn: so...that 引出结果，主句 had been 与 thought 后用过去完成被动，语气层层减弱。

modifiers.text: As there were not enough life-boats for everybody

b3-010-s014.gloss: 救生艇不够所有人用，一千五百人丧生。
b3-010-s014.whyLearn: As 引原因状语从句，从句是 there be 的否定式，主句用被动 were lost，损失由谁承受一目了然。

b3-011-s008.skeleton: 'Would you mind unlocking this suitcase please ?'
b3-011-s008.gloss: 请问您介意打开这个手提箱吗？
b3-011-s008.whyLearn: Would you mind 后接动名词是礼貌请求的固定句式，句末 please 让语气更缓和。

b3-011-s026.skeleton: He was greeted by an unpleasant smell

modifiers.text: which convinced him that I was telling the truth
that I was telling the truth

b3-011-s026.gloss: 一股难闻的气味让他相信我说的是真话。
b3-011-s026.whyLearn: was greeted by 是被动，which 定语从句里再套 that 宾语从句，was telling 用过去进行时。

b3-012-s003.skeleton: Life there is simple and good.
b3-012-s003.gloss: 那里的生活简单而美好。
b3-012-s003.whyLearn: there 紧跟名词作后置修饰，说明是哪里的生活；表语用 and 并列两个形容词。

b3-012-s008.skeleton: there is an element of truth in both these pictures

modifiers.text: but few of us have had the opportunity to find out

b3-012-s008.gloss: 两种说法也许各有一点道理，但少有人去验证。
b3-012-s008.whyLearn: there is 引存在句，but 后 few of us 加现在完成时，to find out 作后置定语，一句读出探究语气。

b3-012-s010.skeleton: They were taking a badly damaged boat
b3-012-s010.gloss: 他们正把损坏的船从维尔京群岛运往迈阿密修。
b3-012-s010.whyLearn: were taking 表当时正在进行，from...to 表航线，to have it repaired 是使役不定式表目的。

b3-012-s013.skeleton: There were hardly any trees on the island and there was no water, but this did not prove to be a problem
b3-012-s013.gloss: 岛上几乎没有树，也没有水，但这不算问题。
b3-012-s013.whyLearn: 两个 there be 句由 and 并列，hardly 与 no 双重否定，but 后用 prove to be 表达结果。

modifiers.text: Though Mrs Bussman was fully acquainted with this story
that there was a chance in a million

b3-036-s011.gloss: 布思曼太太虽知情，却认为他可能是对的
b3-036-s011.whyLearn: 一句里同时挤进让步状语从句、宾语从句和同位语从句，两个 that 功能完全不同，是练从句分层的绝佳范例。

b3-036-s012.skeleton: she sent a boy to the workman

modifiers.text: to ask him if his name was Hans Bussman
if his name was Hans Bussman
the man's name was Hans Bussman and he really was Franz's long-lost brother

b3-036-s012.gloss: 她派人去问那人是否叫汉斯·布思曼
b3-036-s012.whyLearn: 一句先用不定式表目的、if 引宾语从句，再由插入语 Needless to say 抖出结果，叙事节奏很值得模仿。

b3-037-s005.gloss: 出了事就一味怪铁路当局太容易了
b3-037-s005.whyLearn: It is + adj + to do 的经典评价句型，后面跟 when 从句点出场景，does 的强调用法也藏在这里。

modifiers.text: that there was an express train to Westhaven

b3-037-s007.gloss: 查完时刻表，我满意地发现有快车去西黑文
b3-037-s007.whyLearn: after + doing 把先后两个动作压进一句，note 后接 that 从句再套 there be，是旅行叙述的高频组合。

modifiers.text: that a great many local people got on as well

b3-037-s009.gloss: 上车后我发现许多本地人也上了这趟车
b3-037-s009.whyLearn: can't help doing 是极常用的口语说法，a great many 修饰复数名词，一句里学到两个实用搭配。

b3-037-s018.gloss: 我打定主意，一到就投诉
b3-037-s018.whyLearn: determine to do 表示当场下定决心，as soon as 从句让决心和到达两个动作衔接得紧凑有力。

b3-037-s019.skeleton: I was talking angrily to the station-master at Westhaven
b3-037-s019.gloss: 两小时后，我正愤怒地跟站长交涉
b3-037-s019.whyLearn: 过去进行时把当时的场面拉成一个镜头，angrily 与两个介词短语一次交代情绪、对象和地点。

modifiers.text: When he denied the train's existence

b3-037-s020.gloss: 他否认有这趟车，我便借来他的时刻表
b3-037-s020.whyLearn: when 从句先摆出冲突，主句用 borrowed 稳稳反击；train's 与 of the time-table 两种所有格同句对比。

b3-037-s021.skeleton: There was a note of triumph

modifiers.text: when I told him that it was there in black and white
that it was there in black and white

b3-037-s021.gloss: 我得意地告诉他，白纸黑字写着呢
b3-037-s021.whyLearn: there be 配上抽象名词 note of triumph 写神情，when 从句里再嵌宾语从句，层层推进很有表现力。

modifiers.text: for they were as near as early man could get to writing
as early man could get to writing

b3-038-s018.gloss: 这些符号含义明确，是早期人类最接近文字的东西
b3-038-s018.whyLearn: for 引出原因分句，as ... as ... could 的比较结构把“最接近文字”说得既有分寸又准确。

b3-039-s001.skeleton: The rough road across the plain soon became so bad
b3-039-s001.gloss: 土路很快烂得我们……（原句在此未完）
b3-039-s001.whyLearn: so ... that ... 结果句型的开头，so 后必须接形容词或副词，that 从句用来交代后果。

modifiers.text: No matter what the conditions were
that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go
as fast as it could possibly go

b3-039-s006.gloss: 无论路况如何，他都认为车该开得尽可能快
b3-039-s006.whyLearn: no matter what 让步开篇，宾语从句里再嵌被动语态和 as ... as 比较，三种结构串得干净利落。

modifiers.text: wondering if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us
if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us

b3-039-s010.gloss: 因此我们不断回头，担心身后漏下油迹
b3-039-s010.whyLearn: keep doing 表示持续动作，现在分词 wondering 顺带补充心理活动，一句写出边走边担心的画面。

modifiers.text: giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps of bushes
where the only obstacles were clumps of bushes

b3-039-s011.gloss: 巨石突然消失，眼前豁然变成一片平原
b3-039-s011.whyLearn: 感叹句 What a relief 搭配 when 从句，再加分词与 where 从句层层展开，是写“松一口气”的好句式。

b3-039-s012.whyLearn: there be 加不定式 to come 的固定说法，短短一句却能制造悬念，适合学叙事的转折收尾。

b1-057-s012.skeleton: Can you change this pound note
b1-057-s012.gloss: 问女士能否把这张一英镑钞票换开
b1-057-s012.whyLearn: 换零钱的礼貌问句 Can you...?，句尾加称呼 madam，银行购物场景常用。

b1-057-s013.gloss: 乘客委婉地表示自己换不开
b1-057-s013.whyLearn: I'm afraid 是委婉拒绝的固定开场，后面 I can't 省去了重复的动词。

b1-058-s004.whyLearn: sure 后接 there be 存在句，用来推断某处没有某人，比直接否定更自然。

b1-058-s008.gloss: 问对方能不能看见什么东西
b1-058-s008.whyLearn: anything 用于疑问句而非 something，这是疑问句里最容易出错的一点。

b1-058-s019.skeleton: May I have a glass of bear
b1-058-s019.whyLearn: May I...? 比 Can I 更正式客气，please 放句尾缓和请求语气。

b1-059-s002.whyLearn: There were 加复数名词再加地点副词，是描述过去场景的存在句基本式。

modifiers.text: but we could not find them all

b1-059-s003.gloss: 我们找了硬币但没能全部找到
b1-059-s003.whyLearn: but 连接两个过去动作，could not 表达努力之后的遗憾结果。

b1-059-s004.skeleton: our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins
b1-059-s004.gloss: 吃早饭时小儿子在地板上找到两枚硬币
b1-059-s004.whyLearn: While 从句用过去进行时铺垫背景，主句用一般过去时叙事，是时态搭配的范例。

b1-059-s008.skeleton: my husband telephoned me from the office

modifiers.text: when I was doing the housework

b1-059-s008.gloss: 那天上午我做家务时丈夫从办公室来电
b1-059-s008.whyLearn: when 从句插在主句中间，前后用逗号隔开，可练习长句的停顿和信息层次。

b1-060-s011.gloss: 小偷扔下手电筒尽快逃走了
b1-060-s011.whyLearn: as quickly as they could 表示尽可能快地，是动作描写里的高频比较结构。

b1-060-s013.gloss: 他打开灯却看不到任何人
b1-060-s013.whyLearn: but 对比两个过去动作，否定句中要用 anyone 而不是 someone。

b1-061-s008.gloss: 罗伯茨小姐说她想不起来了
b1-061-s008.whyLearn: can't remember 表示一时想不起，句尾 sir 体现对上级的礼貌称呼。

b1-061-s012.gloss: 经理请对方把它试穿一下
b1-061-s012.whyLearn: Would you...? 比 Will you 更客气，put it on 里代词必须放在中间。

b1-063-s005.gloss: 彼得说自己必须这么做
b1-063-s005.whyLearn: 用 must 收尾并省掉重复的动词，是英语口语里常见的省略答法。

b1-064-s002.gloss: 米莉对凯特说自己能做到
b1-064-s002.whyLearn: I think 后接省略形式的宾语从句，句尾加称呼 Kate，口语感很强。

b1-064-s004.gloss: 凯特说自己也这么认为
b1-064-s004.whyLearn: I thought so 用过去时表示我那时也是这么想的，so 代替前面整句话。

b1-064-s010.whyLearn: 用 I think 引出看法是英语最常用的委婉表态句型，说出观点前先降调，日常对话直接可用。

b1-065-s007.whyLearn: can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测，语气比 didn't 更笃定，是本课情态动词表推测的核心。

b1-065-s008.gloss: 我追上你的时候正开到时速八十。
b1-065-s008.whyLearn: when 从句配过去进行时，一个交代持续背景动作，一个交代突然发生的动作，是叙事的基本节奏。

b1-065-s010.whyLearn: I'm afraid 后接省略的否定回答，礼貌地承认没做到，句尾加上称呼 officer 是英语对话的传神之处。

b1-065-s013.gloss: 我当时一直在叫他开慢点。
b1-065-s013.whyLearn: tell sb to do 的复合结构，配上过去进行时表示当时反复叮嘱，很能表达委屈的辩解语气。

b1-066-s006.skeleton: We can't make up our minds.
b1-066-s006.whyLearn: make up one's mind 是高频习语，这里同时复习情态动词否定和物主代词 our 的搭配。

b1-067-s013.skeleton: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.

modifiers.text: a blue dress and a mink coat

b1-067-s013.gloss: 她穿着蓝色连衣裙和貂皮大衣。
b1-067-s013.whyLearn: 用过去进行时描写当时的穿着，两个并列宾语由具体到贵重，人物形象一下就立起来了。

modifiers.text: she was not going to make another

b1-067-s015.gloss: 她说她不打算再养一只了。
b1-067-s015.whyLearn: 间接引语把 be going to 后移成过去式再加否定，末尾 another 省略名词，转述一举练到三处。

b1-067-s016.whyLearn: 主句 said 决定从句时态后移，be going to 变 was going to，是转述别人计划的标准写法。

b1-068-s003.skeleton: I can't make up my mind.
b1-068-s003.whyLearn: 同一习语把 our 换成 my，提醒 make up one's mind 里的物主代词必须跟着主语走。

modifiers.text: she couldn't make up her mind

b1-068-s015.whyLearn: can't 在间接引语里变 couldn't，物主代词同时变 her，一句练到情态、时态、所有格三处。

b1-070-s004.whyLearn: I'm afraid 后面接否定宾语从句，是打断对方、承认听不懂时最得体的说法。

b2-001-s006.whyLearn: 过去进行时加方式副词 loudly 一笔交代背景噪音，为下文抱怨听不见做铺垫。

b2-001-s008.skeleton: I could not hear the actors.
b2-001-s008.whyLearn: could 的否定式在这里不表能力而表当时做不到，是解释处境、引出抱怨的常用句式。

b2-001-s012.gloss: 最后我实在忍不下去了。
b2-001-s012.whyLearn: In the end 放在句首点出结局，配上 could not bear it，把忍耐到极限的情绪交代清楚。

b2-001-s014.whyLearn: can't hear a word 用否定加 a word 把听不见强调到极致，口语里情绪强烈又自然。

b2-066-s008.skeleton: He has had the length of the wings increased

modifiers.text: so that they now measure 93 feet--almost as long as those of a Dakota

b2-066-s008.gloss: 他把机翼加长到九十三英尺。
b2-066-s008.whyLearn: 使役结构加 so that 引结果，measure 说测得长度，as long as 比较达科他机翼。

modifiers.text: though air cyclists may learn how to fly over short distances, and may, eventually, even get across the English Channel
whether they will ever cycle across the Atlantic

b2-066-s010.gloss: 人力飞行器能否飞越大西洋令人怀疑。
b2-066-s010.whyLearn: 让步从句带 and 并列，主句只剩 it is doubtful；whether 从句后置，ever 与 will 指向将来。

b2-067-s004.skeleton: he could not stay near the volcano for very long

modifiers.text: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs

b2-067-s004.gloss: 他拍到好照片，却无法久留火山旁。
b2-067-s004.whyLearn: though 只让一步：managed to take 肯定成绩，could not stay 才是重点。

b2-067-s008.skeleton: he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro

modifiers.text: so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures

b2-067-s008.gloss: 他爬进火山口以便拍照测温。
b2-067-s008.whyLearn: so that 加 could 表目的，take 与 measure 并列共用 could，不必重复情态动词。

modifiers.text: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him
pretending that I had not seen him
that I had not seen him

b2-068-s002.gloss: 装没看见没用，我只好向他挥手。
b2-068-s002.whyLearn: 动名词后置作真主语；had not seen 是过去完成时，说明挥手前早已看见。

b2-068-s003.skeleton: I never enjoy meeting Bert Dykes
b2-068-s003.gloss: 我从不喜欢见到伯特·戴克斯。
b2-068-s003.whyLearn: never 直接否定 enjoy，比 do not 更绝对；enjoy 后只能接动名词 meeting。

b2-068-s004.skeleton: He never has anything to do
b2-068-s004.whyLearn: never 与 anything 连用构成全部否定；to do 作后置定语，说无事可做。

b2-068-s005.skeleton: he always insists on coming with you

modifiers.text: No matter how busy you are

b2-068-s005.gloss: 无论你多忙他都要跟着你。
b2-068-s005.whyLearn: no matter how 表让步，主句用 always 写固定习惯；insist on 后必须接动名词。

b2-068-s014.skeleton: Would you mind my coming with you ?
b2-068-s014.gloss: 问对方介不介意自己同行。
b2-068-s014.whyLearn: Would you mind 后接动名词，加 my 点明动作者是自己，问句更客气。

modifiers.text: but I'm going to the dentist.

b2-068-s016.whyLearn: 直接引语被 I lied 从中间切开；but 补出编造的借口，语气由真转假。

b2-068-s018.gloss: 候诊室里总有东西可读。
b2-068-s018.whyLearn: there be 配 always 表随时都有；不定式 to read 作 plenty 的后置定语。

b2-069-s001.gloss: 我第三次参加驾照考试。
b2-069-s001.whyLearn: was being tested 叠用过去进行时与被动语态；for the third time 说第三次。

modifiers.text: that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you

b2-069-s006.gloss: 设想有孩子突然跑到你车前。
b2-069-s006.whyLearn: Let us suppose that 是引出假设的固定说法；从句用一般现在时表突发。

b2-069-s007.skeleton: I want the car to be stopped immediately

modifiers.text: As soon as I tap on the window

b2-069-s007.gloss: 我一敲窗你就得马上停车。
b2-069-s007.whyLearn: as soon as 从句用一般现在时代将来；want sth to be done 表要求车被停下。

b2-069-s009.skeleton: it took me a long time to react

modifiers.text: Though the sound could be heard clearly

b2-069-s009.gloss: 声音听得清，我却反应了很久。
b2-069-s009.whyLearn: though 从句用被动式承认声音清楚，主句是 it took me a long time to react。

b2-071-s001.skeleton: one of the first things you will see is Big Ben

modifiers.text: the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.

b2-071-s001.gloss: 到伦敦先看到的就是大本钟。
b2-071-s001.whyLearn: one of the first things you will see 套了省略 that 的定语从句，后面接同位语。

b1-017-s002.skeleton: There are some clouds in the sky, but the sun is shining.

modifiers.text: There are some clouds in the sky

b1-017-s002.gloss: 天上有云，但太阳正照着。
b1-017-s002.whyLearn: 存在句先说有什么，进行时再说正在怎样，but把两种天气接起来，一句话学会两个时态对照。

b1-017-s006.skeleton: There are some boats on the river.
b1-017-s006.whyLearn: river前用on而不是in，这个介词差别专治中式搭配；名词复数也决定be动词用are。

b1-018-s008.skeleton: There is a boy in the water.
b1-018-s008.whyLearn: There is配单数名词的入门样板；in the water点出人在水中，位置表达只需一个介词短语。

b1-022-s001.skeleton: Can you make the tea, Sam?
b1-022-s001.whyLearn: can提出请求而非问能力，是英式日常礼貌的核心；呼语放句尾，说话对象和语气都照顾到了。

b1-022-s007.whyLearn: 把can提前就完成提问；宾语用it指前文提过的东西，这一招能让对话不重复名词。

b1-022-s008.skeleton: I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.

modifiers.text: but I can't see the tea

b1-022-s008.gloss: 我能看见茶壶，却看不见茶叶。
b1-022-s008.whyLearn: 两处can一正一反，靠but形成对照；英式拼写can't和重音差别，正好是听辨否定的关键练习。

b1-022-s013.skeleton: There are some in the cupboard（碗橱）.
b1-022-s013.whyLearn: some单独作主语省略已知名词，全靠上下文支撑；这类省略是英语对话听起来自然的关键。

b1-022-s014.whyLearn: find侧重找的结果，跟look for区分开；宾语用them回指复数物品，问句结构照搬can提前。

b1-023-s008.skeleton: Bob: Can you type this letter for the boss please, Miss Jones?
b1-023-s008.gloss: 鲍勃：琼斯小姐，请替老板打这封信好吗？
b1-023-s008.whyLearn: for the boss交代替谁办事，please放句尾仍客气；这是办公室请求的标准说法，实用度极高。

b1-023-s015.skeleton: MISS JONES: I can't type this letter.
b1-023-s015.gloss: 琼斯小姐：我打不了这封信。
b1-023-s015.whyLearn: can't说明能力不足而拒绝，比直接说no委婉；this把拒绝限定在这一封信上，留有余地。

b1-023-s016.skeleton: Miss Jones: I can't read it!
b1-023-s016.whyLearn: it回指前文那封信，避免重复；can't加感叹号，把为难的语气直接传达出来。

b1-025-s005.whyLearn: What about是提建议的固定句式，后接名词即可；比Do you want更轻松，日常购物点菜都能用。

b1-031-s007.skeleton: MR WILLIAMS: Can you remember the doctor's telephone number?
b1-031-s007.gloss: 威廉斯先生：你记得医生的电话号码吗？
b1-031-s007.whyLearn: remember后直接接名词，不用forget式搭配；名词所有格doctor's写出所属，长宾语也不影响can提前。

b1-032-s003.skeleton: DOCTOR: Can I see him please, Mrs Williams?
b1-032-s003.gloss: 医生：威廉斯太太，我可以看看他吗？
b1-032-s003.whyLearn: Can I是征求许可的固定说法；宾格him作see的宾语，人称代词格的变化在这里看得最清楚。

b1-032-s019.whyLearn: please插在句尾问句里照样成立；用宾格him而不是he，是英语代词改格的典型考点。

b1-033-s005.skeleton: BETTY: I can't get home so early, Dad.
b1-033-s005.gloss: 贝蒂：爸爸，我没法那么早到家。
b1-033-s005.whyLearn: get home的home是副词，前面不加to，最易错的搭配之一；so early说明程度，呼语放句尾。

modifiers.text: in that only the lower fields, which make up a very small proportion of our farm, are affected by flooding
which make up a very small proportion of our farm
but other farms are less favourably sited
and flooding can sometimes spell disaster for their owners

b3-056-s012.gloss: 我们幸运，只有低处田地遭水淹
b3-056-s012.whyLearn: 一句里 but 和 and 连出三个并列主句，中间嵌 in that 原因从句与 which 定语从句，适合练长句分层断句。

modifiers.text: As the floods had put the telephone out of order

b3-056-s016.gloss: 洪水弄坏电话，我们无法得知他们近况
b3-056-s016.whyLearn: As 原因从句加 how 宾语从句双重嵌套，过去完成与过去进行时对照，是叙事中还原时间层次的范本。

modifiers.text: that they must have become unduly frightened by the rising flood
for their house, which had sound foundations, would have stood stoutly even if it had been almost submerged
even if it had been almost submerged

b3-056-s021.gloss: 我们明白他们被洪水吓坏了，其实房子很结实
b3-056-s021.whyLearn: must have done 表推测与 even if 虚拟条件并用，再用 for 分句和 which 从句嵌进长句，推测加反事实的典型。

b3-056-s022.skeleton: The men of our family waded down

modifiers.text: in the hope of being able to grapple a corner of the raft and pull it out of the current towards our bank
being able to grapple a corner of the raft and pull it out of the current towards our bank
to grapple a corner of the raft and pull it out of the current towards our bank

b3-056-s022.gloss: 全家男人拿钩子涉水去钩木筏拉回岸边
b3-056-s022.whyLearn: 主干只有 waded down，其余靠多个介词短语和 being able to do 交代方式与目的，练英语尾重句的信息铺排。

modifiers.text: a few months before we had planned to go
before we had planned to go
and, when he knew that he was dying, he made me promise to go on my own
when he knew that he was dying

b3-057-s012.gloss: 他病重，临死前要我独自前往
b3-057-s012.whyLearn: and 后面把时间状语从句和宾语从句塞在主语之前，主干被迫后置，练状语前置打乱语序时的断句能力。

modifiers.text: and bought a comprehensive book of maps
which I found most helpful on the cross country journey
but which I did not think I should need on the last stage

b3-057-s013.gloss: 我租车买地图册，前期很有用后期用不上
b3-057-s013.whyLearn: 两个 which 从句由 but 并列修饰同一先行词，从句内又嵌 I did not think，展示定语从句的复杂挂接方式。

b3-057-s015.skeleton: my father had described over and over again

modifiers.text: what we should see at every milestone
so that I was positive I should recognize it as familiar territory
I should recognize it as familiar territory

b3-057-s015.gloss: 父亲反复描述沿途景象，让我确信认得路
b3-057-s015.whyLearn: 过去完成时交代此前的铺垫，what 从句与 so that 结果从句接力推进，体现时态与信息层次如何配合。

modifiers.text: and at this point, according to my father, I should be looking at farms and cottages in a valley
with the spire of the church of our village showing in the far distance

b3-057-s018.gloss: 走了十英里，父亲说该看到山谷村舍了
b3-057-s018.whyLearn: 插入语 according to my father 隔开主语与谓语，末尾 with 复合结构补出远景，练穿插成分与画面式描写。

b3-057-s025.gloss: 仿佛噩梦，周围无人能帮我
b3-057-s025.whyLearn: there be 存在句加插入语 as in a nightmare，再用不定式作后置定语，短句也能拆出三层结构。

b3-057-s026.skeleton: there appeared on the horizon a man on horseback

modifiers.text: as I was wondering what to do next

b3-057-s026.gloss: 我正不知所措，天边出现骑马人
b3-057-s026.whyLearn: there appeared 全倒装让主语后置，配 as 从句与 riding 分词短语，练倒装句与伴随动作的画面铺陈。

modifiers.text: that there was now no village

b3-057-s028.gloss: 他说现在村子已经不存在了
b3-057-s028.whyLearn: 最简宾语从句范例，主句只剩 He said，可体会英语 that 从句与汉语流水句在结构上的差别。

b3-057-s029.gloss: 我觉得他一定是误会我了
b3-057-s029.whyLearn: 省略 that 的宾语从句里用 must have done 表对过去的肯定推测，一句同时掌握推测语气与从句省略。

b3-058-s003.skeleton: her thoughts were on lunch and a good rest

modifiers.text: but when she got out at her own floor, both were forgotten in her sudden discovery that her front door was open
when she got out at her own floor
that her front door was open

b3-058-s003.gloss: 电梯里她想吃饭休息，见门开着全忘了
b3-058-s003.whyLearn: 分号连接两个独立分句，后半句时间状语从句前置、同位语从句后置，适合练长句的对称与嵌套。

modifiers.text: that she must reprimand her daily maid the next morning for such a monstrous piece of negligence
when she remembered that she had gone shopping after the maid had left
that she had gone shopping after the maid had left
and she knew that she had turned both keys in their locks
that she had turned both keys in their locks

b3-058-s004.gloss: 她正想着要责备女佣，忽然记起自己锁了门
b3-058-s004.whyLearn: when 这里意为就在此时，与过去进行时构成经典搭配，层层宾语从句展开她回忆的链条。

b3-058-s007.skeleton: It was as clear as daylight

modifiers.text: that burglars had forced an entry during her absence

b3-058-s007.gloss: 此时已很清楚，她不在时窃贼闯入
b3-058-s007.whyLearn: it 结构把 that 从句后置，主句先用 as clear as daylight 表态，练英语先评论后说事的语序习惯。

modifiers.text: to go round all the rooms
but then she decided that at her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her
that at her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her
so she went to fetch the porter from his basement

b3-058-s008.gloss: 她先想搜房抓贼，又觉年纪大应找人陪
b3-058-s008.whyLearn: but 与 so 串起三个动作，宾语从句里用 it 作形式主语加 might 表委婉，展示叙事句的因果推进。

b3-024-s005.skeleton: The reader's hair stands on end

modifiers.text: when he reads in the final pages of the novel
that the heroine, a dear old lady who had always been so kind to everybody, had, in her youth, poisoned every one of her five husbands
a dear old lady who had always been so kind to everybody
who had always been so kind to everybody
in the final pages of the novel

b3-024-s005.gloss: 读者得知女主人公年轻时毒死五任丈夫，毛骨悚然。
b3-024-s005.whyLearn: 时间状语从句里再套宾语从句和同位语，插入语把 had 和 poisoned 隔开，最能练长句断句。

b3-024-s017.skeleton: The sudden movement of the door made it sway slightly

modifiers.text: and it gave me the impression that it was about to leap out at me
that it was about to leap out at me

b3-024-s017.gloss: 门突然一动，雕像晃了晃，让他觉得它要扑过来。
b3-024-s017.whyLearn: make 后接宾语加动词原形，再用同位语从句解释 impression，一句涵盖两个高频句型。

b3-024-s021.skeleton: 'Oh, that,' he said with a smile

modifiers.text: as if he were talking about an old friend

b3-024-s021.gloss: 他笑着说“哦，那个”，仿佛在谈一位老朋友。
b3-024-s021.whyLearn: as if 后用 were 加进行时表示与事实相反的假设，是虚拟语气最轻巧的用法。

b3-025-s004.skeleton: sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia

modifiers.text: Before they were replaced by steam-ships
to carry tea from China and wool from Australia

b3-025-s004.gloss: 蒸汽船出现前，卡蒂萨克号专门运中国茶和澳洲羊毛。
b3-025-s004.whyLearn: Before 从句、被动语态和 be used to do 三层叠加，中间还插 like 短语，语序值得模仿。

b3-025-s015.skeleton: This greatly reduced the speed of the ship

that if she travelled too quickly, this rudder would be torn away as well

if she had not lost her rudder

b3-025-s021.whyLearn: no doubt 后的同位语从句里包着与过去相反的虚拟条件句，两个句型一次练到。

b3-026-s006.skeleton: advertisers not only offer free samples but free cars, free houses, and free trips round the world as well

modifiers.text: free cars, free houses, and free trips

b3-026-s006.gloss: 如今广告商不光送样品，还送汽车、房子和环球旅行。
b3-026-s006.whyLearn: not only ... but ... as well 的并列示范，注意介词短语 round the world 修饰 trips。

b3-026-s008.skeleton: Radio and television have made it possible

modifiers.text: for advertisers to capture the attention of millions of people in this way
to capture the attention of millions of people

b3-026-s008.gloss: 广播和电视让广告商能借此抓住千万人的注意力。
b3-026-s008.whyLearn: make it possible for sb to do 的 it 作形式宾语结构，是英语最常见的让某事变可能说法。

modifiers.text: that a crane had to be used to remove it from the lorry
to remove it from the lorry

b3-026-s021.gloss: 它太重了，只好用起重机把它从卡车上吊下来。
b3-026-s021.whyLearn: so ... that 结果从句里套被动语态和不定式，还带 had to 的必要性表达，一句三得。

b3-027-s003.skeleton: it is extremely difficult to estimate the true value of the services

modifiers.text: Though it may be possible to measure the value of material goods in terms of money
to estimate the true value of the services
to measure the value of material goods in terms of money

b3-027-s003.gloss: 物质可用钱衡量，服务对人的真正价值却极难估算。
b3-027-s003.whyLearn: Though 让步从句与形式主语 it 的句子对照，还含 in terms of 和定语从句，议论文高频。

b3-027-s005.skeleton: The conditions of society are such

modifiers.text: that skills have to be paid for in the same way that goods are paid for at a shop
in the same way that goods are paid for at a shop
that goods are paid for at a shop

b3-027-s005.gloss: 社会现状如此：技能必须像商店里的商品一样付费购买。
b3-027-s005.whyLearn: such that 结果从句与 the same way that 定语从句叠加，被动和 have to 同时出现。

b3-027-s013.skeleton: He has deliberately chosen to lead the life he leads and is fully aware of the consequences

modifiers.text: He, may never be sure where the next meal is coming from, but he is free from the thousands of anxieties which afflict other people
where the next meal is coming from

b3-027-s013.gloss: 他自愿过这生活，虽不知下顿饭在哪，却免于常人忧虑。
b3-027-s013.whyLearn: 完成时、定语从句、宾语从句和 but 并列挤在一句里，还与后句形成转折对照。

b3-027-s014.skeleton: His few material possession make it possible for him to move from place to place with ease

modifiers.text: for him to move from place to place with ease
to move from place to place
By having to sleep in the open
having to sleep in the open
he gets far closer to the world of nature than most of us ever do
than most of us ever do

b3-027-s014.gloss: 他物少反能轻便迁移；露宿户外，比多数人更亲自然。
b3-027-s014.whyLearn: 形式宾语 it 与比较级 than 从句各占半句，还提示 By doing 表方式，信息密度高。

b3-027-s016.skeleton: We often speak of tramps with contempt and put them in the same class as beggars

modifiers.text: in the same class as beggars
but how many of us can honestly say that we have not felt a little envious of their simple way of life and their freedom from care
that we have not felt a little envious of their simple way of life and their freedom from care
of their simple way of life and their freedom from care

b3-027-s016.gloss: 我们常鄙视流浪汉，可有几人敢说毫不羡慕他们的生活？
b3-027-s016.whyLearn: but 引出反问，宾语从句用否定加 a little 含蓄表达羡慕，语气技巧很值得学。

b3-028-s002.skeleton: the men from the boats had climbed on board and the decks were soon covered

modifiers.text: with colourful rugs from Persia, silks from India, copper coffee pots, and beautiful hand-made silver-ware
colourful rugs from Persia, silks from India, copper coffee pots, and beautiful hand-made silver-ware

b3-028-s002.gloss: 船未抛锚，小船上的人已登船，甲板很快铺满各国货物。
b3-028-s002.whyLearn: Before 从句配过去完成时，后半句用一串并列名词短语铺陈货物，场面描写经典。

modifiers.text: whether it would be comfortable to wear.

b3-013-s006.gloss: 她想弄清楚这鞋穿起来是否舒服。
b3-013-s006.whyLearn: whether 引导宾语从句，句末不定式 to wear 的逻辑主语要靠语境补出。

modifiers.text: Just as Mrs Richards was entering the dining-room,

b3-014-s003.gloss: 早在十四世纪，霍克伍德发现人们宁愿付钱了事。
b3-014-s003.whyLearn: that 引导同位语从句解释 discovery，would rather...than 是本课核心句型。

in that she never allowed her domestic staff to work more than eight hours a day
what was, in those days, an enlightened policy

b3-032-s010.skeleton: There were books, clothing and photographs

b3-032-s011.gloss: Elkor号船长命船员从残骸中尽量打捞
