modifiers.text: when justice almost ceases to be an abstract conception

b3-035-s006.gloss: 偶尔，公正几乎不再是抽象概念
b3-035-s006.whyLearn: instances后接when从句是地道搭配，cease to be把抽象名词写成会消失之物，句式短而有力

modifiers.text: When we use a phrase like it serves him right
that a certain set of circumstances has enabled justice to act of its own accord

b3-035-s009.gloss: 说“他活该”时，我们其实在承认公正会自行生效
b3-035-s009.whyLearn: 插入语in part让语气留有余地，句末that从句用现在完成时说明条件仍在起作用，说理层次分明

b3-035-s010.skeleton: the shop assistants must have found it impossible

modifiers.text: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large fur store one morning
on the premises of a large fur store
to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'

b3-035-s010.gloss: 某晨小偷在皮草店被抓，店员忍不住说“他活该”
b3-035-s010.whyLearn: must have done表推测，find it impossible to do用形式宾语，两层不定式叠加，是高级叙述句式

b3-035-s018.skeleton: The sorry-looking, blackened figure that emerged, at once admitted

modifiers.text: that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney

b3-035-s018.gloss: 发黑身影当场承认，夜里撬店不成反卡在烟囱里
b3-035-s018.whyLearn: 两个had done并列，讲清撬店在前、卡住随后；at once插入让认罪来得突然，画面感极强

b3-036-s001.skeleton: We are less credulous than we used to be
b3-036-s001.gloss: 我们比十九世纪的人少些轻信
b3-036-s001.whyLearn: less...than加used to be是比较级的实用组合，一句话对比今昔习惯；句末In the nineteenth已引出下句

b1-008-s009.whyLearn: 把 there be 提到句首就成一般疑问句，回答用 Yes, there are；还要用 your 而非 you，一句里同时练疑问式和所有格。

b1-010-s007.whyLearn: There's 是 There is 的口语缩写，后面接单数名词；ice cream 直接放在 man 前作定语，说明名词也能修饰名词。

b1-013-s003.whyLearn: 最典型的 there be 句型：先说存在什么，再用 in the kitchen 补位置，语序与汉语“厨房里有”正好相反，值得熟记。

b1-013-s006.whyLearn: electric 以元音音素开头，所以用 an 而不是 a；形容词作定语紧贴名词，注意 there be 后名词短语的内部顺序。

modifiers.text: in the middle of the room

b1-013-s009.whyLearn: in the middle of 是表“在……中间”的固定语块，它把位置说得比 in the room 更精确，可整体记下并替换后面的名词。

b1-013-s010.whyLearn: 同样是“在桌上”，这里用 on 而不用 in：瓶子与桌面接触，on 表表面接触，选介词看的是物体间的位置关系。

b1-013-s012.whyLearn: , too 放句尾表示“也”，是 there be 句追加信息的常见写法；注意它前面要用逗号与前面的内容隔开。

b1-014-s008.gloss: 房间里放着几把扶手椅。
b1-014-s008.whyLearn: armchair 由 arm 与 chair 合成，句中用复数 armchairs 并搭配 are；顺带记住这类合成名词的构成方式。

b1-014-s010.whyLearn: stereo 是可数名词单数，前面必须加 a；同一个 there be 框架反复出现，正是把它变成本能的好机会。

b1-014-s012.whyLearn: 用 on the stereo 给同一房间里的物品定位，on 表“在……上面”，与 on the television 用法一致，可互相迁移。

b1-016-s011.whyLearn: What about...? 是省略式的特殊疑问句，用来引出另一个对象征求看法，比完整问句更口语，值得整句背下来。

b3-054-s007.skeleton: Knowing that the industrious ant lives in a highlyorganized society does nothing

modifiers.text: that the industrious ant lives in a highlyorganized society
to prevent us from being filled with revulsion
when we find hordes of them crawling over a carefully prepared picnic lunch
crawling over a carefully prepared picnic lunch

b3-054-s007.gloss: 知道蚂蚁勤劳也挡不住我们对蚁群的厌恶
b3-054-s007.whyLearn: 主语是动名词短语加宾语从句，谓语does nothing易被误读，长主语是阅读难点。

b3-054-s016.skeleton: I am especially proud of it

modifiers.text: not only because it has survived several severe winters
but because it occasionally produces luscious peaches

b3-054-s016.gloss: 我为它骄傲，它熬过严冬，还结出美味桃子
b3-054-s016.whyLearn: not only...but...并列两个原因状语从句，把两个理由分层说出来。

b3-054-s020.skeleton: I immediately embarked on an experiment

modifiers.text: which, even though it failed to get rid of the ants, kept me fascinated for twenty-four hours
even though it failed to get rid of the ants
to get rid of the ants

b3-054-s020.gloss: 我着手做实验，虽没除掉蚂蚁，却让我着迷一天
b3-054-s020.whyLearn: 定语从句里插入让步状语从句，which与kept被隔开，是分裂句的典型。

modifiers.text: that they did not dare to cross it

b3-054-s022.gloss: 胶带太黏，它们不敢越过去
b3-054-s022.whyLearn: so...that引出结果从句，配合dare的否定用法，句子短但结构完整。

b3-054-s024.skeleton: I even went out at midnight with a torch and noted with satisfaction (and surprise)

modifiers.text: that the ants were still swarming around the sticky tape without being able to do anything about it
without being able to do anything about it

b3-054-s024.gloss: 我半夜拿手电去看，蚂蚁还被胶带困住团团转
b3-054-s024.whyLearn: 两个并列谓语各带介词短语和宾语从句，从句里再套介词加动名词，层次多。

b3-054-s027.skeleton: They were climbing up the wall of the house

modifiers.text: and then on to the leaves ofthe tree
on to the leaves ofthe tree

b3-054-s027.gloss: 它们爬上屋墙，又爬到树叶上
b3-054-s027.whyLearn: 并列结构省略了重复的谓语，后一半只剩介词短语，读时须补出climbing。

b3-055-s004.skeleton: The most powerful signals that have been received have been emitted

modifiers.text: by what seem to be truly colossal stars which scientists have named 'quasars'
what seem to be truly colossal stars which scientists have named 'quasars'

b3-055-s004.gloss: 最强信号来自被科学家称为类星体的巨大恒星
b3-055-s004.whyLearn: 主语与谓语被定语从句隔开，宾语又是what从句，是层层嵌套的长难句。

b3-055-s008.skeleton: Astronomers no longer regard as fanciful the idea

modifiers.text: that they may one day pick up signals which have been sent by intelligent beings on other worlds
which have been sent by intelligent beings on other worlds
sent by intelligent beings on other worlds

b3-055-s008.gloss: 天文学家不再认为那个想法是空想
b3-055-s008.whyLearn: regard as的宾语后置到补语之后，同位语从句里又套定语从句，语序值得留意。

b3-055-s011.skeleton: intelligent being which are just beginning to develop on remote worlds may be ready to pick up our signals

modifiers.text: which are just beginning to develop on remote worlds
to pick up our signals in thousands of years' time
or when life on earth has become extinct

b3-055-s011.gloss: 反过来，刚起步的外星文明或数千年后才收到我们的信号
b3-055-s011.whyLearn: 主语被定语从句切断，句尾用or并列两个时间状语，含when从句。

b3-055-s014.skeleton: scientists engaged in Project Ozma are concentrating their attention on stars

modifiers.text: Aware of the fact that it would be impossible to wait thousands or millions of years to receive an answer from a distant planet
that it would be impossible to wait thousands or millions of years to receive an answer from a distant planet
to wait thousands or millions of years to receive an answer from a distant planet
to receive an answer from a distant planet

b3-055-s014.gloss: 明知等不到回信，科学家仍专注观测近处恒星
b3-055-s014.whyLearn: 句首形容词短语作状语，主语又被分词短语后置修饰，是信息前置的写法。

b3-055-s025.skeleton: it would be narrow-minded in the extreme to ridicule these attempts

modifiers.text: In an age when anything seems to be possible
when anything seems to be possible
to ridicule these attempts to find out if there is life in other parts of the universe
to find out if there is life in other parts of the universe
if there is life in other parts of the universe
in other parts of the universe

b3-055-s025.gloss: 在一切皆有可能的时代，嘲笑这些尝试未免狭隘
b3-055-s025.whyLearn: it作形式主语，真正主语是不定式短语，其中还套着if引导的宾语从句。

b3-056-s002.skeleton: we could not make a living
b3-056-s002.gloss: 没有它我们就无法谋生
b3-056-s002.whyLearn: 介词短语表假设条件，配合could的否定式，极短却完整的含蓄条件句。

b3-056-s003.skeleton: There is only enough spring water

modifiers.text: to supply the needs of the house
so we have to pump from the river for farm use

b3-056-s003.gloss: 泉水只够家用，农用需从河里抽水
b3-056-s003.whyLearn: there be后接enough...to不定式，再用so引出并列分句，衔接很自然。

modifiers.text: just as beekeepers with their bees
that misfortune might overtake us if the important events of our lives were not related to it
if the important events of our lives were not related to it

b3-056-s005.gloss: 我们本能地知道，不把大事与它关联，厄运或会降临
b3-056-s005.whyLearn: 插入语把谓语和that宾语从句隔开，从句里还有虚拟条件句，信息密度高。

b3-056-s007.skeleton: Sometimes we go up-stream to a favourite backwater, some- times we have our party at the boathouse

modifiers.text: which a predecessor of ours at the farm built in the meadow hard by the deepest pool for swimming and diving
in the meadow hard by the deepest pool for swimming and diving

b3-056-s007.gloss: 有时去上游河湾，有时在船屋聚会，那是先辈所建
b3-056-s007.whyLearn: 两个分句用逗号并列，第二句带which定语从句，从句里介词短语层层叠加。

b3-056-s009.skeleton: We welcome the seasons by the river- side

modifiers.text: crowning the youngest girl with flowers in the spring
holding a summer festival on Midsummer Eve
giving thanks for the harvest in the autumn
and throwing a holly wreath into the current in the winter

b3-056-s009.gloss: 我们在河边迎四季：戴花、节庆、感恩、投花环
b3-056-s009.whyLearn: 四个现在分词短语并列作伴随状语，句式整齐，宜模仿写季节活动。

b3-058-s013.skeleton: She had lived in the flat for thirty years and was a veritable magpie at hoarding

modifiers.text: it seemed as though everything she possessed had been tossed out and turned over and over

b3-058-s013.gloss: 她住了三十年，攒物成癖；东西被翻得七零八落。
b3-058-s013.whyLearn: 过去完成时与被动语态连用，as though领出全句总结，可学两个分句如何各自成篇。

b3-058-s016.skeleton: The inspector began to look for fingerprints

modifiers.text: while the constable checked that the front door locks had not been forced
that the front door locks had not been forced
therebyproving that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony
that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony
either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony

b3-058-s016.gloss: 警长查指纹，警员查门锁，断定贼或撬锁或翻阳台。
b3-058-s016.whyLearn: while并列两线取证，thereby proving把结果压成分词，一句演完侦查推理全过程。

b3-058-s017.skeleton: There was no trace of fingerprints

modifiers.text: but the inspector found a dirty red bundle that contained jewellery which the old lady said was not hers
that contained jewellery which the old lady said was not hers
which the old lady said was not hers

b3-058-s017.gloss: 没有指纹，但警长找到一包首饰，老夫人说不认得。
b3-058-s017.whyLearn: 两个定语从句一环套一环，还夹进said式插入小句，是练嵌套修饰的典型句。

b3-058-s019.skeleton: The inspector then asked the old lady to try to check what was missing by the next day

modifiers.text: to try to check what was missing by the next day
and advised her not to stay alone in the flat for a few nights
not to stay alone in the flat for a few nights

b3-058-s019.gloss: 警长让她次日清点失物，并劝她别独自住几晚。
b3-058-s019.whyLearn: ask sb to do与advise sb not to do连用，一肯定一否定，正好对比不定式作补语的两种式。

b3-058-s020.skeleton: The old lady thought he was a fussy creature

modifiers.text: but since the porter agreed with him, she rang up her daughter and asked for her help in what she described as a little spot of bother
since the porter agreed with him
in what she described as a little spot of bother
what she described as a little spot of bother

b3-058-s020.gloss: 她觉得他小题大做，但门房同意，她便求助女儿。
b3-058-s020.whyLearn: since既表原因又插在句中，后面what从句作介词宾语，多层嵌套却不乱。

modifiers.text: who always cuts out from newspapers sketches of model clothes that she would like to buy, if she had the money
that she would like to buy

b3-059-s010.gloss: 我认识个人，总从报上剪下想买的时装图样。
b3-059-s010.whyLearn: cuts out…sketches宾语后置语序罕见，末尾又接虚拟条件，一句练语序加虚拟两难点。

b3-059-s011.skeleton: the chances that she will ever be able to afford such purchases are remote

modifiers.text: that she will ever be able to afford such purchases
but she is never sufficiently strongrminded to be able to stop the practice
to be able to stop the practice

b3-059-s011.gloss: 她不富裕，买不起；又总没毅力戒掉这习惯。
b3-059-s011.whyLearn: chances后接同位语从句说明内容，分号后but转折，两个难结构在一句里对照。

b3-059-s016.skeleton: there is always something to do in connection with it

modifiers.text: stamps, records, first editions of books, china, glass, antique furniture, pictures, model cars, stuffed birds, toy animals
from finding the right place for the latest addition to verifying facts in reference books
finding the right place for the latest addition

b3-059-s016.gloss: 收藏无论是什么，总有做不完的事要忙。
b3-059-s016.whyLearn: 句首Whatever让步，中间一串同位语列举藏品，末尾from…to收尾，尽显英文列举张力。

modifiers.text: not only in the chosen subject, but also in general matters which have some bearing on it
in general matters which have some bearing on it
which have some bearing on it

b3-059-s017.gloss: 这爱好既教专门知识，也教相关常识。
b3-059-s017.whyLearn: not only…but also连接两个介词短语，第二个还挂定语从句，短句里层次分明。

b3-059-s018.whyLearn: 最短的there be句，示范存在句加also的扩写方式，适合背诵模仿。

b3-059-s021.skeleton: Soon the hobby leads to travel

modifiers.text: perhaps to a meeting in another town, possibly a trip abroad in search of a rare specimen
in search of a rare specimen
for collectors are not confined to any one country

b3-059-s021.gloss: 爱好引你出行、赴会、远游寻珍，藏家不限一国。
b3-059-s021.whyLearn: 几个并列名词短语层层展开出行场景，句末for给出原因，学铺陈加解释的节奏。

b3-059-s022.skeleton: one may well become an authority on one's hobby and will very probably be asked to give informal talks

modifiers.text: to give informal talks to little gatherings and then, if successful, to larger audiences
to little gatherings and then, if successful, to larger audiences

b3-059-s022.gloss: 多年后你会成专家，受邀对小圈子乃至大场合讲话。
b3-059-s022.whyLearn: may well与will be asked并列，两个to短语共享不定式，条件插入语插在中间，结构精巧。

b3-060-s017.skeleton: this will be less than if you miss the train and have to wait an hour or more for the next one

modifiers.text: Although being early may mean wasting a little time
if you miss the train and have to wait an hour or more for the next one
and have to wait an hour or more for the next one
and you avoid the frustration of arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station and being unable to get onit
of arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station and being unable to get onit
when the train is drawing out of the station
arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station

b3-060-s017.gloss: 早到只浪费一点时间，胜过误车干等，也免了眼看车开的懊恼。
b3-060-s017.whyLearn: Although让步与if条件前后呼应，分号后and另起新句，展示长句如何分层推进。

b3-060-s019.skeleton: Such an experience befell a certain young girl

modifiers.text: the first time she was travelling alone

b3-060-s019.gloss: 一位年轻女孩初次独自出行时，就碰上了这种事。
b3-060-s019.whyLearn: the first time直接当连词引导时间从句，比when更地道，值得记住。

modifiers.text: since her parents had impressed upon her that it would be unforgivable to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her
that it would be unforgivable to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her
to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her
with whom she was going to stay
to make two journeys to meet her

b3-060-s020.gloss: 她提前二十分钟到站，因为父母叮嘱误车不可原谅。
b3-060-s020.whyLearn: since从句里宾语从句套定语从句再套不定式，三层嵌套，是拆长句的好范本。

modifiers.text: that a train did come into the station at the time on the paper
at the time on the paper
but only to take on water, not passengers

b3-060-s024.gloss: 他承认确有那班车进站停车，但只加水不载客。
b3-060-s024.whyLearn: 两个that宾语从句并列，did强调谓语，末尾only to道出真相，语气转折干净。

b3-045-s031.skeleton: The town itself received so much attention

modifiers.text: that almost every one of the inhabitants was affected to a greater or less degree

b3-045-s031.gloss: 小镇备受关注，居民几乎都受到影响。
b3-045-s031.whyLearn: so...that 引出结果状语从句，that 不可省；was affected 是被动，说“受影响”比 affect 更常见。

b3-046-s002.skeleton: No one can plead ignorance of a subject any longer

modifiers.text: for there are countless do-it-yourself publications

b3-046-s002.gloss: 如今谁也不能再说自己对某事一无所知。
b3-046-s002.whyLearn: for 作并列连词表原因，比 because 书面；any longer 与否定连用表“不再”，可多套用。

modifiers.text: When lights fuse, furniture gets rickety, pipes get clogged, or vacuum cleaners fail to operate
that their husbands will somehow put things right

b3-046-s010.gloss: 家里东西一出毛病，妻子就认定丈夫能修好。
b3-046-s010.whyLearn: 四个小句用 when 统起，写“一……就……”的清单很省力；assume that 后接将来时，put things right 很地道。

b3-046-s011.skeleton: The worst thing about the do-it-yourself game is

modifiers.text: that sometimes husbands live under the delusion that they can do anything
even when they have been repeatedly proved wrong

b3-046-s011.gloss: 自己动手最大的问题是丈夫总自以为什么都会。
b3-046-s011.whyLearn: The worst thing is that... 是评价句式万能开头；delusion 后再套 that 从句，可见宾语从句能嵌套。

b3-046-s012.skeleton: It is a question of pride
b3-046-s012.gloss: 这与其说是别的，不如说是面子问题。
b3-046-s012.whyLearn: as much as anything else 是英式口语里常见的补充说明，放在句尾就不把话说死；换个名词即可评价别的事。

b3-046-s017.skeleton: it only needed a minor adjustment

modifiers.text: As far as I could see
a turn of a screw here, a little tightening up there, a drop of oil

b3-046-s017.gloss: 在我看来，只需几处小调整就能修好。
b3-046-s017.whyLearn: As far as I could see 是限定“在我看来”的现成引语；冒号后用三个 a+名词短语罗列小动作，可把任意修理清单这样铺开。

modifiers.text: that the machine still refusedto work after I had reassembled it
for the simple reason that I was left with several curiously shaped bits of metal
which did not seem to fit anywhere

b3-046-s024.gloss: 重装后机器仍不转，我毫不意外。
b3-046-s024.whyLearn: be surprised to find that... 串起不定式与宾语从句；for the simple reason that 收原因

modifiers.text: either I would have to buy a new mower or let the grass grow
When my wife nagged me to do something about it

b3-046-s027.gloss: 妻子催我修，我说要么买新机要么任草长。
b3-046-s027.whyLearn: tell sb. that 的宾语从句里嵌 either...or... 并列两个方案，既练从句又练并列，谈判、抱怨都用得上。

modifiers.text: which I have promised to repair

b3-046-s029.gloss: 深草里埋着一台我答应要修的割草机。
b3-046-s029.whyLearn: 过去分词 buried 摆在句首作状语，画面感强；there be 主句后接定语从句，是描写场景的常用组合。

b3-047-s010.skeleton: is driven by a turbine engine which is propelled by liquid mud pumped into it from the surface

modifiers.text: which is being tested at Leona Valley Ranch in Texas
which is propelled by liquid mud
pumped into it from the surface

b3-047-s010.gloss: 新钻机由泥浆推动的涡轮机驱动。
b3-047-s010.whyLearn: 一句话里嵌两个被动定语从句，还带过去分词短语，是科技说明文压缩信息的典型写法，学会就能读懂长句。

b3-047-s016.skeleton: scientists will have to overcome a number of problems

modifiers.text: Before it is possible to drill this deep hole

b3-047-s016.gloss: 钻这么深的井前，科学家得先解决许多问题。
b3-047-s016.whyLearn: Before 从句用 it is possible to do，主句用 will have to；写计划或难点照这个骨架来。

b3-047-s028.skeleton: Great care will therefore have to be taken

modifiers.text: to keep the platform steady and make it strong enough to withstand hurricanes

b3-047-s028.gloss: 因此必须格外小心，保持平台稳固抗飓风。
b3-047-s028.whyLearn: will have to be taken 是“将来必须被……”的完整被动式，后接不定式表目的。

b3-047-s029.skeleton: scientists will not only learn a great deal about the earth

modifiers.text: not only learn a great deal about the earth, but possibly about the nature of the universe itself

b3-047-s029.gloss: 若项目成功，科学家将大大了解地球乃至宇宙。
b3-047-s029.whyLearn: if 从句用现在时、主句用将来时，是条件句的基本配合；not only 与 but 并列两个 about 短语，可见并列可以省掉重复动词。

b3-048-s001.gloss: 在这个旅游发达的世界，仍有成千上万的地方。
b3-048-s001.whyLearn: there are 前加 In this...world 的地点状语，是开启介绍性段落的稳妥开头；thousands of 表示笼统的大量。

b3-048-s003.skeleton: people who are cut off not only from foreign tourists, but even from their own countrymen can be hostile to travellers

modifiers.text: who are cut off not only from foreign tourists, but even from their own countrymen
not only from foreign tourists, but even from their own countrymen

b3-048-s003.gloss: 与外界隔绝的人可能对旅行者怀有敌意。
b3-048-s003.whyLearn: can be 表“有时会”，比 are 缓和；who 从句里又套 not only...but even...，定语从句能装并列。

modifiers.text: for they were not only of great architectural interest, but contained alarge number of beautifully preserved frescoes as well

b3-048-s006.gloss: 这些因建筑价值和精美壁画吸引众多游客。
b3-048-s006.whyLearn: for 引出原因分句，not only...but...as well 把两个理由并列整齐，of great interest 更书面。

b2-071-s003.skeleton: the great clock would never have been erected

modifiers.text: If the Houses of Parliament had hot been burned down in 1834

b2-071-s003.gloss: 若无1834年大火，大本钟便不会建成。
b2-071-s003.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句：if 从句用过去完成时，主句用 would have been done 的被动形式。

b2-071-s004.skeleton: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall

modifiers.text: who was responsible for the making of the clock
when the new Houses of Parliament were being built

b2-071-s004.gloss: 大本钟得名于负责造钟的本杰明·霍尔。
b2-071-s004.whyLearn: 定语从句里再套时间状语从句，were being built 展示过去进行时的被动语态。

b2-071-s005.skeleton: It is not only of immense size

modifiers.text: but is extremely accurate as well

b2-071-s005.gloss: 它体积巨大，走时也极其精准。
b2-071-s005.whyLearn: not only...but...as well 连接两个谓语，后一分句重复 be 动词是固定用法。

b2-071-s006.skeleton: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked
b2-071-s006.gloss: 格林尼治天文台官员每天两次校钟。
b2-071-s006.whyLearn: have sth done 表示请人做某事，checked 是过去分词作宾语补足语。

b2-071-s012.skeleton: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint

modifiers.text: who had been working on the tower

b2-071-s012.gloss: 油漆工把油漆罐挂在指针上，让钟变慢。
b2-071-s012.whyLearn: who 从句修饰主语，hung 与 slowed 并列，过去完成进行时强调持续动作。

b2-072-s003.skeleton: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built
b2-072-s003.gloss: 他开的 Bluebird 是专为他打造的。
b2-072-s003.whyLearn: 同位语插在主语之后，had been built 是过去完成时被动，从句省略了关系词。

b2-072-s005.skeleton: he had great difficulty in controlling the car

modifiers.text: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour
because a tyre burst during the first run

b2-072-s005.gloss: 虽时速超304英里，爆胎却让他难以控车。
b2-072-s005.whyLearn: Although 让步与 because 原因两个从句夹住主句，have difficulty in doing 是高频搭配。

b2-072-s011.skeleton: he was driving a car called Bluebird
b2-072-s011.gloss: 像父亲一样，他开的车叫 Bluebird。
b2-072-s011.whyLearn: 过去进行时描写当时情景，called Bluebird 是分词短语作后置定语。

b2-073-s002.skeleton: A quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get

modifiers.text: or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again
seeing the same film over and over again

b2-073-s002.gloss: 他们最多不过钓一天鱼或连看几场电影。
b2-073-s002.whyLearn: 长并列主语后接 is usually as far as they get，as far as 表程度的上限。

b2-073-s003.skeleton: They have all been put to shame by a boy

modifiers.text: who, while playing truant, travelled 1600 miles

b2-073-s003.gloss: 逃学的男孩用行动让他们汗颜。
b2-073-s003.whyLearn: 被动语态用 by 引出施动者，定语从句中又嵌入 while 引导的时间状语。

modifiers.text: When he woke up next morning
that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais

b2-073-s005.gloss: 他醒来发现船已到了加来。
b2-073-s005.whyLearn: 宾语从句用过去完成时表示更早发生，插入语 in the meantime 插在主谓之间。

modifiers.text: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,'

b2-074-s004.gloss: 格洛丽亚说这儿是野餐的好地方。
b2-074-s004.whyLearn: 直接引语在前、said + 人名在后，引语里的 is 与 said 时态形成对照。

b2-074-s007.whyLearn: Why don't we + 动词原形是提建议的固定问句，语序与否定形式要记牢。

modifiers.text: When they had all made themselves comfortable

b2-074-s009.gloss: 众人刚安顿好，一个陌生人出现了。
b2-074-s009.whyLearn: 从句用过去完成时表示先发生，主句用一般过去时，时态先后一目了然。

b2-074-s014.gloss: 牌子写着禁止露营，怕你不识字。
b2-074-s014.whyLearn: It says 后可直接引出标牌原文，in case 引导以防万一的状语从句。

b2-075-s009.skeleton: The woman kept as near as she could to the children

modifiers.text: and even tried to get into the case herself

b2-075-s009.gloss: 她尽量靠近孩子，还想钻进行李箱，可箱子太小。
b2-075-s009.whyLearn: as...as she could 表尽力，try to do 接不定式，三个分句由 and、but 并列。

b3-028-s005.skeleton: I had no sooner got off the ship than I was assailed by a man

modifiers.text: who wanted to sell me a diamond ring

b3-028-s005.gloss: 我刚下船就被一个推销钻戒的人缠上。
b3-028-s005.whyLearn: no sooner...than 搭配被动语态和 who 定语从句，一句里三个考点，适合整体背诵。

b3-028-s006.skeleton: I had no intention of buying one, but I could not conceal the fact

modifiers.text: that I was impressed by the size of the diamonds
by the size of the diamonds

b3-028-s006.gloss: 我无意购买，却掩饰不住对钻石之大印象深刻。
b3-028-s006.whyLearn: have no intention of doing 与 the fact that 同位语从句合用，是否认与承认的对照写法。

b3-028-s007.skeleton: Some of them were as big as marbles
b3-028-s007.gloss: 其中一些钻石有弹珠那么大。
b3-028-s007.whyLearn: some of 与 as...as 同级比较都很短，适合当作产出句型直接套用描述大小。

b3-028-s009.skeleton: he held a diamond firmly against the window and made a deep impression in the glass

modifiers.text: As we were walking past a shop

b3-028-s009.gloss: 走过商店时，他把钻石抵住玻璃压出深痕。
b3-028-s009.whyLearn: as 引导时间状语从句配过去进行时，主句两个谓语并列，适合练同时进行加连续动作的描写。

b3-028-s010.skeleton: It took me over half an hour
b3-028-s010.gloss: 我花了半个多小时才摆脱他。
b3-028-s010.whyLearn: it takes sb 时间 to do 是高频句型，配 get rid of 这个短语，整句背下来最省事。

b3-028-s019.skeleton: I shook my head and held up a finger

modifiers.text: indicating that I was willing topay a pound
that I was willing topay a pound

b3-028-s019.gloss: 我摇头并竖起一根手指，表示愿出一英镑。
b3-028-s019.whyLearn: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，内部再套 that 宾语从句，是给动作补充说明的实用写法。

b3-029-s003.skeleton: A Frenchman, for instance, might find it hard

modifiers.text: to laugh at a Russian joke

b3-029-s003.gloss: 比如法国人可能觉得俄国笑话不好笑。
b3-029-s003.whyLearn: find it hard to do 的形式宾语结构，加上插入语 for instance，是举例论证的常用句式。

modifiers.text: not to laugh at, say, Charlie Chaplin's early films

b3-029-s007.gloss: 无论你住哪儿，都会觉得卓别林早期电影好笑。
b3-029-s007.whyLearn: no matter where 让步状语从句加 find it difficult not to do，一句集中两个高级结构。

b3-029-s018.skeleton: He spenta miserable day in bed

modifiers.text: thinking of all the fun he was missing

b3-029-s018.gloss: 他在床上郁闷地过了一天，想着错过的乐子。
b3-029-s018.whyLearn: spend 加时间加 doing 结构里嵌一个省略关系词的定语从句，一句收获两个高频点。

modifiers.text: that the Cox brothers employed a conscientious ghost that did most of their work for them
that did most of their work for them

b3-030-s008.gloss: 后来，考克斯兄弟雇了个勤快鬼干活成了公认的事。
b3-030-s008.whyLearn: 同位语从句和定语从句同句出现，两个 that 职责不同，对比着看最容易分清。

b3-030-s017.skeleton: he returned to the farm and his farther hid him

modifiers.text: When he learnt that he would be sent abroad
that he would be sent abroad
until the end of the war

b3-030-s017.gloss: 他得知将被送出国后回农场，父亲藏起他直到战后。
b3-030-s017.whyLearn: 时间状语从句里套宾语从句，再用 and 并列两个主句，适合练长句的层次切分。

b3-030-s024.skeleton: He used to sleep during the day and work at night

modifiers.text: quite unaware of the fact that he had become the ghost of Endley
that he had become the ghost of Endley

b3-030-s024.gloss: 他习惯白天睡夜里干活，全然不知自己成了恩德利鬼。
b3-030-s024.whyLearn: used to 表过去习惯，后接并列动词，再加形容词短语和同位语从句收尾，是叙述文的典型句式。

modifiers.text: to keep the secret any longer

b3-030-s025.gloss: 他死后，兄弟们再也守不住这个秘密。
b3-030-s025.whyLearn: find it impossible to do 的形式宾语，插入语 however 位置灵活，可对比汉语语序体会。

b3-031-s011.skeleton: He wanted to buy a &300 fur coat for his wife, but he was in such a bedraggled condition

modifiers.text: to buy a &300 fur coat for his wife
that an assistant refused to serve him

b3-031-s011.gloss: 他想给妻子买件三百镑大衣，却因衣衫褴褛被店员拒绝。
b3-031-s011.whyLearn: such...that 结果状语从句前带不定式宾语，wanted to buy 与 refused to serve 形成对照。

b3-031-s020.skeleton: This exhibition received a great deal of attention in the press

modifiers.text: for though the pictures were supposed to be the work of famous artists, they had in fact been painted by Dickie
though the pictures were supposed to be the work of famous artists

b3-031-s020.gloss: 展览在报上备受关注，因画作虽号称名家实为迪基所作。
b3-031-s020.whyLearn: for 引导的并列原因句里再嵌 though 让步和 be supposed to 被动，靠连词切分就能读懂长句。

modifiers.text: to stage this elaborate joke simply to prove that critics do not always know what they are talking about
to prove that critics do not always know what they are talking about
that critics do not always know what they are talking about

b3-031-s021.gloss: 他花四年策划这场玩笑，只为证明评论家常常不懂装懂。
b3-031-s021.whyLearn: it took sb time to do 里层层套目的状语与宾语从句，末尾以 what 从句收束，是练长句的好材料。

b3-039-s013.gloss: 我们正前方有一道巨大的裂缝。
b3-039-s013.whyLearn: there be把新信息放在句尾，地点状语提前先铺垫环境，是写险情最省力的起手式。

b3-039-s023.skeleton: A yellow light on the dash- board flashed angrily

modifiers.text: and Bruce cheerfully announced that there was no oil in the engine!
that there was no oil in the engine

b3-039-s023.gloss: 仪表盘黄灯怒闪，布鲁斯却笑说引擎没油了。
b3-039-s023.whyLearn: and把机械警报和人物欢快口吻并置，反差就是幽默；that从句负责交代坏消息。

b3-040-s003.skeleton: Inviting the fire-brigade to put out a non-existent fire is a crude form of deception

modifiers.text: to put out a non-existent fire
which no self-respecting student would ever indulge in
which are funny to everyone except the victims

b3-040-s003.gloss: 请消防队扑灭不存在的火，是拙劣骗术。
b3-040-s003.whyLearn: 动名词短语作主语下定义，再用两个which从句分别补充定义和后果，段落骨架清晰。

b3-040-s004.skeleton: he immediately telephoned the police and informed them

modifiers.text: When a student recently saw two workmen using a pneumatic drill outside his university
using a pneumatic drill outside his university
that two students dressed up as workmen were tearing up the road with a pneumatic drill

b3-040-s004.gloss: 学生见有人用风钻挖路，便报警谎报。
b3-040-s004.whyLearn: when从句交代背景，主句用and串两个谓语，that宾语从句里再嵌分词定语，层层套接。

b3-040-s005.skeleton: he went over to the workmen and told them

modifiers.text: As soon as he had hung up
that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they were not to take him seriously
if a policeman ordered them to go away

b3-040-s005.gloss: 挂断电话后，他过去叮嘱工人别把警察当真。
b3-040-s005.whyLearn: as soon as领时间、that领宾语、if领条件，三种从句在一句里各就各位，适合拆位练习。

b3-040-s019.skeleton: did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax

modifiers.text: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police
that the man was actually telephoning the police
that they had all been the victims of a hoax

b3-040-s019.gloss: 直到看见对方真报警，他才明白大家都被骗了。
b3-040-s019.whyLearn: Only加状语置于句首引发部分倒装，助动词did提前，是考试和写作里最典型的强调句式。

b3-041-s001.skeleton: The quiet life of the country has never appealed to m
b3-041-s001.gloss: 乡间的宁静生活从未吸引过我。
b3-041-s001.whyLearn: has never appealed to是现在完成时否定式的固定搭配，主语后置of短语，结构干净好套用。

b3-041-s010.skeleton: He says nothing about the poor selection of goods in the shops, or about those unfortunate people

modifiers.text: about the poor selection of goods in the shops
about those unfortunate people who have to travel from the country to the city every day to get to work
who have to travel from the country to the city every day to get to work

b3-041-s010.gloss: 他对商店货色差和通勤族的辛苦只字不提。
b3-041-s010.whyLearn: or并列两个about介词短语，第二个再挂who定语从句和目的不定式，长句靠并列撑起来。

b3-041-s013.skeleton: you will find the city can provide you with the best that life can offer

modifiers.text: If you can do without the few pastoral pleasures of the country
the city can provide you with the best that life can offer

b3-041-s013.gloss: 若能舍弃乡间田园之乐，城市会给你最好的生活。
b3-041-s013.whyLearn: if条件加find后省略that的宾语从句，the best后再接that定语从句，三层嵌套一次看清。

b3-041-s014.skeleton: You never have to travel miles
b3-041-s014.gloss: 你不必跑很远的路去见朋友。
b3-041-s014.whyLearn: never与have to连用表示不必，句尾to see表目的，一句话写尽城市生活的便利。

modifiers.text: that you never have to make do with second best

b3-041-s022.gloss: 花样太多，你无须将就次等货色。
b3-041-s022.whyLearn: so...that结果状语从句配上there be和make do with，把选择丰富说得干脆有力。

modifiers.text: about the warm glow shed by advertisements on cold wet winter nights
shed by advertisements on cold wet winter nights

b3-041-s025.gloss: 寒夜冷雨里，广告的暖光令人安心。
b3-041-s025.whyLearn: there be接名词加形容词，再用about短语和过去分词shed后置修饰，是写景抒情的常用模板。

b3-041-s026.skeleton: Few things could be more impressive than the peace

modifiers.text: that descends on deserted city streets at week-ends
when the thousands that travel to work everyday are tucked a way in their homes in the country

b3-041-s026.gloss: 周末人潮归乡后，城里街上的宁静最动人。
b3-041-s026.whyLearn: Few things could be more...than用否定式比较级表示最高级，后面还套定语和when时间从句。

b3-041-s027.skeleton: It has always been a mystery to me

modifiers.text: why city dwellers, who appreciate all these things, obstinately pretend that they would prefer to live in the country
that they would prefer to live in the country

b3-041-s027.gloss: 城里人享受这些却硬说想住乡下，令我费解。
b3-041-s027.whyLearn: It作形式主语，真正主语是why从句，从句里还插who定语和that宾语从句，适合练长主语。

b3-042-s003.skeleton: It is impossible to give a satisfactory explanation

modifiers.text: to give a satisfactory explanation for a pot-holer's motives

b3-042-s003.gloss: 洞穴探险者的动机难以给出令人满意的解释。
b3-042-s003.whyLearn: It作形式主语、不定式作真正主语，是英语避免句子头重脚轻最常用的一招。

b3-042-s009.skeleton: Precautions of this sort are necessary

modifiers.text: for it is impossible to foretell the exact nature of the difficulties which will confront the potholer
to foretell the exact nature of the difficulties which will confront the potholer

b3-042-s009.gloss: 这类预防是必要的，因为无法预知会遇到什么难题。
b3-042-s009.whyLearn: for引出原因分句，it作形式主语配不定式，名词后接which定语从句，书面语范本。

modifiers.text: and experts confirmed that a puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered
that a puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered

b3-001-s005.gloss: 它一见人就跑；专家说美洲狮被逼急了才袭人。
b3-001-s005.whyLearn: when时间状语、that宾语从句、unless条件状语三层嵌套，主句过去时而从句用将来时，时态对比典型。

modifiers.text: to think that a dangerous wild animal is still at large in the quiet countryside
that a dangerous wild animal is still at large in the quiet countryside

b3-001-s013.gloss: 想到危险野兽仍在这宁静乡间游荡，令人不安。
b3-001-s013.whyLearn: it作形式主语，真正主语是不定式短语，其中再套that宾语从句；at large是地道表达，值得背。

b3-002-s002.skeleton: The big clock which used to strike the hours day and night was damaged many years ago and has been silent ever since

modifiers.text: which used to strike the hours day and night

b3-002-s002.gloss: 大钟多年前损坏，从此再没响过。
b3-002-s002.whyLearn: 定语从句把主语和谓语隔开，读时须抓住was damaged与has been silent两个谓语。

b3-002-s011.gloss: 你瞧，我本想给你个惊喜。
b3-002-s011.whyLearn: You see是口语插入语；was hoping用过去进行时表委婉，比I hoped更客气。

modifiers.text: but I'm afraid that at one o'clock it will strike thirteen times and there's nothing I can do about it
that at one o'clock it will strike thirteen times and there's nothing I can do about it
and there's nothing I can do about it

b3-002-s017.gloss: 钟走得还行，只怕一点会敲十三下，我没办法。
b3-002-s017.whyLearn: but转折后接that宾语从句，从句里用and并列there be句，还嵌省略that的定语从句。

b3-002-s018.skeleton: We'll get used to that Bill
b3-002-s018.gloss: 我们要习惯这种事的，比尔。牧师说。
b3-002-s018.whyLearn: 区分get used to(习惯于)与used to do(过去常做)，并注意引语在前、said the vicar在后的写法。

b3-002-s019.skeleton: Thirteen is not as good as one
b3-002-s019.gloss: 十三虽不如一，但总比什么都没有强。
b3-002-s019.whyLearn: not as...as与better than两个比较结构并列对照，注意否定比较后but转折的语感。

b3-003-s015.skeleton: She was wearing a full-length skirt
b3-003-s015.whyLearn: 过去进行时描绘当时穿着状态，which定语从句修饰skirt，复习两个高频考点。

b3-004-s002.skeleton: People who work in offices are frequently referred to as' white collar workers'

modifiers.text: for the simple reason that they usually wear a collar and tie to go to work
that they usually wear a collar and tie to go to work

b3-004-s002.gloss: 办公室职员因常穿衬衫打领带而被称作白领。
b3-004-s002.whyLearn: 主语后接who定语从句，reason后接that同位语从句，中间还夹被动短语，是长句切分好例子。

modifiers.text: to say anything to his wife about his job

b3-004-s005.gloss: 婚后阿尔弗太窘，不敢和妻子谈自己的工作。
b3-004-s005.whyLearn: too...to表示‘太…而不能’，后接三个短语层层叠加，when时间状语从句先行，语序紧凑。

b3-005-s012.skeleton: Not only had the poor man been arrested

modifiers.text: but he had been sent to prison as well

b3-005-s012.gloss: 那可怜人不只被捕，还被送进了监狱。
b3-005-s012.whyLearn: Not only置于句首引起部分倒装，后接but并列；两谓语都是过去完成时被动，双重考点。

b3-005-s013.skeleton: he had at last been allowed to send a cable

modifiers.text: in which he informed the editor that he had been arrested while counting the 1084 steps leading to the 15-foot wall which surrounded the president's palace
that he had been arrested while counting the 1084 steps leading to the 15-foot wall which surrounded the president's palace
while counting the 1084 steps leading to the 15-foot wall which surrounded the president's palace
leading to the 15-foot wall which surrounded the president's palace

b3-005-s013.gloss: 他终获准发电报，告知编辑自己数台阶时被捕。
b3-005-s013.whyLearn: 一句串起定语从句、宾语从句、分词短语和while状语，是练习长句拆解与被动时态的好样本。

b3-006-s015.skeleton: Mr Taylor rushed out and ran after it

modifiers.text: but it was impossible to stop the thieves

b3-006-s015.gloss: 它要走时泰勒冲出去追，扔东西也拦不住贼。
b3-006-s015.whyLearn: Just as引导时间状语从句，主句两动词并列，throwing分词表伴随，最后but转折，节奏分明。

b3-007-s003.skeleton: Most of the inhabitants were asked to take part in the exercise

modifiers.text: to take part in the exercise
during which they had to pretend that their city had been bombed
that their city had been bombed

b3-007-s003.gloss: 多数居民被要求参加演习，须假装城市已被轰炸。
b3-007-s003.whyLearn: 被动谓语后接不定式，during which定语从句又套宾语从句，最后用过去完成时被动。

b3-007-s010.skeleton: Theatrical make-up and artificial blood had been used

modifiers.text: to make the injuries look realistic

b3-007-s010.gloss: 戏剧化妆与假血被用来让伤口看起来很逼真。
b3-007-s010.whyLearn: had been used是过去完成时被动，后接make sb/sth do结构，复习被动态与不带to的不定式。

b3-007-s016.gloss: 有些人被这景象感动得哭了起来。
b3-007-s016.whyLearn: so...that引导结果状语从句，被动谓语中夹by短语，句子虽短却含两个句式。

b3-042-s025.skeleton: they could hear an insistent booming sound

modifiers.text: In this part of the cave
which they found was caused by a small water-spout shooting down into a pool from the roof of the cave
from the roof of the cave

b3-042-s025.gloss: 洞中他们听见水柱击水的轰鸣
b3-042-s025.whyLearn: which 从句里嵌入 they found 主谓，再套被动语态，一句示范多层嵌套的读法。

b3-042-s029.skeleton: the only sound that could be heard was made by water

modifiers.text: In the eerie silence of the cavern
which dripped continuously from the high dome above them
from the high dome above them

b3-042-s029.gloss: 寂静洞窟里唯一声响来自滴水
b3-042-s029.whyLearn: 主语被 that 被动从句拉长，谓语 was made by 后置，考验主干定位能力。

b3-043-s004.skeleton: the higher the premium you will have to pay

modifiers.text: the bigger the risk an insurance company takes

b3-043-s004.whyLearn: the+比较级,the+比较级表正比，risk 后省略关系词的定语从句也要识别。

b3-043-s005.skeleton: It is not uncommon to hear

modifiers.text: that a ship-ping company has made a claim for the cost of salvaging a sunken ship
for the cost of salvaging a sunken ship

b3-043-s005.whyLearn: 双重否定 not uncommon 弱化肯定，宾语从句内再套现在完成时与动名词。

b3-043-s016.skeleton: The sides of the dish were so smooth

modifiers.text: that it was almost impossible to attach hawsers and chains to the rim without damaging it
to attach hawsers and chains to the rim

b3-043-s016.whyLearn: so...that 引结果从句，without+动名词说明无法回避的连带后果。

modifiers.text: that it set up a huge wave in the canal

b3-043-s025.whyLearn: such...that 表结果，程度由 with such force 铺垫，写水势凶猛可直接套用。

modifiers.text: that the wave would rebound off the other side of the bank and send the dish plunging into the water again
and send the dish plunging into the water again
off the other side of the bank

b3-043-s026.gloss: 危险在于浪会把盘子再掀下水
b3-043-s026.whyLearn: danger 后同位语从句说明内容，would 表过去将来，and 并列两个谓语。

modifiers.text: to take your mind off the journey

b3-044-s004.whyLearn: It 作形式主语，真主语是不定式，take one's mind off 是固定搭配。

modifiers.text: If you are lucky enough to get a couchette
staring at the small blue light in the ceiling
or fumbling to find your passport

b3-044-s008.gloss: 夜行车上要么盯着灯要么找护照
b3-044-s008.whyLearn: spend 后接两个并列 -ing 短语，条件与时间从句前后夹住，句式对称。

b3-044-s011.skeleton: the greater part of the journey is spent on narrow, bumpy roads

modifiers.text: you can, at least, travel fairly safely at high speeds

b3-044-s011.gloss: 高速安全，但多数路段拥挤颠簸
b3-044-s011.whyLearn: but 并列两分句，被动 be spent 与 which 从句叠加，插入语拉开口语节奏。

modifiers.text: even when such refinements are not available

b3-044-s024.gloss: 即便无这些设施也够你忙
b3-044-s024.whyLearn: even when 从句带让步意味，后接 there be 存在句，不定式后置修饰 plenty。

b3-044-s028.skeleton: you can enjoy the extraordinary sight

modifiers.text: If the landscape is hidden from view
that stretch out for miles before you
while the sun shines brilliantly in a clear sky

b3-044-s028.gloss: 地面被遮时反能看云海
b3-044-s028.whyLearn: 条件从句用被动，主句情态动词后接 that 从句，while 从句形成明暗对照。

modifiers.text: that there is nothing to prevent you from reading or sleeping
to prevent you from reading or sleeping

b3-044-s029.gloss: 旅程平稳无人打扰阅读睡眠
b3-044-s029.whyLearn: so...that 引出 there be 存在句，不定式 prevent sb from doing 表阻止。

b3-045-s010.skeleton: They were expecting their sixth child

modifiers.text: and faced with even more pressing economic problems
with even more pressing economic problems

b3-045-s010.gloss: 他们迎来第六胎且经济更拮据
b3-045-s010.whyLearn: 过去进行时铺背景，and 连接被动式 faced with，两层困境并列呈现。

modifiers.text: not only from unknown people, but from baby food and soap manufacturers
from baby food and soap manufacturers
who wished to advertise their products

b3-045-s019.gloss: 礼物从陌生人和厂商涌来
b3-045-s019.whyLearn: not only...but 并列两个介词短语，who 从句补充厂商动机，层层递进。

b3-045-s029.skeleton: It would never again be possible
b3-045-s029.gloss: 他们再也无法过正常生活
b3-045-s029.whyLearn: would 表过去将来，never again 插在助动词与 be 之间，不定式是真主语。

b2-039-s004.skeleton: Mr Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient

modifiers.text: When the doctor answered the phone

b2-039-s004.gloss: 医生接电话时，吉尔伯特先生说他在询问一位病人。
b2-039-s004.whyLearn: 主句said后接宾语从句，从句用过去进行时表当时正在进行的动作，句末同位语补充病人身份。

b2-039-s006.skeleton: He then asked when Mr Gilbert would be allowed to go home and the doctor told him

modifiers.text: when Mr Gilbert would be allowed to go home
that he would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks

b2-039-s006.gloss: 他问吉尔伯特何时能出院，医生答需再住院两周。
b2-039-s006.whyLearn: 一句里连用两个宾语从句，间接疑问句用陈述语序，被动与情态表达许可，是转述对话的好范例。

b2-040-s015.skeleton: I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner

modifiers.text: whether she was enjoying her dinner

b2-040-s015.gloss: 绝望中我问她晚饭吃得是否开心。
b2-040-s015.whyLearn: 介词短语In despair前置点出心情，whether引导的间接疑问句保持陈述语序，是转述疑问的典范。

b2-042-s003.skeleton: he picked up a long pipe

modifiers.text: As soon as he saw us
and opened one of the baskets

b2-042-s003.gloss: 他一见我们就拿起镶满硬币的长管并打开篮子。
b2-042-s003.whyLearn: as soon as引导时间状语从句，主句用and连接两个连续动作，中间插入被动定语从句，叙事节奏清晰。

b2-043-s003.skeleton: Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole
b2-043-s003.gloss: 伯德成功飞越南极，这是第一次。
b2-043-s003.whyLearn: 逗号隔开主语与谓语，successfully直接修饰动词，for the first time点明首次，句式简洁有力。

b2-043-s004.skeleton: they soon ran into serious trouble

modifiers.text: Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below

b2-043-s004.gloss: 起初他们还能拍下群山照片，很快就遇上麻烦。
b2-043-s004.whyLearn: Though引导让步从句置前，主句soon ran into形成转折；a great many与that定语从句叠加，信息密度高。

modifiers.text: that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away
for there were no more mountains in sight

b2-043-s009.gloss: 伯德知道能到南极了，前方再无山影。
b2-043-s009.whyLearn: knew后接that宾语从句表心理活动，从句内嵌which定语从句与for原因分句，展示多层从句的挂接方式。

b2-044-s001.skeleton: Mrs Anne Sterling did not think of the risk

modifiers.text: when she ran through a forest after two men

b2-044-s001.gloss: 斯特林太太没想风险，就穿过森林追那两人。
b2-044-s001.whyLearn: think of后用省略关系词的定语从句she was taking，句尾when从句交代追赶背景，一次看清嵌套与时间状语。

b2-044-s004.gloss: 斯特林太太气得追了上去。
b2-044-s004.whyLearn: so...that结构把愤怒与追赶的结果一线串起，that从句前不加逗号，是描述因果结果的常用口语句式。

modifiers.text: When she caught up with them
that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag
so she ran straight at them

b2-044-s006.gloss: 她追上后见他们翻包，便直冲过去。
b2-044-s006.whyLearn: when从句先设场景，saw后宾语从句用过去完成与过去进行并列，句末so引出果断动作，长句层次分明。

b2-044-s007.skeleton: The men got such a fright

modifiers.text: that they dropped the bag and ran away

b2-044-s007.gloss: 那两人吓坏了，丢下包就跑。
b2-044-s007.whyLearn: such a fright that与so...that同源却接名词，that从句用两个并列动词写出一连串动作，口语感强。

modifiers.text: that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers
but it was not returned to him

b2-045-s003.gloss: 萨姆确信钱包是被村民捡到的，却没人还他。
b2-045-s003.whyLearn: be sure that接宾语从句，must have been found是情态推测加被动，but转折点出钱包未还。

b2-045-s005.skeleton: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money

modifiers.text: together with a note which said: 'A thief, yes, 'but only 5o per cent a thief!'
which said: 'A thief, yes, 'but only 5o per cent a thief!'

b2-045-s005.gloss: 钱包用报纸包着，还回一半钱和一张字条。
b2-045-s005.whyLearn: and连接两个并列分句，前句用过去完成被动交代状态，后句以together with引出字条，which定语从句点出留言内容。

b2-046-s006.skeleton: He was so surprised at being discovered

modifiers.text: that he did not even try to run away

b2-046-s006.gloss: 发现自己被认出，他惊得连逃跑都没试。
b2-046-s006.whyLearn: so...that结果句；at后接被动动名词being discovered，从句用did not even try to强化否定。

b2-047-s003.skeleton: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night

modifiers.text: because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar

b2-047-s003.gloss: 他说有天夜里睡不着，因为听见酒吧传来怪声。
b2-047-s003.whyLearn: told me后that宾语从句表转述，because从句交代原因，现在分词coming from the bar后置修饰noise。

modifiers.text: when it is impossible for you to answer

b2-048-s001.gloss: 牙医总在你无法作答时提问。
b2-048-s001.whyLearn: when状语从句后置，it is impossible for you to answer用it作形式主语，说出看牙的无奈。

b2-086-s003.skeleton: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening

modifiers.text: when they were thrown violent1y into the sea

b2-086-s003.gloss: 两人才刚明白发生了什么就被抛入海中。
b2-086-s003.whyLearn: had hardly…when 表「刚……就……」，里面还嵌宾语从句和被动语态，一句练三个点。

b2-086-s009.skeleton: they swam on as quickly as they could

modifiers.text: because they knew that the boat would soon return
that the boat would soon return

b2-086-s009.gloss: 船过去后他们拼命快游，因为知道船还会回来。
b2-086-s009.whyLearn: 时间、原因两个状语从句夹一个宾语从句，还有 as…as one could 表「尽力」的写法。

modifiers.text: At the time the murder was committed

b2-087-s001.gloss: 凶案发生时我正坐在8路车上。
b2-087-s001.whyLearn: at the time 交代时间背景，被动语态说事件、过去进行时说自己在场，是不在场证明的经典句式。

b2-089-s007.skeleton: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed

modifiers.text: as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come

b2-089-s007.gloss: 没进场的人本不必失望，很多演员根本没来。
b2-089-s007.whyLearn: need not have done 表「本来不必做」，配两个定语从句和 as 原因从句，可辨虚拟与推测。

modifiers.text: As soon as he opened his mouth

b2-089-s010.gloss: 他一开口，大家就哄堂大笑。
b2-089-s010.whyLearn: as soon as 表「一……就……」，主句用 burst out doing 写瞬间反应，讲故事可直接套用。

b2-090-s002.skeleton: the Brazilian government decided to have a new city built

modifiers.text: It was mainly for this reason that
to have a new city built 600 miles north-west of Rio de Janeiro
600 miles north-west of Rio de Janeiro

b2-090-s002.gloss: 正因如此，巴西政府决定另建新都。
b2-090-s002.whyLearn: It was…that 强调句把原因状语提到焦点，have sth done 表「让人建造」，适合仿写强调原因。

b2-091-s002.skeleton: He informed the station at once

modifiers.text: but no one there was able to explain the mystery

b2-091-s002.gloss: 他立刻报告车站，却没人能解释这谜团。
b2-091-s002.whyLearn: but 并列两个分句形成对比，be able to do 强调过去某一次的具体能力，比 can 更实。

b2-091-s003.skeleton: The officer in the control tower was very angry

modifiers.text: because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft

b2-091-s003.gloss: 控制塔官员听到消息很生气，因气球危及飞机。
b2-091-s003.whyLearn: 主句先立态度，再挂时间、原因两个状语从句交代来龙去脉，描写加说理一步到位。

b2-092-s002.skeleton: I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall, and began climbing towards the bedroom window

modifiers.text: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the door-bell
from the shed in the garden

b2-092-s002.gloss: 叫不醒妻子，我搬来梯子爬向卧室窗。
b2-092-s002.whyLearn: but…so…串起三个并列谓语，by doing 表方式，动作链一气呵成，可学叙事节奏。

b2-092-s008.skeleton: I hate to interrupt a man

modifiers.text: but would you mind coming with me to the station ?'

b2-092-s008.gloss: 本不想打扰，但能请你跟我去趟警局吗？
b2-092-s008.whyLearn: would you mind doing 是礼貌请求的固定句式，前面用 when 从句铺垫，客气又不失执法的分寸。

b2-093-s007.skeleton: it was taken to pieces and sent to America
b2-093-s007.gloss: 第二年它被拆成零件运往美国。
b2-093-s007.whyLearn: 两个被动谓语共用一个主语，第二个省略 was，学「被拆开又运走」这类并列被动的省略写法。

b2-094-s003.skeleton: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water

modifiers.text: to be reluctant to enter the water
so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool
from the floor of the pool

b2-094-s003.gloss: 两月大婴儿不怕水，很快能潜水捡物。
b2-094-s003.whyLearn: appear to be reluctant to do 层层套接表「似乎不愿」，后半 so…that 写成长之快，信息密度很高。

b2-095-s018.skeleton: And how can you explain that
b2-095-s018.gloss: 那这件事你又怎么解释呢？
b2-095-s018.whyLearn: how can you 开头的反问句，情态动词 can 带出质问语气，是口语里追问归因的短句模板。

b2-096-s006.skeleton: the food that had been laid out for the dead is thrown into a river or into the sea

modifiers.text: that had been laid out for the dead
as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it
for anyone living to eat it

b2-096-s006.gloss: 清晨为亡者摆的食物被倒进河或海里。
b2-096-s006.whyLearn: 主语被定语从句撑开，句末 as 从句交代原因，被动加过去完成时讲清先后，很有说明文味道。

b2-096-s007.skeleton: the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before, are placed into the water

modifiers.text: In towns that are near the sea
which had been hung in the streets the night before

b2-096-s007.gloss: 海边城镇的灯笼在节后放入水中。
b2-096-s007.whyLearn: 两个定语从句分别修饰 towns 和 lanterns，主句用被动，句末再挂 when 从句，长句分层清楚。

modifiers.text: When reports came into London Zoo that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of London
that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of London

b3-001-s002.gloss: 有关美洲狮的报告送到动物园，却没人当真。
b3-001-s002.whyLearn: 同位语从句和时间状语从句套在一起，主句被动加否定，学新闻式「先铺背景再落结果」。
